title.zh: 卷三百三十 列傳第二百十八 西域二
title.raw: 卷三百三十 列傳第二百十八 西域二 Volume 330 Biographies 218: Western Regions 2

sentences.zh: 西番諸衛

translations.literal: The Various Western Tibetan Guard Units
translations.idiomatic: The Western Tibetan Guard Units

sentences.zh: 〈（西寧河州洮州岷州等番族諸衛）〉

translations.literal: (The various guard units of the Tibetan peoples at Xining, Hezhou, Taozhou, Minzhou, and elsewhere)〉
translations.idiomatic: (Guard units of the Tibetan peoples of Xining, Hezhou, Taozhou, Minzhou, and the like)〉

sentences.zh: 西番，即西羌，族種最多，自陝西曆四川、雲南西徼外皆是。

translations.literal: The Western Tibetans are the Western Qiang; their clans and kinds are the most numerous, and they are found everywhere beyond the western frontiers from Shaanxi through Sichuan and Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: The Western Tibetans were the Western Qiang peoples, the most diverse of all the frontier tribes, ranging beyond the western marches from Shaanxi through Sichuan and into Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 其散處河、湟、洮、岷間者，為中國患尤劇。

translations.literal: Those scattered between the He, Huang, Tao, and Min rivers caused China the gravest trouble.
translations.idiomatic: Those settled among the He, Huangshui, Tao, and Min river valleys were an especially severe plague upon the empire.

sentences.zh: 漢趙充國、張奐、段熲，唐哥舒翰，宋王韶之所經營，皆此地也。

translations.literal: The campaigns that Han Zhao Chongguo, Zhang Huan, and Duan Jiong, Tang Geshu Han, and Song Wang Shao waged were all in this region.
translations.idiomatic: This was the very country where Han generals Zhao Chongguo, Zhang Huan, and Duan Jiong, Tang's Geshu Han, and Song's Wang Shao had all sought to bring the frontier to heel.

sentences.zh: 元封駙馬章古為寧濮郡王，鎮西寧，於河州設吐番宣慰司，以洮、岷、黎、雅諸州隸之，統治番眾。

translations.literal: Under the Yuan, the imperial son-in-law Zhanggu was enfeoffed as Prince of Ningpu and stationed at Xining; a Tibetan Pacification Commission was established at Hezhou, with Taozhou, Minzhou, Li, Ya, and other prefectures subordinated to it to rule the Tibetan peoples.
translations.idiomatic: In Yuan times the imperial son-in-law Zhanggu was made Prince of Ningpu and posted at Xining; a Tibetan Pacification Commission was set up at Hezhou, governing Taozhou, Minzhou, Li, Ya, and the rest, and holding authority over the Tibetan populations.

sentences.zh: 洪武二年，太祖定陝西，即遣官齎詔招諭，其酋長皆觀望。

translations.literal: In the second year of Hongwu, when the Taizu pacified Shaanxi, he immediately sent officials bearing imperial edicts to summon and instruct them, but their chieftains all held back in watchful waiting.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu year 2, as the Hongwu Emperor consolidated Shaanxi, he at once dispatched officials with edicts of summons and reassurance—but the tribal chiefs mostly waited to see which way the wind would blow.

sentences.zh: 復遣員外郎許允德招之，乃多聽命。

translations.literal: He then sent Supervisor of Officials Xu Yunde to recruit them, whereupon most obeyed.
translations.idiomatic: When he sent Xu Yunde, an outer-court secretary, to win them over, most at last submitted.

sentences.zh: 明年五月，吐蕃宣慰使何鎖南普等以元所授金銀牌印宣敕來上，會鄧愈克河州，遂詣軍前降。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the following year, the Tibetan Pacification Commissioner Hesuo Nanpu and others presented the gold and silver plaques, seals, and edicts bestowed by the Yuan; as Deng Yu captured Hezhou, they thereupon came to the army camp to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: The next year, in the fifth month, Hesuo Nanpu, Tibetan Pacification Commissioner, and his colleagues brought forward the Yuan-issue gold and silver tallies, seals, and commissions; learning that Deng Yu had taken Hezhou, they went straight to his camp to yield.

sentences.zh: 其鎮西武靖王卜納剌亦以吐蕃諸部來納款。

translations.literal: The Prince of Wujing in the West, Bonala, also came with the various Tibetan departments to offer allegiance.
translations.idiomatic: Bonala, the Yuan Prince of Wujing in the West, likewise brought the Tibetan tribes in to pledge submission.

sentences.zh: 冬，何鎖南普等入朝貢馬及方物。

translations.literal: In winter, Hesuo Nanpu and others came to court and presented horses and local products as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That winter Hesuo Nanpu and his party arrived at court with horses and regional goods as tribute.

sentences.zh: 帝喜，賜襲衣。

translations.literal: The emperor was pleased and bestowed court robes.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was delighted and granted them robes of office.

sentences.zh: 四年正月設河州衛，命為指揮同知，予世襲，知院朵兒只、汪家奴併為指揮僉事。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fourth year the Hezhou Guard was established; he was appointed Assistant Commander, with hereditary tenure, and Supervisors Duorzhi and Wangjianu were both made Assistant Commandants.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 4 the Hezhou Guard was founded; Hesuo Nanpu was made assistant commander with a hereditary commission, while Duorzhi and Wangjianu of the Pacification Office were appointed assistant commandants alongside him.

sentences.zh: 設千戶所八，百戶所七，皆命其酋長為之。

translations.literal: Eight battalion offices and seven company offices were established, all commanded by their chieftains.
translations.idiomatic: Eight battalion posts and seven company posts were set up, each headed by a local chief.

sentences.zh: 卜納剌等亦至京師，為靖南衛指揮同知，其儕桑加朵兒只為高昌衛指揮同知，皆帶刀侍衛。

translations.literal: Bonala and others also came to the capital; he was made Assistant Commander of the Jingnan Guard, and his companion Sangjiaduorzhi was made Assistant Commander of the Gaochang Guard; all served as sword-bearing attendants.
translations.idiomatic: Bonala and his fellows likewise came to the capital: Bonala was named assistant commander of the Jingnan Guard, and Sangjiaduorzhi assistant commander of the Gaochang Guard; both were enrolled among the emperor's sword-bearing bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 自是，番酋日至。

translations.literal: From this time Tibetan chieftains arrived daily.
translations.idiomatic: After that, Tibetan chiefs came in day after day.

sentences.zh: 尋以降人馬梅、汪瓦兒併為河州衛指揮僉事。

translations.literal: Soon the surrendered leaders Ma Mei and Wangwa'er were both made Assistant Commandants of the Hezhou Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the defectors Ma Mei and Wangwa'er were also appointed assistant commandants of the Hezhou Guard.

sentences.zh: 又遣西寧州同知李喃哥等招撫其酋長，至者亦悉授官。

translations.literal: Li Nange, Vice Magistrate of Xining Prefecture, and others were again sent to win over their chieftains, and all who came were likewise granted office.
translations.idiomatic: The court also sent Li Nange, vice magistrate of Xining, and others to pacify the chiefs; every chief who responded was given a post.

sentences.zh: 乃改西寧州為衛，以喃哥為指揮。

translations.literal: Xining Prefecture was then converted into a guard, with Nange as commander.
translations.idiomatic: Xining Prefecture was thereupon converted into a guard, and Nange made its commander.

sentences.zh: 帝以西番產馬，與之互市，馬至漸多。

translations.literal: Because the Western Tibetans produced horses, the emperor traded with them in mutual markets, and horses gradually became more numerous.
translations.idiomatic: Since the Western Tibetans bred horses, the emperor opened horse markets with them, and mounts soon began to arrive in greater numbers.

sentences.zh: 而其所用之貨與中國異，自更鈔法後，馬至者少，患之。

translations.literal: Yet the currency they used differed from China's; after the reform of paper money, fewer horses came, which caused concern.
translations.idiomatic: The goods they accepted in trade, however, were not the same as China's currency; after the paper-money reforms, fewer horses arrived, and the court grew anxious.

sentences.zh: 八年五月命中官趙成齎羅綺、綾絹並巴茶往河州市之，馬稍集，率厚其值以償。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the eighth year the eunuch Zhao Cheng was ordered to carry brocades, damasks, silks, and Ba tea to Hezhou to purchase horses; horses gradually gathered, and generous prices were generally paid in compensation.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of year 8 the eunuch Zhao Cheng was sent to Hezhou with brocades, damasks, silks, and Ba tea to buy horses; the animals began to come in again, and the court usually paid them handsomely.

sentences.zh: 成又宣諭德意，番人感悅，相率詣闕謝恩。

translations.literal: Cheng also proclaimed the emperor's gracious intent; the Tibetans were moved and pleased and came in groups to the palace to give thanks.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Cheng also proclaimed the emperor's benevolent intentions; the Tibetans were deeply moved and came in groups to the capital to express their gratitude.

sentences.zh: 山後歸德等州西番諸部落皆以馬來市。

translations.literal: The various Western Tibetan tribes of Guidu and other prefectures beyond the mountains all brought horses to market.
translations.idiomatic: Western Tibetan tribes from Guidu and other prefectures beyond the mountains likewise brought horses to trade.

sentences.zh: 十二年，洮州十八族番酋三副使等叛，據納麟七站之地。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, the Tibetan chieftain Sanfushi of the Eighteen Clans of Taozhou and others rebelled and seized the territory of the seven stations of Nalin.
translations.idiomatic: In year 12 Sanfushi, a chief of Taozhou's Eighteen Clans, and others rose in revolt and occupied the seven relay stations at Nalin.

sentences.zh: 命征西將軍沐英等討之，又命李文忠往籌軍事。

translations.literal: The Western Expeditionary General Mu Ying and others were ordered to attack them, and Li Wenzhong was also ordered to go plan the military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Mu Ying, general of the western expedition, was ordered to suppress them, and Li Wenzhong was sent to oversee the campaign.

sentences.zh: 英等至洮州舊城，寇遁去，追斬其魁數人，盡獲畜產。

translations.literal: Ying and the others reached the old city of Taozhou; the bandits fled, several of their leaders were pursued and beheaded, and all their livestock was captured.
translations.idiomatic: Mu Ying reached the old Taozhou town; the rebels fled, several ringleaders were run down and killed, and all their herds were taken.

sentences.zh: 遂於東籠山南川度地築城置戍，遣使來奏。

translations.literal: They then measured ground in the southern valley of Donglong Mountain, built a city, and stationed garrisons, and sent envoys to report.
translations.idiomatic: They then chose a site in the southern valley below Donglong Mountain, built a fortified town, posted garrisons, and sent a memorial to court.

sentences.zh: 帝報曰：「洮州，西番門戶，築城戍守，扼其咽喉。」

translations.literal: The emperor replied: "Taozhou is the gateway of the Western Tibetans; by building a city and garrisoning it, you choke their throat."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor answered: "Taozhou is the gateway to the Western Tibetans. To fortify it and hold garrisons there is to seize them by the throat."

sentences.zh: 遂置洮州衛，以指揮聶緯、陳暉等六人守之。

translations.literal: The Taozhou Guard was then established, with Commanders Nie Wei, Chen Hui, and four others to defend it.
translations.idiomatic: The Taozhou Guard was accordingly established, with Nie Wei, Chen Hui, and four other commanders placed in charge.

sentences.zh: 已，文忠等言官軍守洮州，餉艱民勞。

translations.literal: Later Wenzhong and others said that government troops guarding Taozhou faced hardship in supplies and toil for the people.
translations.idiomatic: Later Li Wenzhong and his colleagues reported that holding Taozhou strained supply lines and burdened the local population.

sentences.zh: 帝降敕諭之曰：「洮州西控番戎，東蔽湟、隴，漢、唐以來備邊要地。

translations.literal: The emperor issued an edict instructing them: "Taozhou controls the Tibetan barbarians to the west and shields Huang and Long to the east; since Han and Tang it has been a vital frontier post.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sent down an edict: "Taozhou commands the Tibetan frontier to the west and shields Huang and Long to the east. Since Han and Tang times it has been a key border strongpoint.

sentences.zh: 今番寇既斥，棄之不守，數年後番人將復為患。

translations.literal: Now that the Tibetan bandits have been driven off, if you abandon it and do not hold it, within a few years the Tibetans will again become a scourge.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels have only just been driven out. If you abandon the post now, within a few years the Tibetans will be raiding again.

sentences.zh: 慮小費而忘大虞，豈良策哉。

translations.literal: To fret over small expense and forget great peril—can that be a good plan?
translations.idiomatic: To stint on small costs while forgetting a far greater danger—is that wise policy?

sentences.zh: 所獲牛羊，分給將士，亦足棄兩年軍食。

translations.literal: The cattle and sheep captured, if distributed to officers and soldiers, would also suffice to spare two years of army provisions.
translations.idiomatic: Divide the cattle and sheep you captured among the troops, and they alone will cover two years of rations.

sentences.zh: 其如敕行之。」

translations.literal: Carry this out as the edict commands."
translations.idiomatic: Carry out my orders accordingly."

sentences.zh: 文忠等乃不敢違。

translations.literal: Wenzhong and the others then did not dare disobey.
translations.idiomatic: Li Wenzhong and his colleagues dared not gainsay him.

sentences.zh: 秋，何鎖南普及鎮撫劉溫各攜家屬來朝。

translations.literal: In autumn, Hesuo Nanpu and the Pacification Commissioner Liu Wen each came to court with their families.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn Hesuo Nanpu and the pacification commissioner Liu Wen each arrived at court with their families in tow.

sentences.zh: 諭中書省臣曰：「何鎖南普自歸附以來，信義甚堅。

translations.literal: He instructed the ministers of the Secretariat: "Since his submission, Hesuo Nanpu's faith and loyalty have been very firm.
translations.idiomatic: He told the Secretariat: "Since Hesuo Nanpu submitted, his loyalty has been unwavering.

sentences.zh: 前遣使烏斯藏，遠涉萬里，及歸，所言皆稱朕意。

translations.literal: Previously he was sent as envoy to U-Tsang, traveling ten thousand li; on his return, everything he reported accorded with my intent.
translations.idiomatic: When I sent him as envoy to U-Tsang, he crossed ten thousand li; on his return, everything he reported pleased me.

sentences.zh: 今以家屬來朝，宜加禮待。」

translations.literal: Now that he has come to court with his family, he should receive added courtesy."
translations.idiomatic: Now that he has brought his household to court, treat him with special honor."

sentences.zh: 乃賜米、麥各三十石，劉溫三之一。

translations.literal: He then bestowed thirty piculs each of rice and wheat; Liu Wen received one-third as much.
translations.idiomatic: He granted thirty piculs each of rice and wheat; Liu Wen received a third of that amount.

sentences.zh: 英等進擊番寇，大破之，盡擒其魁，俘斬數萬人，獲馬牛羊數十萬。

translations.literal: Ying and others advanced to attack the Tibetan bandits, routed them utterly, captured all their leaders, took and killed tens of thousands, and obtained hundreds of thousands of horses, cattle, and sheep.
translations.idiomatic: Mu Ying pressed the attack and shattered the Tibetan forces, capturing every leader, killing or taking tens of thousands, and seizing hundreds of thousands of horses, cattle, and sheep.

sentences.zh: 自是，群番震懾，不敢為寇。

translations.literal: From this time the Tibetan groups were awed and did not dare raid.
translations.idiomatic: After that the tribes were cowed and dared not raid again.

sentences.zh: 十六年，青海酋長史剌巴等七人來歸，賜文綺、寶鈔。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, the Qinghai chieftain Silaba and six others came to submit; they were granted patterned silks and treasure notes.
translations.idiomatic: In year 16 Silaba of Qinghai and six other chiefs submitted; the court rewarded them with brocades and treasure notes.

sentences.zh: 時岷州亦設衛，番人歲以馬易茶，馬日蕃息。

translations.literal: At this time a guard was also established at Minzhou; the Tibetans each year traded horses for tea, and horses daily multiplied.
translations.idiomatic: A guard was also set up at Minzhou; each year the Tibetans traded horses for tea, and the herds steadily grew.

sentences.zh: 二十五年又命中官而聶至河州，召必里諸番族，以敕諭之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year the eunuch Ernie was again ordered to Hezhou to summon the various Tibetan clans of Bili and instruct them by imperial edict.
translations.idiomatic: In year 25 the eunuch Ernie was again sent to Hezhou to summon the Bili tribes and proclaim the imperial edict.

sentences.zh: 爭出馬以獻，得萬三百餘匹，給茶三十餘萬觔。

translations.literal: They vied to bring out horses to present; more than ten thousand three hundred were obtained, and more than three hundred thousand jin of tea was given.
translations.idiomatic: They competed to offer horses; over 10,300 were collected, and more than 300,000 jin of tea was paid in return.

sentences.zh: 命以馬畀河南、山東、陝西騎士。

translations.literal: An order was issued to distribute the horses to cavalry in Henan, Shandong, and Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered the horses distributed to the mounted forces of Henan, Shandong, and Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 帝以諸衛將士有擅索番人馬者，遣官齎金、銅信符敕諭，往賜涼州、甘州、肅州、永昌、山丹、臨洮、鞏昌、西寧、洮州、河州、岷州諸番族。

translations.literal: Because officers and soldiers of the various guards had presumptuously demanded horses from Tibetans, the emperor sent officials bearing gold and bronze tally tokens and edicts of instruction to bestow them upon the Tibetan peoples of Liangzhou, Ganzhou, Suzhou, Yongchang, Shandan, Lintao, Gongchang, Xining, Taozhou, Hezhou, and Minzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Learning that guard troops had been seizing Tibetan horses on their own authority, the emperor sent officials with gold and bronze tally tokens and edicts to the Tibetan peoples of Liangzhou, Ganzhou, Suzhou, Yongchang, Shandan, Lintao, Gongchang, Xining, Taozhou, Hezhou, and Minzhou.

sentences.zh: 諭之曰：「往者朝廷有所需，必酬以茶貨，未許私徵。

translations.literal: He instructed them: "In the past, whenever the court had needs, it always compensated with tea and goods; private levies were not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: He told them: "Whenever the court has needed anything in the past, it has always paid in tea and goods. Private exactions were forbidden.

sentences.zh: 近聞邊將無狀，多假朝命擾害，俾爾等不獲寧居。

translations.literal: Recently I have heard that frontier generals have behaved shamefully, often using the court's name to harass and harm, so that you cannot live in peace.
translations.idiomatic: Lately I hear frontier officers have abused their power, using the court's name to harass you so that you cannot live in peace.

sentences.zh: 今特製金、銅信符頒給，遇有徵發，必比對相符始行，否則偽，械至京，罪之。」

translations.literal: Now special gold and bronze tally tokens have been made and issued; whenever there is a levy, it must proceed only after the tallies match; otherwise it is false, and the offender is to be shackled and brought to the capital and punished."
translations.idiomatic: I have had gold and bronze tally tokens made and distributed. No requisition may proceed unless the tallies match. If they do not, the demand is false; bring the offender to the capital in bonds and punish him."

sentences.zh: 自是，需求遂絕。

translations.literal: From this time unauthorized demands ceased.
translations.idiomatic: After that, unauthorized levies stopped.

sentences.zh: 初，西寧番僧三剌為書招降罕東諸部，又建佛剎於碾白南川，以居其眾，至是來朝貢馬，請敕護持，賜寺額。

translations.literal: Earlier, the Xining Tibetan monk Sanla had written letters to summon the surrender of the various departments of Handong, and also built a Buddhist monastery in the southern valley of Nianbai to house his followers; at this time he came to court presenting horses, requested an edict of protection, and was granted a monastery name plaque.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the Xining monk Sanla had written to win over the Handong tribes and built a monastery in the southern valley at Nianbai to house his followers. Now he came to court with horses, asked for an imperial protective edict, and received an official temple name.

sentences.zh: 帝從所請，賜額曰瞿曇寺。

translations.literal: The emperor granted his request and bestowed the name Qutan Monastery.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor granted his request and named the temple Qutan Monastery.

sentences.zh: 立西寧僧綱司，以三剌為都綱司。

translations.literal: The Xining Monastic Registry was established, with Sanla as Chief Registrar.
translations.idiomatic: A monastic registry was established at Xining, with Sanla as chief registrar.

sentences.zh: 又立河州番、漢二僧綱司，並以番僧為之，紀以符契。

translations.literal: Tibetan and Han monastic registries were also established at Hezhou, both headed by Tibetan monks, recorded by tally contracts.
translations.idiomatic: Separate Tibetan and Han monastic registries were also set up at Hezhou, both headed by Tibetan monks and recorded by written commissions.

sentences.zh: 自是其徒爭建寺，帝輒錫以嘉名，且賜敕護持。

translations.literal: From this time his followers vied to build monasteries; the emperor would bestow fine names and grant protective edicts.
translations.idiomatic: After that his followers competed to build temples, and the emperor would grant them fine names and protective edicts.

sentences.zh: 番僧來者日眾。

translations.literal: Tibetan monks arriving daily grew numerous.
translations.idiomatic: Tibetan monks arriving at court grew more numerous by the day.

sentences.zh: 永樂時，諸衛僧戒行精勤者，多授剌麻、禪師、灌頂國師之號，有加至大國師、西天佛子者，悉給以印誥，許之世襲，且令歲一朝貢，由是諸僧及諸衛士官輻輳京師。

translations.literal: In the Yongle period, monks of the various guards who were diligent in discipline and practice were mostly granted the titles of Lama, Chan Master, and Initiation State Preceptor; some were advanced to Great State Preceptor or Buddha Son of the Western Heaven; all were given seals and patents, permitted hereditary succession, and ordered to present tribute once a year—whereby monks and guard officers converged on the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Under Yongle, diligent monks of the guard units were often made lamas, chan masters, or initiation state preceptors; some rose to great state preceptor or Buddha-son of the Western Heaven. All received seals and patents, hereditary tenure, and an annual tribute mission—so monks and guard officers thronged the capital.

sentences.zh: 其他族種，如西寧十三族、岷州十八族、洮州十八族之屬，大者數千人，少者數百，亦許歲一奉貢，優以宴賚。

translations.literal: Other tribal kinds, such as the Thirteen Clans of Xining, the Eighteen Clans of Minzhou, and the Eighteen Clans of Taozhou—the large numbering several thousand, the small several hundred—were also permitted one tribute mission a year and generously feasted and rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: Other tribal groups—the Thirteen Clans of Xining, the Eighteen of Minzhou, the Eighteen of Taozhou, and the like, some numbering thousands and others only hundreds—were likewise allowed one tribute visit a year and entertained with generous feasts and gifts.

sentences.zh: 西番之勢益分，其力益弱，西陲之患亦益寡。

translations.literal: The power of the Western Tibetans grew ever more divided, their strength ever weaker, and frontier troubles in the west grew ever fewer.
translations.idiomatic: Western Tibetan power grew ever more fragmented and their strength ever weaker, while troubles on the western frontier steadily diminished.

sentences.zh: 宣德元年，以協討安定、曲先功，加國師吒思巴領占等五人為大國師，給誥命、銀印，秩正四品，加剌麻著星等六人為禪師，給敕命、銀印，秩正六品。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xuande, for assisting in the campaign against Anding and Quxian, five persons including State Preceptor Tashiba Lingzhan were promoted to Great State Preceptor, given patents and silver seals, rank fourth grade; six persons including Lama Zhuxing were promoted to Chan Master, given edict patents and silver seals, rank sixth grade.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuande year 1, for helping suppress Anding and Quxian, five men including state preceptor Tashiba Lingzhan were raised to great state preceptor with patents and silver seals at rank 4a, and six lamas including Zhuxing were made chan masters with edict patents and silver seals at rank 6a.

sentences.zh: 正統五年敕陝西鎮守都督鄭銘、都御史陳鎰曰：「得奏，言河州番民領占等先因避罪，逃居結河裡，招集徒黨，占耕土田，不注籍納賦，又藏匿逃亡，剽劫行旅，欲發兵討之。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Zhengtong an edict was sent to the Shaanxi garrison commander-in-chief Zheng Ming and Censor-in-Chief Chen Yi: "We have received your memorial stating that the Hezhou Tibetan Lingzhan and others, having first fled to avoid punishment, dwelt at Jieheli, gathered followers, occupied and farmed land, failed to register and pay taxes, also harbored fugitives, and plundered travelers; you wish to send troops to attack them.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengtong year 5 the emperor ordered Shaanxi garrison commander Zheng Ming and censor-in-chief Chen Yi: "Your memorial reports that the Hezhou Tibetan Lingzhan and others fled to escape punishment, settled at Jieheli, gathered followers, seized farmland without registering or paying taxes, harbored fugitives, and robbed travelers. You propose to send troops against them.

sentences.zh: 朕念番性頑梗，且所犯在赦前，若遽加師旅，恐累及無辜。

translations.literal: I reflect that Tibetans are stubborn by nature, and their offenses occurred before the amnesty; if troops are hastily sent, I fear the innocent will be implicated.
translations.idiomatic: I bear in mind that Tibetans are a stubborn people, and their crimes fell before the general amnesty. If we march at once, innocents may suffer with the guilty.

sentences.zh: 宜使人撫諭，令散遣徒黨，還所掠牛羊，兵即勿進，否則加兵未晚。

translations.literal: It is fitting to send men to pacify and instruct them, ordering them to disperse their followers and return stolen cattle and sheep; do not advance the army yet—if they refuse, it will not be too late to add troops.
translations.idiomatic: Send envoys to reassure them: disperse your followers and return what you stole. Hold the army back for now; if they refuse, you may still send troops later.

sentences.zh: 爾等其審之。」

translations.literal: You must weigh this carefully."
translations.idiomatic: Consider this carefully."

sentences.zh: 番人果輸服。

translations.literal: The Tibetans indeed submitted.
translations.idiomatic: The Tibetans duly submitted.

sentences.zh: 七年再敕銘及都御史王翱等曰：「得鎮守河州都指揮劉永奏：往歲阿爾官等六族三千餘人，列營歸德城下，聲言交易，後乃鈔掠屯軍，大肆焚戮；

translations.literal: In the seventh year Ming and Censor-in-Chief Wang Ao and others were again ordered: "We have received the memorial of Liu Yong, Commander-in-Chief garrisoning Hezhou: last year more than three thousand of the six clans of Aerguan and others encamped below Guide City, claiming trade, but later raided garrison troops and carried out great burning and slaughter;
translations.idiomatic: In year 7 the emperor again ordered Zheng Ming and censor-in-chief Wang Ao: "Commander Liu Yong of the Hezhou garrison reports that last year more than three thousand men of the six Aerguan clans camped below Guide, claiming to trade, then raided the garrison troops and burned and killed on a wide scale;

sentences.zh: 而著亦匝族番人屢於暖泉亭諸處，潛為寇盜。

translations.literal: while Tibetans of the Zhuoyiza clan repeatedly at Nuanchuan Pavilion and other places secretly acted as bandits.
translations.idiomatic: while Tibetans of the Zhuoyiza clan have repeatedly raided around Nuanchuan Pavilion and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 指揮張瑀擒獲二人，止責償所盜馬，縱之使去。

translations.literal: Commander Zhang Yu captured two men but only required repayment of stolen horses and released them.
translations.idiomatic: Commander Zhang Yu seized two of them but merely made them repay the stolen horses and let them go.

sentences.zh: 論法，瑀及永皆當究治，今姑令戴罪。

translations.literal: By law both Yu and Yong should be investigated and punished; for now they are merely ordered to atone while retaining office.
translations.idiomatic: By law both Zhang Yu and Liu Yong should be prosecuted; for now they are allowed to continue in office while under censure.

sentences.zh: 爾等即遣官偕三司堂上親詣其寨，曉以利害，令還歸所掠，許其自新，不悛，則進討。

translations.literal: You are to send officials together with the heads of the three commissions in person to their stockades, explain advantage and harm, order them to return what was plundered, permit them to reform; if they do not repent, then advance to attack.
translations.idiomatic: Send officials with the heads of the provincial commissions in person to their camps. Explain the stakes, demand the return of plunder, and offer them a chance to reform. If they refuse, then attack.

sentences.zh: 蓋馭戎之道，撫綏為先，撫之不從，然後用兵。

translations.literal: For the way to control barbarians, pacification comes first; only when pacification fails should arms be used.
translations.idiomatic: The way to manage frontier peoples is to win them over first; only when persuasion fails should you resort to force.

sentences.zh: 爾等宜體此意。」

translations.literal: You should embody this intent."
translations.idiomatic: Keep this principle in mind."

sentences.zh: 番人亦輸服。

translations.literal: The Tibetans again submitted.
translations.idiomatic: The Tibetans again submitted.

sentences.zh: 成化三年，陝西副使鄭安言：「進貢番僧，自烏斯藏來者不過三之一，餘皆洮、岷寺僧詭名冒貢。

translations.literal: In the third year of Chenghua, Shaanxi Vice Commissioner Zheng An said: "Of the Tibetan monks presenting tribute, not even one in three come from U-Tsang; the rest are monks of Taozhou and Minzhou monasteries who falsely claim names to present tribute fraudulently.
translations.idiomatic: In Chenghua year 3 Shaanxi vice commissioner Zheng An reported: "Of the Tibetan monks who come to present tribute, fewer than a third are actually from U-Tsang; the rest are monks from Taozhou and Minzhou temples who falsely claim titles to present tribute.

sentences.zh: 進一羸馬，輒獲厚直，得所賜幣帛，制為戰袍，以拒官軍。

translations.literal: For presenting one emaciated horse they promptly receive generous payment; with the silks bestowed they make battle robes to resist government troops.
translations.idiomatic: They present one scrawny horse and receive lavish payment, then turn the silks they are given into battle robes to fight government troops.

sentences.zh: 本以羈縻之，而益致寇掠，是虛國帑而齎盜糧也。」

translations.literal: They were meant to be restrained by appeasement, yet this only increases raiding—it is to empty the state treasury and supply grain to bandits."
translations.idiomatic: The policy was meant to keep them in check, yet it only encourages raiding. We are emptying the treasury to feed our enemies."

sentences.zh: 章下禮部，會廷臣議，請行陝西文武諸臣，計定貢期、人數及存留、起送之額以聞，報可。

translations.literal: The memorial was sent to the Ministry of Rites; court ministers were convened to discuss it, and it was requested that Shaanxi civil and military officials calculate and fix tribute periods, numbers, and quotas for retention and escort to report—approved.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial went to the Ministry of Rites. After consultation, the court ordered Shaanxi officials to set tribute schedules, quotas, and rules for who might remain or be escorted to the capital, then report back. The emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 已而奏上，諸自烏斯藏來者皆由四川入，不得徑赴洮、岷，遂著為例。

translations.literal: Later a memorial was submitted: all coming from U-Tsang must enter by Sichuan and may not go directly to Taozhou or Minzhou; this was then established as precedent.
translations.idiomatic: When the report came in, all envoys from U-Tsang were required to enter through Sichuan and forbidden to go directly to Taozhou or Minzhou. This became fixed precedent.

sentences.zh: 明年冬，洮州番寇擁眾掠鐵城、後川二寨，指揮張翰等率兵御之，敗去，獲所掠人口以歸。

translations.literal: The next winter Tibetan bandits of Taozhou gathered a crowd and raided the two stockades of Tiecheng and Houchuan; Commander Zhang Han and others led troops to resist, drove them off in defeat, and recovered the people they had seized.
translations.idiomatic: The following winter Taozhou Tibetans raided the stockades at Tiecheng and Houchuan. Commander Zhang Han drove them off and recovered the captives.

sentences.zh: 五年，巡按江孟綸言：「岷州番寇縱橫，村堡為虛。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, Touring Censor Jiang Menglun said: "Tibetan bandits of Minzhou run rampant, and villages and stockades lie empty.
translations.idiomatic: In year 5 touring censor Jiang Menglun reported: "Tibetan raiders roam Minzhou at will, and villages and stockades stand deserted.

sentences.zh: 頃令指揮後泰與其弟通反覆開示，生番忍藏、占藏等三十餘族酋長百六十餘人，熟番栗林等二十四族酋長九十一人，轉相告語，悔過來歸，且還被掠人畜，願供徭賦。

translations.literal: Recently Commander Houtai and his brother Tong were ordered repeatedly to instruct them; more than 160 chieftains of over 30 raw-Tibetan clans such as Rencang and Zhancang, and 91 chieftains of 24 settled-Tibetan clans such as Lilin, told one another, repented and came to submit, also returned plundered people and livestock, and wished to supply labor and taxes.
translations.idiomatic: Commander Houtai and his brother Tong were sent repeatedly to reason with them. More than 160 chiefs of over thirty raw-Tibetan clans and ninety-one chiefs of twenty-four settled clans persuaded one another to repent, return plundered people and livestock, submit, and pay taxes and corvée.

sentences.zh: 殺牛告天，誓不再犯。

translations.literal: They killed cattle to announce to Heaven and swore not to offend again.
translations.idiomatic: They sacrificed cattle before Heaven and swore never to offend again.

sentences.zh: 已令副使李圮從宜賞勞，宣示朝廷恩威，皆歡躍而去。

translations.literal: Vice Commissioner Li Pi has already been ordered to reward them as appropriate, proclaim the court's grace and might, and all departed rejoicing.
translations.idiomatic: Vice commissioner Li Pi was sent to reward them as he saw fit and proclaim the court's grace and authority. They departed rejoicing.

sentences.zh: 惟熟番綠園一族怙惡不服。」

translations.literal: Only the settled-Tibetan Lüyuan clan, relying on wickedness, would not submit."
translations.idiomatic: Only the settled Lüyuan clan, stubborn in their wickedness, refused to submit."

sentences.zh: 兵部言：「番性無常，朝撫夕叛，未可弛備。

translations.literal: The Ministry of War said: "Tibetans are inconstant by nature, pacified in the morning and rebelling by evening; vigilance must not be relaxed.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of War replied: "Tibetans are fickle by nature—pacified in the morning and in revolt by evening. We must not lower our guard.

sentences.zh: 請諭邊臣，向化者加意撫綏，犯順者克期剿滅。」

translations.literal: We request that frontier officials be instructed: toward those who turn to civilization, redouble pacification; toward those who rebel, set a date for extermination."
translations.idiomatic: Tell the frontier officials to treat those who submit with special care, and to destroy rebels on a fixed schedule."

sentences.zh: 帝納其言。

translations.literal: The emperor accepted their advice.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor accepted the recommendation.

sentences.zh: 八年，禮官言：「洮、岷諸衛送各族番人赴京，多至四千二百餘人，應賞彩幣人二表裡，帛如之，鈔二十九萬八千有奇，馬直尚在其外。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, ritual officials said: "The various guards of Taozhou and Minzhou sent Tibetan peoples of various clans to the capital, as many as more than 4,200; each person should be rewarded with two suits of patterned silks and equivalent cloth, more than 298,000 in paper money, not counting horse prices.
translations.idiomatic: In year 8 the ritual officials reported: "The Taozhou and Minzhou guards sent more than 4,200 Tibetans of various tribes to the capital. Rewards would require two suits of patterned silks per person, equivalent cloth, and more than 298,000 in paper money—not counting the price paid for horses.

sentences.zh: 考正統、天順間，各番貢使不過三五百人。

translations.literal: Examining the Zhengtong and Tianshun periods, tribute envoys of the various tribes did not exceed three to five hundred.
translations.idiomatic: Under Zhengtong and Tianshun, tribute missions from the various tribes had numbered no more than three to five hundred.

sentences.zh: 成化初，因洮、岷諸處濫以熟番作生番冒送，已定例，生番三年一貢，大族四五人，小族一二人赴京，餘悉遣還。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Chenghua, because Taozhou, Minzhou, and other places indiscriminately sent settled Tibetans posing as raw Tibetans in fraudulent missions, precedent was fixed: raw Tibetans tribute once every three years; large clans send four or five persons, small clans one or two to the capital, the rest all sent back.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Chenghua, because Taozhou and Minzhou had been sending settled Tibetans disguised as raw tribesmen, regulations were fixed: raw Tibetans were to tribute once every three years, with large clans sending four or five envoys and small clans one or two, and all others sent home.

sentences.zh: 成化六年，副使鄧本瑞妄自招徠，又復冒送，臣部已重申約束。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Chenghua, Vice Commissioner Deng Benrui presumptuously recruited on his own and again sent fraudulent missions; our ministry has already reiterated the restrictions.
translations.idiomatic: In Chenghua year 6 vice commissioner Deng Benrui recruited envoys on his own authority and again sent fraudulent missions. Our ministry has already restated the rules.

sentences.zh: 今副使吳圮等不能嚴飭武備，專事通番，以紓近患。

translations.literal: Now Vice Commissioners Wu Pi and others cannot strictly maintain military readiness but devote themselves to dealing with Tibetans to relieve immediate troubles.
translations.idiomatic: Now vice commissioners Wu Pi and others neglect military readiness and devote themselves to appeasing Tibetans merely to ease immediate troubles.

sentences.zh: 乞降敕切責，務遵前令。」

translations.literal: We beg that an edict be sent down sternly rebuking them, and that they strictly follow the former orders."
translations.idiomatic: We ask that an edict be sent down to rebuke them sharply and compel them to obey the earlier regulations."

sentences.zh: 帝亦如其言。

translations.literal: The emperor likewise followed their words.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 西寧即古湟中，其西四百里有青海，又曰西海，不草豐美。

translations.literal: Xining is the ancient Huangzhong; four hundred li to its west is Qinghai, also called the Western Sea, where the pasture grass is lush and fine.
translations.idiomatic: Xining is ancient Huangzhong. Four hundred li west lies Qinghai—the Western Sea—where the pastures are rich and green.

sentences.zh: 番人環居之，專務畜牧，日益繁滋，素號樂土。

translations.literal: Tibetan peoples lived all around it, devoting themselves exclusively to animal husbandry; day by day they grew more numerous and flourishing, and it was long called a land of contentment.
translations.idiomatic: Tibetans settled all around it, living solely by herding; their numbers grew steadily, and the region had long been known as a happy land.

sentences.zh: 正德四年，蒙古部酋亦不刺、阿爾禿廝獲罪其主，擁眾西奔。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Zhengde, the Mongol chieftains Yibulai and Aertusi offended their lord and fled west at the head of their followers.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengde year 4, the Mongol chiefs Yibulai and Aertusi fell out with their master and fled west with their followers.

sentences.zh: 瞰知青海饒富，襲而據之，大肆焚掠。

translations.literal: Seeing that Qinghai was rich and abundant, they raided and seized it, burning and plundering on a great scale.
translations.idiomatic: Learning how rich Qinghai was, they attacked, seized the region, and burned and looted without restraint.

sentences.zh: 番人失其地，多遠徙。

translations.literal: The Tibetans lost their lands, and many migrated far away.
translations.idiomatic: The Tibetans lost their homeland, and many moved far away.

sentences.zh: 其留者不能自存，反為所役屬。

translations.literal: Those who remained could not support themselves and instead became subject to their service and control.
translations.idiomatic: Those who stayed behind could not survive on their own and instead fell under their domination.

sentences.zh: 自是甘肅、西寧始有海寇之患。

translations.literal: From this time Gansu and Xining first suffered from the Sea Bandits.
translations.idiomatic: From then on Gansu and Xining first suffered from the Sea Bandits.

sentences.zh: 九年，總制彭澤集諸道軍，將搗其巢。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, Supreme Commander Peng Ze assembled armies from the various circuits and was about to strike their lair.
translations.idiomatic: In year 9 supreme commander Peng Ze gathered troops from all circuits and prepared to destroy their base.

sentences.zh: 寇詗知之，由河州渡黃河，奔四川，出松潘、茂州境，直走烏斯藏。

translations.literal: The bandits learned through scouts, crossed the Yellow River at Hezhou, fled into Sichuan, passed through Songpan and Maozhou territory, and made straight for U-Tsang.
translations.idiomatic: The raiders learned of the plan through scouts, crossed the Yellow River at Hezhou, fled into Sichuan, passed through Songpan and Maozhou, and headed straight for U-Tsang.

sentences.zh: 及大軍引還，則仍返海上，惟阿爾禿廝遁去。

translations.literal: When the great army withdrew, they returned again to the Sea region; only Aertusi escaped.
translations.idiomatic: When the main army withdrew, they returned to the Sea region; only Aertusi got away.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖二年，尚書金獻民西征，議遣官招撫，許為籓臣，如先朝設安定、曲先諸衛故事。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jiajing, Minister Jin Xianmin went west on campaign and proposed sending officials to pacify and recruit them, allowing them to become vassal subjects as in the former court's precedent of establishing the Anding, Quxian, and other guard units.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiajing year 2, minister Jin Xianmin marched west and proposed sending officials to pacify the raiders and accept them as vassals, following the earlier precedent of establishing the Anding, Quxian, and other guard units.

sentences.zh: 兵部行總制楊一清計度，一清意在征討，言寇精騎不過二三千，餘皆脅從番人，然怨之入骨，時欲報仇，可用為間諜，大舉剿絕。

translations.literal: The Ministry of War dispatched Supreme Commander Yang Yiqing to assess the situation. Yang Yiqing's intention was to campaign and punish them; he said the bandits' elite horsemen numbered no more than two or three thousand, the rest were Tibetan people coerced to follow, yet they hated them to the bone and constantly sought revenge—they could be used as spies, and a major effort could wipe them out entirely.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of War sent supreme commander Yang Yiqing to assess the situation. Yang favored a punitive campaign: the raiders' crack cavalry numbered no more than two or three thousand; the rest were Tibetans forced to follow. Those Tibetans hated the Mongols to the bone and constantly sought revenge—they could serve as spies, and a major strike could wipe the bandits out.

sentences.zh: 議末定，王憲、王瓊相繼來代，皆以兵寡餉詘，議竟不行。

translations.literal: Before the plan was settled, Wang Xian and Wang Qiong succeeded one another in office; both cited insufficient troops and depleted supplies, and the plan was ultimately not carried out.
translations.idiomatic: Before the plan was settled, Wang Xian and Wang Qiong succeeded one another in the post; both cited too few troops and depleted supplies, and the proposal was never carried out.

sentences.zh: 八年，洮、岷諸番數犯臨洮、鞏昌，內地騷動。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, the Tibetans of Taozhou and Minzhou repeatedly raided Lintao and Gongchang, and the interior was thrown into turmoil.
translations.idiomatic: In year 8 the Tibetans of Taozhou and Minzhou repeatedly attacked Lintao and Gongchang, throwing the interior into turmoil.

sentences.zh: 樞臣李承勛言：「番為海寇所侵，日益內徙。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary Li Chengxun said: "The Tibetans, harassed by the Sea Bandits, are moving inward day by day.
translations.idiomatic: Grand secretary Li Chengxun said: "The Tibetans, harried by the Sea Bandits, are drifting inward day by day.

sentences.zh: 倘二寇交通，何以善後。

translations.literal: If the two bandit forces join together, how can we manage the aftermath?
translations.idiomatic: If the two raiding forces join forces, how are we to manage the aftermath?

sentences.zh: 昔趙充國不戰而服羌，段穎殺羌百萬而內地虛耗，兩者相去遠矣。

translations.literal: In antiquity Zhao Chongguo subdued the Qiang without fighting, while Duan Jiong killed a million Qiang and drained the interior—the two approaches are worlds apart.
translations.idiomatic: In antiquity Zhao Chongguo subdued the Qiang without fighting, while Duan Jiong killed a million Qiang and drained the interior—the two approaches are worlds apart.

sentences.zh: 乞廣先帝之明，專充國之任，制置方略，悉聽瓊便宜從事。」

translations.literal: We beg that Your Majesty extend the late emperor's wisdom, appoint one in Zhao Chongguo's role, devise strategy, and leave Wang Qiong full discretion to act as circumstances require."
translations.idiomatic: We ask that Your Majesty extend the late emperor's wisdom, appoint a man in Zhao Chongguo's role, set overall strategy, and leave Wang Qiong full discretion to act as he sees fit."

sentences.zh: 瓊乃集眾議，且剿且撫。

translations.literal: Qiong then gathered a council and pursued both punitive action and pacification.
translations.idiomatic: Qiong then convened a council and pursued both suppression and pacification.

sentences.zh: 先遣總兵官劉文、游擊彭椷分佈士馬。

translations.literal: First he dispatched Regional Commander Liu Wen and Mobile Corps Commander Peng Zhen to distribute troops and horses.
translations.idiomatic: First he sent regional commander Liu Wen and mobile corps commander Peng Zhen to deploy troops and horses.

sentences.zh: 明年二月自固原進至洮、岷，遣人開示禍福。

translations.literal: In the second month of the following year he advanced from Guyuan to Taozhou and Minzhou and sent men to expound the consequences of good and ill fortune.
translations.idiomatic: The following second month he advanced from Guyuan to Taozhou and Minzhou and sent men to explain the rewards of submission and the penalties of resistance.

sentences.zh: 洮州東路木舍等三十一族，西路答祿失等十三族，岷州西寧溝等十五族，皆聽撫，給白旂犒賜遣歸。

translations.literal: Thirty-one clans of the eastern route of Taozhou such as Mushe, thirteen clans of the western route such as Dalushi, and fifteen clans of Minzhou such as Xininggou—all accepted pacification, were given white banners as rewards, and sent home.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty-one eastern-route Taozhou clans including Mushe, thirteen western-route clans including Dalushi, and fifteen Minzhou clans including Xininggou all accepted pacification, were given white banners as rewards, and sent home.

sentences.zh: 惟岷州東路若籠族、西路板爾等十五族及岷州剌即等五族，恃險不服。

translations.literal: Only the Ruolong clan of Minzhou's eastern route, fifteen clans of the western route such as Ban'er, and five clans of Minzhou such as Laji, relying on difficult terrain, would not submit.
translations.idiomatic: Only the Ruolong clan on Minzhou's eastern route, fifteen western-route clans including Ban'er, and five Minzhou clans including Laji, trusting in difficult terrain, refused to submit.

sentences.zh: 乃分兵先攻若籠、板爾二族，覆其巢，剌即諸族震慴乞降。

translations.literal: He then divided his forces and first attacked the Ruolong and Ban'er clans, overthrew their lairs, and the Laji clans, awestruck and fearful, begged to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: He then divided his forces and first attacked the Ruolong and Ban'er clans, destroyed their strongholds, and the Laji clans, shaken with fear, begged to surrender.

sentences.zh: 凡斬首三百六十餘級，撫定七十餘族，乃班師。

translations.literal: In all more than 360 heads were taken, more than 70 clans were pacified and settled, and the army then withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: In all more than 360 heads were taken, more than seventy clans were pacified, and the army withdrew.

sentences.zh: 自是，洮、岷獲寧，而西寧仍苦寇患。

translations.literal: From this time Taozhou and Minzhou knew peace, but Xining still suffered from bandit troubles.
translations.idiomatic: From then on Taozhou and Minzhou were pacified, but Xining still suffered from raiders.

sentences.zh: 十一年，甘肅巡撫趙載等言：「亦不剌據海上已二十餘年，其黨卜兒孩獨傾心向化，求帖木哥等屬番來納款。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, Gansu Grand Coordinator Zhao Zai and others said: "Yibulai has held the Sea region for more than twenty years; among his followers Boyerhai alone has turned sincerely toward civilization and asks that Timuge and other subordinate Tibetans come to offer allegiance.
translations.idiomatic: In year 11 Gansu grand coordinator Zhao Zai and others reported: "Yibulai has held the Sea region for more than twenty years. Among his followers, Boyerhai alone has turned sincerely toward the court and asks that Timuge and other subordinate Tibetans come to submit.

sentences.zh: 宜因而撫之，或俾之納馬，或令其遣質，或授官給印，建立衛所，為我籓籬，於計為便。」

translations.literal: They should be pacified in this opportunity—by requiring tribute horses, sending hostages, or granting offices and seals and establishing guard units as our vassal bulwark; this would be advantageous."
translations.idiomatic: We should take this opportunity to pacify them—by requiring tribute horses, taking hostages, granting offices and seals, or establishing guard units as our vassal bulwark. That would be the advantageous course."

sentences.zh: 疏甫上，會河套酋吉囊引眾西掠，大破亦不剌營，收其部落大半而去，惟卜兒孩一枝斂眾自保。

translations.literal: No sooner had the memorial been submitted than the Ordos chieftain Jinang led his followers west on a raid, smashed Yibulai's camp, and carried off the greater part of his tribes before departing; only Boyerhai's faction gathered its forces and preserved itself.
translations.idiomatic: No sooner had the memorial been submitted than the Ordos chief Jinang led his followers west on a raid, smashed Yibulai's camp, and carried off most of his tribes before departing; only Boyerhai's band gathered its forces and preserved itself.

sentences.zh: 由是西寧亦獲休息，而納款之議竟寢。

translations.literal: Thereupon Xining also obtained respite, but the plan for submission was ultimately shelved.
translations.idiomatic: Xining then also obtained respite, but the plan for accepting their submission was shelved.

sentences.zh: 及唐龍為總制，寇南掠松潘。

translations.literal: When Tang Long became supreme commander, the bandits raided south into Songpan.
translations.idiomatic: When Tang Long became supreme commander, the raiders plundered south into Songpan.

sentences.zh: 龍慮其回巢與諸番及他部勾結為患，奏行甘肅守臣，繕兵積粟，為殄滅計。

translations.literal: Tang Long feared that on returning to their lair they would collude with the various Tibetans and other tribes to cause trouble; he memorialized the Gansu frontier officials to drill troops and store grain in preparation for their extermination.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Long feared that on returning to their base they would collude with the Tibetans and other tribes to cause trouble; he memorialized the Gansu frontier officials to drill troops, store grain, and prepare for their extermination.

sentences.zh: 及龍去，事亦不行。

translations.literal: When Tang Long departed, the plan was again not carried out.
translations.idiomatic: When Tang Long left office, the plan again came to nothing.

sentences.zh: 二十年正月，卜兒孩獻金牌、良馬求款。

translations.literal: In the first month of the twentieth year, Boyerhai presented a gold tablet and fine horses seeking to submit.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 20, Boyerhai presented a gold tablet and fine horses seeking to submit.

sentences.zh: 兵部言：「寇果輸誠通貢，誠西陲大利。

translations.literal: The Ministry of War said: "If the bandits truly submit in sincerity and open tribute relations, it would indeed be a great benefit to the western frontier.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of War said: "If the raiders truly submit in sincerity and open tribute relations, it would indeed be a great benefit to the western frontier.

sentences.zh: 乃止獻馬及金牌，未有如往歲遣子入侍、酋長入朝之請，未可遽許。

translations.literal: Yet they have offered only horses and a gold tablet, without the requests of previous years to send sons to attend court or chieftains to come to audience—this cannot be granted rashly.
translations.idiomatic: Yet they have offered only horses and a gold tablet, without the requests of previous years to send sons to attend court or chiefs to come to audience—this cannot be granted rashly.

sentences.zh: 宜令督撫臣偵察情實，並條制馭之策以聞。」

translations.literal: The supreme commander and grand coordinators should be ordered to investigate the true situation and submit a detailed plan for controlling them."
translations.idiomatic: The supreme commander and grand coordinators should be ordered to investigate the true situation and submit a detailed plan for controlling them."

sentences.zh: 報可。

translations.literal: The report was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The report was approved.

sentences.zh: 會寇勢漸衰，番人亦漸復業，其議復寢。

translations.literal: As the bandits' strength gradually declined and the Tibetans also gradually resumed their livelihoods, the plan was again shelved.
translations.idiomatic: As the raiders' strength gradually declined and the Tibetans gradually resumed their livelihoods, the plan was shelved again.

sentences.zh: 二十四年設岷州，隸鞏昌府。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year Minzhou was established, subordinated to Gongchang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In year 24 Minzhou was established and placed under Gongchang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 岷西臨極邊，番漢雜處。

translations.literal: Minzhou bordered the outermost frontier to the west, with Tibetans and Han intermixed.
translations.idiomatic: Minzhou lay on the outermost western frontier, where Tibetans and Han lived intermixed.

sentences.zh: 洪武時，改土番十六族為十六里，設衛治之，俾稍供徭役。

translations.literal: In the Hongwu period, sixteen native Tibetan clans were converted into sixteen li districts, guard units were established to govern them, and they were made to supply a measure of corvée labor.
translations.idiomatic: In the Hongwu period sixteen native Tibetan clans were reorganized into sixteen li districts, guard units were established to govern them, and they were required to supply a measure of corvée labor.

sentences.zh: 自設州之後，徵發繁重，人日困敝。

translations.literal: After the prefecture was established, levies and conscriptions grew heavy and the people grew daily more impoverished.
translations.idiomatic: After the prefecture was established, levies and conscriptions grew heavy and the people grew daily more impoverished.

sentences.zh: 且番人戀世官，而流官又不樂居，遙寄治他所。

translations.literal: Moreover the Tibetans clung to hereditary offices, while the appointed officials were unwilling to reside there and governed remotely from elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the Tibetans clung to hereditary offices, while the appointed officials were unwilling to live there and governed remotely from elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 越十餘年，督撫合疏言不便，乃設衛如故。

translations.literal: After more than ten years, the supreme commander and grand coordinators jointly memorialized that the arrangement was unsuitable, and guard units were restored as before.
translations.idiomatic: After more than ten years the supreme commander and grand coordinators jointly memorialized that the arrangement was unsuitable, and guard units were restored as before.

sentences.zh: 時北部俺答猖獗，歲掠宣、大諸鎮。

translations.literal: At this time Altan of the northern regions was rampant, raiding the Xuanda and other garrisons year after year.
translations.idiomatic: At this time Altan of the northern regions was rampant, raiding the Xuanda and other garrisons year after year.

sentences.zh: 又羡青海富饒，三十八年攜子賓兔、丙兔等數萬眾，襲據其地。

translations.literal: He also coveted Qinghai's wealth and abundance; in the thirty-eighth year he led tens of thousands including his sons Bintu and Bingtu and raided to seize the region.
translations.idiomatic: He also coveted Qinghai's wealth; in year 38 he led tens of thousands of men, including his sons Bintu and Bingtu, and seized the region by force.

sentences.zh: 卜兒孩竄走，遂縱掠諸番。

translations.literal: Boyerhai fled in flight, and they then pillaged the various Tibetan peoples at will.
translations.idiomatic: Boyerhai fled, and they then plundered the Tibetan peoples at will.

sentences.zh: 已，引去，留賓兔據松山，丙兔據青海，西寧亦被其患。

translations.literal: Soon after they withdrew, leaving Bintu to hold Songshan and Bingtu to hold Qinghai; Xining also suffered their depredations.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after they withdrew, leaving Bintu at Songshan and Bingtu in Qinghai; Xining also suffered their depredations.

sentences.zh: 隆慶中，俺答受封順義王，修貢惟謹，二子亦斂戢。

translations.literal: In the Longqing period Altan received investiture as Prince of Shunyi, maintained tribute with scrupulous care, and his two sons also restrained themselves.
translations.idiomatic: In the Longqing period Altan received investiture as Prince of Shunyi, maintained tribute with scrupulous care, and his two sons also restrained themselves.

sentences.zh: 時烏斯藏僧有稱活佛者，諸部多奉其教。

translations.literal: At that time among the monks of U-Tsang were those called Living Buddhas, and many tribes followed their teaching.
translations.idiomatic: At that time among the monks of U-Tsang were those called Living Buddhas, and many tribes followed their teaching.

sentences.zh: 丙兔乃以焚修為名，請建寺青海及嘉峪關外，為久居計。

translations.literal: Bingtu then under the pretext of Buddhist devotion requested permission to build temples at Qinghai and beyond Jiayuguan, as a plan for long-term residence.
translations.idiomatic: Bingtu then, under the pretext of Buddhist devotion, requested permission to build temples at Qinghai and beyond Jiayuguan as a plan for long-term residence.

sentences.zh: 廷臣多言不可許，禮官言：「彼已採木興工，而令改建於他所，勢所不能，莫若因而許之，以鼓其善心，而杜其關外之請。

translations.literal: Many court officials said this must not be granted; the ritual officials said: "They have already felled timber and begun construction; to order them to rebuild elsewhere is beyond their power. Better to permit it accordingly, to encourage their good intentions and forestall their requests beyond the pass.
translations.idiomatic: Many court officials said this must not be granted; the ritual officials said: "They have already felled timber and begun construction. To order them to rebuild elsewhere is beyond their power. Better to permit it accordingly, to encourage their good intentions and forestall their requests beyond the pass.

sentences.zh: 況中國之御戎，惟在邊關之有備。

translations.literal: Moreover China's defense against the barbarians depends solely on preparedness at the frontier passes.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover China's defense against the barbarians depends solely on preparedness at the frontier passes.

sentences.zh: 戎之順逆，亦不在一寺之遠近。」

translations.literal: Whether the barbarians submit or rebel does not hinge on whether a temple is near or far."
translations.idiomatic: Whether the barbarians submit or rebel does not hinge on whether a temple is near or far."

sentences.zh: 帝許之。

translations.literal: The emperor granted permission.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor granted permission.

sentences.zh: 丙兔既得請，又近脅番人，使通道松潘以迎活佛。

translations.literal: Once Bingtu obtained permission, he also coerced nearby Tibetans to open a route through Songpan to welcome the Living Buddha.
translations.idiomatic: Once Bingtu obtained permission, he also coerced nearby Tibetans to open a route through Songpan to welcome the Living Buddha.

sentences.zh: 四川守臣懼逼，乞令俺答約束其子，毋擾鄰境。

translations.literal: The Sichuan frontier officials, fearing pressure, asked that Altan restrain his son and not disturb neighboring territory.
translations.idiomatic: The Sichuan frontier officials, fearing pressure, asked that Altan restrain his son and not disturb neighboring territory.

sentences.zh: 俺答言，丙兔止因甘肅不許開市，寧夏又道遠艱難，雖有禁令，不能盡制。

translations.literal: Altan replied that Bingtu's conduct was only because Gansu would not permit markets to open and Ningxia was far and the route difficult; though there were prohibitions, they could not be fully enforced.
translations.idiomatic: Altan replied that Bingtu's conduct was only because Gansu would not permit markets to open and Ningxia was far and the route difficult; though there were prohibitions, they could not be fully enforced.

sentences.zh: 宣大總督方逢時亦言開市為便。

translations.literal: The Xuanda Governor-General Fang Fengshi also said that opening markets would be advantageous.
translations.idiomatic: The Xuanda governor-general Fang Fengshi also said that opening markets would be advantageous.

sentences.zh: 帝以責陝西督撫，督撫不敢違。

translations.literal: The emperor blamed the Shaanxi supreme commander and grand coordinators, and they dared not disobey.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor blamed the Shaanxi supreme commander and grand coordinators, and they dared not disobey.

sentences.zh: 萬曆二年冬，許丙兔市於甘肅，賓兔市於庄浪，歲一次。

translations.literal: In the winter of the second year of Wanli, Bingtu was permitted to trade at Gansu and Bintu at Zhuanglang, once per year.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of Wanli year 2, Bingtu was permitted to trade at Gansu and Bintu at Zhuanglang, once per year.

sentences.zh: 既而寺成，賜額仰華。

translations.literal: Before long the temple was completed and granted the name Yanghua.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the temple was completed and granted the name Yanghua.

sentences.zh: 先是，亦不剌之據青海，邊臣猶以外寇視之。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Yibulai held Qinghai, frontier officials still regarded him as a foreign invader.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Yibulai held Qinghai, frontier officials still regarded him as a foreign invader.

sentences.zh: 至是以俺答故，竟視若屬番。

translations.literal: Now because of Altan, they finally treated them as subordinate Tibetans.
translations.idiomatic: Now because of Altan, they finally treated them as subordinate Tibetans.

sentences.zh: 諸酋亦以父受王封，不敢大為邊患，而洮州之變乃起。

translations.literal: The chieftains also, because their father had received princely investiture, did not dare cause major frontier trouble—yet the Taozhou incident then arose.
translations.idiomatic: The chiefs also, because their father had received princely investiture, did not dare cause major frontier trouble—yet the Taozhou incident then arose.

sentences.zh: 初，洮州番人以河州奸民負其物貨，入掠內地，他族亦乘機為亂。

translations.literal: Initially, Taozhou Tibetans, because Hezhou scoundrels owed them for goods, entered to raid the interior; other clans also seized the opportunity to make trouble.
translations.idiomatic: At first Taozhou Tibetans, because Hezhou scoundrels owed them for goods, raided the interior; other clans also seized the opportunity to make trouble.

sentences.zh: 奸民以告河州參將陳堂，堂曰：「此洮州番也，何與我事。」

translations.literal: The scoundrels reported this to Hezhou Vice Commander Chen Tang, who said: "These are Taozhou Tibetans—what business is it of mine?"
translations.idiomatic: The scoundrels reported this to Hezhou vice commander Chen Tang, who said: "These are Taozhou Tibetans—what business is it of mine?"

sentences.zh: 洮州參將劉世英曰：「彼犯河州，非我失事。」

translations.literal: Taozhou Vice Commander Liu Shiying said: "They violated Hezhou—that is not my failure."
translations.idiomatic: Taozhou vice commander Liu Shiying said: "They violated Hezhou—that is not my failure."

sentences.zh: 由是二將有隙。

translations.literal: From this the two commanders bore a grudge against each other.
translations.idiomatic: From this the two commanders bore a grudge against each other.

sentences.zh: 總督石茂華聞之，令二人及蘭州參將徐勛、岷州守備硃憲、舊洮州守備史經各引兵壓其境，曉以利害。

translations.literal: Grand Coordinator Shi Maohua heard of it and ordered the two men, together with Lanzhou Vice Commander Xu Xun, Minzhou Garrison Commander Zhu Xian, and former Taozhou Garrison Commander Shi Jing, each to lead troops to press their borders and explain the consequences.
translations.idiomatic: Grand coordinator Shi Maohua heard of it and ordered the two men, together with Lanzhou vice commander Xu Xun, Minzhou garrison commander Zhu Xian, and former Taozhou garrison commander Shi Jing, each to lead troops to press their borders and explain the consequences.

sentences.zh: 番人懼，即還所掠人畜。

translations.literal: The Tibetans were afraid and at once returned the people and livestock they had plundered.
translations.idiomatic: The Tibetans were afraid and at once returned the people and livestock they had plundered.

sentences.zh: 世英謂首惡未擒，不可遽已，遂剿破之，殺傷及焚死者無算。

translations.literal: Shiying said the ringleaders had not been captured and the action could not be stopped abruptly; he then attacked and broke them, killing, wounding, and burning countless victims.
translations.idiomatic: Shiying said the ringleaders had not been captured and the action could not be stopped abruptly; he then attacked and broke them, killing, wounding, and burning countless victims.

sentences.zh: 軍律，吹銅角乃退兵。

translations.literal: By military regulations, the trumpet was to be sounded on bronze horns before withdrawing troops.
translations.idiomatic: By military regulations, bronze horns were to be sounded before withdrawing troops.

sentences.zh: 堂挾前憾，不待角聲而去，諸部亦多引去。

translations.literal: Tang, nursing his old grievance, departed without waiting for the horn signal, and many units also withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Tang, nursing his old grievance, departed without waiting for the horn signal, and many units also withdrew.

sentences.zh: 憲、經方深入搜捕，鄰番見其勢孤，圍而殺之。

translations.literal: Zhu and Shi had just advanced deep in pursuit when neighboring Tibetans, seeing their force isolated, surrounded and killed them.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu and Shi had just advanced deep in pursuit when neighboring Tibetans, seeing their force isolated, surrounded and killed them.

sentences.zh: 事聞，帝震怒，褫堂、世英職，切責茂華等。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported, the emperor was furious, stripped Tang and Shiying of their posts, and sternly rebuked Maohua and the others.
translations.idiomatic: When the matter was reported, the emperor was furious, stripped Tang and Shiying of their posts, and sternly rebuked Maohua and the others.

sentences.zh: 茂華乃集諸軍分道進討，斬首百四十餘級，焚死者九百餘人，獲孳畜數十群。

translations.literal: Maohua then assembled the armies and advanced by separate routes; more than 140 heads were taken, more than 900 were killed by fire, and dozens of herds of livestock were captured.
translations.idiomatic: Maohua then assembled the armies and advanced by separate routes; more than 140 heads were taken, more than 900 were killed by fire, and dozens of herds of livestock were captured.

sentences.zh: 諸番震恐遠徙，來降者七十一族，斬送首惡四人，生縛以獻者二人，輸馬牛羊二百六十。

translations.literal: The various Tibetans, terrified, migrated far away; 71 clans came to surrender, four ringleaders were beheaded and sent, two were bound alive and presented, and 260 horses, cattle, and sheep were delivered.
translations.idiomatic: The various Tibetans, terrified, migrated far away; seventy-one clans came to surrender, four ringleaders were beheaded and sent, two were bound alive and presented, and 260 horses, cattle, and sheep were delivered.

sentences.zh: 稽首謝罪，誓不再犯，師乃還。

translations.literal: They prostrated themselves in apology, swore not to offend again, and the army then withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: They prostrated themselves in apology, swore not to offend again, and the army then withdrew.

sentences.zh: 自丙兔據青海，有切盡台吉者，河套酋吉能從子，俺答從孫也，從之而西。

translations.literal: Since Bingtu held Qinghai, there was Qiejin Taiji, a nephew of the Ordos chieftain Jineng and a great-grandson of Altan, who followed him west.
translations.idiomatic: Since Bingtu held Qinghai, there was Qiejin Taiji, a nephew of the Ordos chief Jineng and a great-grandson of Altan, who followed him west.

sentences.zh: 屢掠番人不得志，邀俺答往助。

translations.literal: Having repeatedly raided Tibetans without satisfaction, he invited Altan to come assist.
translations.idiomatic: Having repeatedly raided Tibetans without satisfaction, he invited Altan to come assist.

sentences.zh: 俺答雅欲侵瓦剌，乃假迎活佛名，擁眾西行。

translations.literal: Altan, who had long wished to invade the Oirats, then under the pretense of welcoming the Living Buddha led his followers west.
translations.idiomatic: Altan, who had long wished to invade the Oirats, then under the pretense of welcoming the Living Buddha led his followers west.

sentences.zh: 疏請授丙兔都督，賜金印，且開茶市。

translations.literal: He memorialized requesting that Bingtu be appointed Regional Commander, granted a gold seal, and that tea markets be opened.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized requesting that Bingtu be appointed regional commander, granted a gold seal, and that tea markets be opened.

sentences.zh: 部議不許，但稍給以茶。

translations.literal: The ministry deliberated and did not permit it, but gave a small amount of tea.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry deliberated and did not permit it, but gave a small amount of tea.

sentences.zh: 俺答既抵瓦剌，戰敗而還。

translations.literal: After Altan reached the Oirats, he was defeated in battle and returned.
translations.idiomatic: After Altan reached the Oirats, he was defeated in battle and returned.

sentences.zh: 乃移書甘肅守臣，乞假道赴烏斯藏。

translations.literal: He then sent a letter to the Gansu frontier officials requesting passage to U-Tsang.
translations.idiomatic: He then sent a letter to the Gansu frontier officials requesting passage to U-Tsang.

sentences.zh: 守臣不能拒，遂越甘肅而南，會諸酋於海上。

translations.literal: The frontier officials could not refuse; he thereupon crossed south through Gansu and met the chieftains at the Sea region.
translations.idiomatic: The frontier officials could not refuse; he thereupon crossed south through Gansu and met the chiefs at the Sea region.

sentences.zh: 番人益遭蹂躪，多竄徙。

translations.literal: The Tibetans suffered ever greater ravaging and many fled and migrated.
translations.idiomatic: The Tibetans suffered ever greater ravaging and many fled and migrated.

sentences.zh: 八年春，始以活佛言東還，而切盡弟火落赤及俺答庶兄子永邵卜遂留居青海不去。

translations.literal: In the spring of the eighth year he at last returned east at the Living Buddha's word, but Qiejin's younger brother Huoluo Chi and Altan's elder brother's son Yongshao Bu then remained in Qinghai and did not leave.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of year 8 he at last returned east at the Living Buddha's word, but Qiejin's younger brother Huoluo Chi and Altan's elder brother's son Yongshao Bu then remained in Qinghai and did not leave.

sentences.zh: 八月，丙兔率眾掠番並內地人畜，詔絕其市賞。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Bingtu led his followers to plunder Tibetans and people and livestock of the interior; an edict cut off his market rewards.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Bingtu led his followers to plunder Tibetans and people and livestock of the interior; an edict cut off his market rewards.

sentences.zh: 俺答聞之，馳書切責。

translations.literal: Altan heard of it and sent an urgent letter sternly rebuking him.
translations.idiomatic: Altan heard of it and sent an urgent letter sternly rebuking him.

sentences.zh: 乃盡還所掠，執獻為惡者六人，自罰牛羊七百。

translations.literal: He then returned all that had been plundered, seized and presented six wrongdoers, and imposed upon himself a fine of 700 cattle and sheep.
translations.idiomatic: He then returned all that had been plundered, seized and presented six wrongdoers, and imposed upon himself a fine of 700 cattle and sheep.

sentences.zh: 帝嘉其父恭順，賚之銀幣，即以牛羊賜其部人，為惡者付之自治，仍許貢市，俺答益感德。

translations.literal: The emperor praised the father's respectful submission, bestowed silver and coins, had the cattle and sheep given to his tribesmen, entrusted the wrongdoers to his own governance, and still permitted tribute and markets; Altan was all the more moved by this grace.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised the father's respectful submission, bestowed silver and coins, had the cattle and sheep given to his tribesmen, entrusted the wrongdoers to his own governance, and still permitted tribute and markets; Altan was all the more moved by this grace.

sentences.zh: 而火落赤侵掠番族不休，守臣檄切盡台吉約束之，亦引罪輸服。

translations.literal: But Huoluo Chi continued to raid Tibetan clans without cease; the frontier officials sent dispatches to Qiejin Taiji to restrain him, and he also confessed guilt and submitted compensation.
translations.idiomatic: But Huoluo Chi continued to raid Tibetan clans without cease; the frontier officials sent dispatches to Qiejin Taiji to restrain him, and he also confessed guilt and submitted compensation.

sentences.zh: 及俺答卒，傳至孫扯力克，勢輕，不能制諸酋。

translations.literal: When Altan died, succession passed to his grandson Chelik; his power was weak and he could not control the chieftains.
translations.idiomatic: When Altan died, succession passed to his grandson Chelik; his power was weak and he could not control the chiefs.

sentences.zh: 十六年九月，永邵卜部眾有闌入西寧者，副總兵李奎方被酒，躍馬而前。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the sixteenth year, men of Yongshao Bu's tribe broke into Xining; Vice Regional Commander Li Kui, having been drinking, leaped on his horse and rode forward.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of year 16, men of Yongshao Bu's tribe broke into Xining; vice regional commander Li Kui, having been drinking, leaped on his horse and rode forward.

sentences.zh: 部眾控鞍欲訴，奎拔刀斫之，眾遂射奎死。

translations.literal: The tribesmen held the saddle and wished to plead their case; Kui drew his blade and hacked at them, whereupon the crowd shot and killed Kui.
translations.idiomatic: The tribesmen held the saddle and wished to plead their case; Kui drew his blade and hacked at them, whereupon the crowd shot and killed Kui.

sentences.zh: 部卒馳救之，亦多死。

translations.literal: Soldiers of his unit galloped to rescue him, and many of them also died.
translations.idiomatic: Soldiers of his unit galloped to rescue him, and many of them also died.

sentences.zh: 守臣不能討，遣使詰責，但獻首惡，還人畜而止。

translations.literal: The frontier officials could not punish them; they sent envoys to rebuke them, but only the ringleaders were presented, people and livestock returned, and the matter ended there.
translations.idiomatic: The frontier officials could not punish them; they sent envoys to rebuke them, but only the ringleaders were presented, people and livestock returned, and the matter ended there.

sentences.zh: 以故無所憚，愈肆侵盜。

translations.literal: For this reason they had nothing to fear and plundered all the more wantonly.
translations.idiomatic: For this reason they had nothing to fear and plundered all the more wantonly.

sentences.zh: 時丙兔及切盡台吉亦皆死，丙兔子真相移駐莽剌川，火落赤移駐捏工川，逼近西寧，日蠶食番族。

translations.literal: At that time Bingtu and Qiejin Taiji also both died. Bingtu's son Zhenxiang moved his camp to the Mangla River, Huoluochi moved his camp to the Niegong River, pressing close to Xining and day by day nibbling away at the Fan peoples.
translations.idiomatic: By then Bingtu and Qiejin Taiji had both died. Bingtu's son Zhenxiang shifted his encampment to the Mangla River and Huoluochi to the Niegong River, drawing near Xining and day by day encroaching upon the Tibetan tribes.

sentences.zh: 番不能支，則折而為寇用。

translations.literal: The Fan could not hold out, and so turned to serve the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Unable to hold their ground, the tribes turned and put themselves at the bandits' service.

sentences.zh: 扯力克又西行助之，勢益熾。

translations.literal: Chilik again went west to aid them, and their power grew ever fiercer.
translations.idiomatic: Chilik marched west once more to reinforce them, and their strength burned hotter still.

sentences.zh: 十八年六月入舊洮州，副總兵李聯芳率三千人御之，盡覆。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the eighteenth year they entered Old Taozhou. Vice Regional Commander Li Lianfang led three thousand men to oppose them and was utterly destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the eighteenth year they entered Old Taozhou. Vice Regional Commander Li Lianfang marched out with three thousand men to meet them and was wiped out to the last man.

sentences.zh: 七月復深入，大掠河州、臨洮、渭源。

translations.literal: In the seventh month they again penetrated deeply and plundered Hezhou, Lintao, and Weiyuan on a great scale.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month they drove deep once more and ravaged Hezhou, Lintao, and Weiyuan.

sentences.zh: 總兵官劉承嗣與游擊孟孝臣各將一軍御之，皆敗績，游擊李芳等死焉，西陲大震。

translations.literal: Regional Commander Liu Chengsi and Mobile Corps Commander Meng Xiaochen each led an army to oppose them, and both were defeated. Mobile Corps Commander Li Fang and others died in the fighting, and the western frontier was greatly shaken.
translations.idiomatic: Regional Commander Liu Chengsi and Mobile Corps Commander Meng Xiaochen each took an army against them and both were routed; Mobile Corps Commander Li Fang and others fell in battle, and the whole western frontier reeled.

sentences.zh: 事聞，命尚書鄭洛出經略。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported, Minister Zheng Luo was ordered out as frontier commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: When word reached the court, Minister Zheng Luo was dispatched to take charge of frontier affairs.

sentences.zh: 洛前督宣大軍，撫順義王及忠順夫人有恩。

translations.literal: Luo had formerly commanded the Xuanda army and had shown kindness in pacifying the Prince of Shunyi and Lady Zhongshun.
translations.idiomatic: Luo had once commanded the Xuanda forces and had earned the gratitude of the Prince of Shunyi and Lady Zhongshun through his conciliatory rule.

sentences.zh: 遣使趣扯力克東歸，而大布招番之令，來者率善遇之，自是歸附者不絕。

translations.literal: He sent envoys to urge Chilik to return east, and broadly issued orders to recruit the Fan peoples. Those who came were generally treated well, and from then on those who submitted did not cease.
translations.idiomatic: He sent envoys urging Chilik to turn east again, and proclaimed broad orders inviting the tribes to submit; arrivals were treated generously, and from that time the stream of those coming over never dried up.

sentences.zh: 火、真二酋自知罪重，又聞套酋卜失兔來助，大敗於水泉口，扯力克復將還巢，始懼。

translations.literal: The two chieftains Huo and Zhen, knowing their guilt was grave, also heard that the Tao chieftain Bushitu was coming to aid them, and suffered a great defeat at Shuiquankou. Chilik was again about to return to his lair, and only then did they become afraid.
translations.idiomatic: The chieftains Huo and Zhen, knowing how heavy their crimes were, heard that Tao chieftain Bushitu was marching to their aid and then suffered a crushing defeat at Shuiquankou; when Chilik prepared to withdraw to his base, fear finally took hold of them.

sentences.zh: 徙帳去，留其黨可卜兔等於莽剌川。

translations.literal: They moved their camps away, leaving their followers Kebutu and others at the Mangla River.
translations.idiomatic: They shifted their camps and withdrew, leaving followers such as Kebutu behind on the Mangla River.

sentences.zh: 明年，總兵官尤繼先破走之。

translations.literal: The next year Regional Commander You Jixian routed and drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: The following year Regional Commander You Jixian defeated them and put them to flight.

sentences.zh: 洛更進兵青海，焚仰華寺，逐其餘眾而還。

translations.literal: Luo advanced further into Qinghai, burned Yanghua Temple, drove off the remaining host, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Luo pressed on into Qinghai, burned Yanghua Temple, scattered the remnant forces, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 番人復業者至八萬餘人，西陲暫獲休息。

translations.literal: Fan people who resumed their livelihoods reached more than eighty thousand, and the western frontier briefly obtained rest.
translations.idiomatic: More than eighty thousand tribespeople returned to their fields, and the western frontier enjoyed a brief respite.

sentences.zh: 已，復聚於青海。

translations.literal: Before long they gathered again at Qinghai.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the raiders had massed at Qinghai once again.

sentences.zh: 二十三年增設臨洮總兵官，以劉綎任之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year a Lintao regional commander was additionally established, and Liu Ting was appointed to the post.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year the court added a regional commander at Lintao and appointed Liu Ting to the office.

sentences.zh: 未幾，永邵卜諸部犯南川，參將達雲大破之。

translations.literal: Before long the Yong Shaobu tribes violated Nanchuan, and Garrison Commander Da Yun inflicted a great defeat upon them.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward the Yong Shaobu clans raided Nanchuan, and Garrison Commander Da Yun routed them decisively.

sentences.zh: 已，連火、真二酋犯西川，雲又擊破之。

translations.literal: Before long the chieftains Huo and Zhen together violated Xichuan, and Yun again struck and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Not long after, the chieftains Huo and Zhen joined forces to raid Xichuan, and Da Yun defeated them again.

sentences.zh: 明年，諸酋復掠番族，將窺內地。

translations.literal: The next year the chieftains again plundered the Fan peoples and were about to spy out the interior.
translations.idiomatic: The following year the chieftains again preyed upon the tribes and seemed poised to probe the inner provinces.

sentences.zh: 綎部將周國柱御之莽剌川，又大破之。
