translations.literal: Liu Ting's subordinate commander Zhou Guozhu opposed them at the Mangla River and again inflicted a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Ting's lieutenant Zhou Guozhu met them on the Mangla River and routed them once more.

sentences.zh: 二十七年糾叛苗犯洮、岷，總兵官蕭如薰等敗之，斬番人二百五十餘級，寇八十二級，撫降番族五千餘人。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year rebellious Miao were mustered to violate Tao and Min. Regional Commander Xiao Ruxun and others defeated them, beheading more than two hundred fifty Fan and eighty-two bandits, and pacifying and accepting the surrender of more than five thousand Fan people.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year rebel Miao allies struck at Tao and Min. Regional Commander Xiao Ruxun and his officers defeated them, taking more than two hundred fifty tribal heads and eighty-two bandit heads, and winning over more than five thousand tribespeople by persuasion.

sentences.zh: 三十四年復入鎮番黑古城，為總兵官柴國柱所敗。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year they again entered Zhenfan Heigucheng and were defeated by Regional Commander Chai Guozhu.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fourth year they entered Zhenfan Heigucheng once more and were beaten back by Regional Commander Chai Guozhu.

sentences.zh: 自是屢入鈔掠，不能大得志。

translations.literal: From then on they repeatedly entered to raid and plunder, but could not greatly achieve their aims.
translations.idiomatic: After that they raided again and again but never won any great success.

sentences.zh: 時為陝西患者，有三大寇：一河套，一松山，一青海。

translations.literal: At that time the troubles afflicting Shaanxi came from three great bandit centers: one in Hetao, one at Songshan, and one in Qinghai.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Shaanxi suffered under three great raiding centers: Hetao, Songshan, and Qinghai.

sentences.zh: 青海土最沃，且有番人屏蔽，故患猶不甚劇。

translations.literal: The soil of Qinghai was the most fertile, and moreover the Fan peoples served as a screen, so the trouble was still not very severe.
translations.idiomatic: Qinghai had the richest land and the tribes still formed a buffer, so the trouble there remained less acute.

sentences.zh: 崇禎十一年，李自成屢為官軍擊敗，自洮州軼出番地。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Chongzhen, Li Zicheng was repeatedly defeated by government troops and slipped out from Taozhou into Fan territory.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year of Chongzhen, Li Zicheng, beaten again and again by imperial forces, broke out of Taozhou and fled into tribal lands.

sentences.zh: 諸將窮追，復奔入塞內，番族亦遭蹂躪。

translations.literal: The generals pursued to the limit, and he again fled back inside the frontier passes. The Fan peoples also suffered trampling and ravage.
translations.idiomatic: The generals pressed the pursuit until he doubled back inside the passes, and the tribes were trampled underfoot in the chase.

sentences.zh: 十五年，西寧番族作亂，總抹官馬爌督諸將五道進剿，斬首七百有奇，撫降三十八族而還。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year the Xining Fan peoples rose in rebellion. The zongmo official Ma Huang supervised five columns of generals in a punitive advance, beheaded more than seven hundred, pacified and accepted the surrender of thirty-eight tribes, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year the Xining tribes rebelled. The zongmo official Ma Huang led five columns of generals against them, took more than seven hundred heads, brought thirty-eight clans to submission, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 明年冬，李自成遣將陷甘州，獨西寧不下。

translations.literal: The next winter Li Zicheng sent a general who captured Ganzhou, but Xining alone did not fall.
translations.idiomatic: The following winter Li Zicheng's lieutenant took Ganzhou, but Xining alone held out.

sentences.zh: 賊將辛恩忠攻破之，遂進掠青海。

translations.literal: The rebel general Xin Enzhong stormed and captured it, then advanced to plunder Qinghai.
translations.idiomatic: The rebel commander Xin Enzhong broke the city and marched on to ravage Qinghai.

sentences.zh: 諸酋多降附，而明室亦亡。

translations.literal: Many chieftains submitted, and the Ming house also perished.
translations.idiomatic: Many chieftains came over to the rebels, and with them the Ming dynasty fell.

sentences.zh: 番有生熟二種。

translations.literal: Among the Fan there were two kinds, raw and cooked.
translations.idiomatic: The tribes fell into two categories, the raw and the cooked.

sentences.zh: 生番獷悍難制。

translations.literal: The raw Fan were fierce and stubborn and hard to control.
translations.idiomatic: The raw tribes were wild, fierce, and difficult to govern.

sentences.zh: 熟番納馬中茶，頗柔服，後浸通生番為內地患。

translations.literal: The cooked Fan presented horses in exchange for tea and were quite tractable, but later gradually mingled with the raw Fan and became a trouble to the interior.
translations.idiomatic: The cooked tribes traded horses for tea and were generally compliant, but in time they grew entangled with the raw tribes and became a threat to the inner provinces.

sentences.zh: 自青海為寇所據，番不堪剽奪，私饋皮幣曰手信，歲時加饋曰添巴，或反為嚮導，交通無忌。

translations.literal: Once Qinghai was occupied by bandits, the Fan could not endure the plunder and robbery. They privately presented hides and goods called shouxin, and added gifts at the seasons called tianba, or in turn served as guides, communicating and trafficking without restraint.
translations.idiomatic: Once bandits held Qinghai, the tribes could no longer bear the looting. They secretly sent furs and goods as personal tokens, added seasonal gifts called tianba, and sometimes even acted as guides, trading and passing messages without fear.

sentences.zh: 而中國市馬亦鮮至，蓋已失捍外衛內之初意矣。

translations.literal: And horses for the Chinese markets also rarely arrived, for the original intent of defending the exterior and guarding the interior had already been lost.
translations.idiomatic: Horses for the Chinese markets scarcely came anymore; the original design of holding the outer frontier to shield the inner realm had already been abandoned.

sentences.zh: 原夫太祖甫定關中，即法漢武創河西四郡隔絕羌、胡之意，建重鎮於甘肅，以北拒蒙古，南捍諸番，俾不得相合。

translations.literal: Originally, when the Taizu had just settled the Guanzhong region, he followed Emperor Wu of Han's idea in creating the four commanderies west of the Yellow River to separate the Qiang and the Hu. He established a great stronghold in Gansu to repel the Mongols in the north and hold back the various Fan in the south, so that they could not join together.
translations.idiomatic: When the Taizu had only just secured Guanzhong, he took Emperor Wu of Han's precedent of founding the four commanderies west of the river to keep Qiang and Hu apart, and built a great bastion in Gansu to block the Mongols in the north and the tribes in the south so they could never unite.

sentences.zh: 又遣西寧等西衛土官與漢官參治，令之世守。

translations.literal: He also dispatched native officials of Xining and the other western guards to administer jointly with Han officials, ordering them to guard their posts in hereditary succession.
translations.idiomatic: He also posted native officers of Xining and the other western guards to govern alongside Han officials, charging them to hold their posts from generation to generation.

sentences.zh: 且多置茶課司，番人得以馬易茶。

translations.literal: Moreover he widely established tea tax offices so that the Fan could exchange horses for tea.
translations.idiomatic: He further set up numerous tea tax offices so the tribes could trade horses for tea.

sentences.zh: 而部族之長，亦許其歲時朝貢，自通名號於天子。

translations.literal: The chiefs of the tribes were also permitted to come with tribute at the seasons and to communicate their titles directly with the Son of Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Tribal chiefs were allowed to present tribute at the proper seasons and to address the throne in their own names.

sentences.zh: 彼勢既分，又動於利，不敢為惡。

translations.literal: Their power being already divided, and moved moreover by profit, they did not dare do evil.
translations.idiomatic: With their strength divided and their interests tied to trade, they did not dare turn to violence.

sentences.zh: 即小有蠢動，邊將以偏師制之，靡不應時底定。

translations.literal: Even if there were small stirrings of trouble, frontier generals restrained them with detached forces, and none failed to be settled at once.
translations.idiomatic: Even minor disturbances were quelled at once by frontier generals with detached columns.

sentences.zh: 自邊臣失防，北寇得越境闌入，與番族交通，西陲遂多事。

translations.literal: Once frontier officials lost their defenses, northern bandits were able to cross the border and force entry, communicate with the Fan peoples, and the western frontier then had many troubles.
translations.idiomatic: When frontier officials let their guard slip, northern raiders crossed the border at will, made contact with the tribes, and the western marches were never quiet again.

sentences.zh: 然究其時之所患，終在寇而不在番，故議者以太祖制馭為善。

translations.literal: Yet examining the troubles of that time, the root lay ultimately in the bandits and not in the Fan, so commentators regarded the Taizu's system of control as good.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the real affliction of the age lay with the raiders, not the tribes themselves, and commentators held that the Taizu's policy of control had been the wiser course.

sentences.zh: 安定衛

translations.literal: Anding Guard
translations.idiomatic: Anding Guard

sentences.zh: 安定衛，距甘州西南一千五百里。

translations.literal: Anding Guard lay one thousand five hundred li southwest of Ganzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Anding Guard stood one thousand five hundred li southwest of Ganzhou.

sentences.zh: 漢為婼羌，唐為吐蕃地，元封宗室卜煙帖木兒為寧王鎮之。

translations.literal: Under the Han it was Ruoqiang; under the Tang it was Tibetan territory. Under the Yuan the imperial clansman Buyan Temür was enfeoffed as Prince of Ning to guard it.
translations.idiomatic: In Han times it had been Ruoqiang; in Tang times it was Tibetan land. The Yuan enfeoffed the imperial clansman Buyan Temür as Prince of Ning to hold the region.

sentences.zh: 其地本名撒里畏兀兒，廣袤千里，東近罕東，北邇沙州，南接西番。

translations.literal: The place was originally called Sarig Uyghur. It was a thousand li in breadth and length. To the east it neared Handong; to the north it bordered Shazhou; to the south it adjoined the Western Fan.
translations.idiomatic: The region was originally known as Sarig Uyghur, a thousand li across. Handong lay to the east, Shazhou to the north, and the Western tribes to the south.

sentences.zh: 居無城郭，以氈帳為廬舍。

translations.literal: The people had no walled cities and used felt tents as dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: They had no walled towns and lived in felt tents.

sentences.zh: 產多駝馬牛羊。

translations.literal: Its products were abundant in camels, horses, cattle, and sheep.
translations.idiomatic: Camels, horses, cattle, and sheep were plentiful there.

sentences.zh: 洪武三年遣使持詔招諭。

translations.literal: In the third year of Hongwu an envoy was sent bearing an edict to summon and instruct them.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Hongwu the court sent an envoy with an edict summoning them to allegiance.

sentences.zh: 七年六月，卜煙帖木兒使其府尉麻答兒等來朝，貢鎧甲刀劍諸物。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the seventh year Buyan Temür sent his palace guard Madar and others to court, presenting armor, swords, and other objects as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the seventh year Buyan Temür sent his palace guard Madar and others to court with tribute of armor, blades, and other goods.

sentences.zh: 太祖喜，宴賚其使者，遣官厚賚其王，而分其地為阿端、阿真、苦先、貼里四部，各錫以印。

translations.literal: The Taizu was pleased, feasted and rewarded their envoys, sent officials with rich gifts for their prince, and divided their land into four divisions—Adun, Azhen, Kuxian, and Tieli—each granted a seal.
translations.idiomatic: The Taizu was delighted, entertained and rewarded the envoys, sent officials with rich gifts for their prince, and divided the territory into four divisions—Adun, Azhen, Kuxian, and Tieli—each invested with a seal.

sentences.zh: 明年正月，其王遣傅卜顏不花來貢，上元所授金、銀字牌，請置安定、阿端二衛，從之。

translations.literal: In the first month of the next year their prince sent Fubuyanbuhua to present tribute, returning the gold and silver tally-plaques granted by the Yuan, and requesting the establishment of the Anding and Adun guards. The request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the following year their prince sent Fubuyanbuhua to court with tribute, surrendering the gold and silver tally-plaques given under the Yuan, and asking that the Anding and Adun guards be established. The court agreed.

sentences.zh: 乃封卜煙帖木兒為安定王，以其部人沙刺等為指揮。

translations.literal: Buyan Temür was then enfeoffed as Prince of Anding, and men of his tribe such as Shala were made commanders.
translations.idiomatic: Buyan Temür was enfeoffed as Prince of Anding, and tribesmen such as Shala were appointed commanders.

sentences.zh: 九年命前廣東參政鄭九成等使其地，賚王及其部人衣幣。

translations.literal: In the ninth year the former Guangdong Administrative Vice Commissioner Zheng Jiucheng and others were ordered to their territory to bestow robes and gifts upon the prince and his tribesmen.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year the former Guangdong Administrative Vice Commissioner Zheng Jiucheng and others were sent to their lands to present robes and gifts to the prince and his people.

sentences.zh: 明年，王為沙剌所弒，王子板咱失里復仇，誅沙剌。

translations.literal: The next year the prince was assassinated by Shala. The prince's son Banzhanshili took revenge and executed Shala.
translations.idiomatic: The following year Shala assassinated the prince. The prince's son Banzhanshili avenged him and put Shala to death.

sentences.zh: 沙剌部將復殺王子，部內大亂。

translations.literal: Shala's subordinate commanders again killed the prince, and great disorder broke out within the tribe.
translations.idiomatic: Shala's lieutenants then killed the prince as well, and the tribe fell into chaos.

sentences.zh: 番將朵兒只巴叛走沙漠，經安定，大肆殺掠，奪其印去，其眾益衰。

translations.literal: The Fan general Duoirzhiba rebelled and fled into the desert. Passing through Anding, he slaughtered and plundered on a great scale, seized their seal, and departed. Their host grew ever weaker.
translations.idiomatic: The tribal general Duoirzhiba rebelled and fled into the desert. On his way through Anding he ravaged the land, seized their seal, and departed, leaving the tribe ever more diminished.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，藍玉西征，徇阿真川。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year Lan Yu marched west on campaign and advanced along the Azhen River.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year Lan Yu led a western campaign and swept along the Azhen River.

sentences.zh: 土酋司徒哈昝等懼，逃匿山谷不敢出。

translations.literal: The native chieftains Situhazan and others were afraid, fled and hid in the valleys, and did not dare come out.
translations.idiomatic: The native chieftains Situhazan and others, terrified, hid in the mountain valleys and dared not show themselves.

sentences.zh: 及肅王之國甘州，遣僧謁王，乞授官以安部眾。

translations.literal: When the Prince of Su established his fief at Ganzhou, they sent monks to pay respects to the prince and begged that offices be granted to settle their tribesmen.
translations.idiomatic: When the Prince of Su took up his fief at Ganzhou, they sent monks to petition him, begging for official appointments to reassure their people.

sentences.zh: 王為奏請，帝許之。

translations.literal: The prince memorialized on their behalf, and the emperor granted it.
translations.idiomatic: The prince submitted a memorial on their behalf, and the emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 二十九年命行人陳誠至其地，復立安定衛。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year the courier Chen Cheng was ordered to their territory and Anding Guard was re-established.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year the court dispatched the courier Chen Cheng to their lands and restored Anding Guard.

sentences.zh: 其酋長哈孩虎都魯等五十八人悉授指揮、千百戶等官。

translations.literal: Fifty-eight of their chieftains, including Hahai Hudulu, were all granted posts as commanders, chiliarchs, centurions, and the like.
translations.idiomatic: Fifty-eight of their chiefs, including Hahai Hudulu, were all appointed commanders, chiliarchs, centurions, and other officers.

sentences.zh: 誠還，酋長隨之入朝，貢馬謝恩。

translations.literal: When Cheng returned, the chieftains followed him to court and presented horses in gratitude.
translations.idiomatic: When Cheng returned, the chiefs accompanied him to court and presented horses in thanks.

sentences.zh: 帝厚賚之，覆命中官齎銀幣往賜。

translations.literal: The emperor richly rewarded them and again ordered a eunuch to carry silver and gifts to bestow upon them.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor rewarded them generously and again sent a eunuch with silver and gifts.

sentences.zh: 初，安定王之被殺也，其子撒兒只失加為其兄所殺，部眾潰散，子亦攀丹流寓靈藏。

translations.literal: Earlier, when the Prince of Anding was killed, his son Saierzhishijia was slain by his elder brother. The tribesmen scattered in defeat, and Zi Yipandan wandered in exile at Lingzang.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when the Prince of Anding was murdered, his son Saierzhishijia was killed by his elder brother. The tribe broke apart, and Zi Yipandan took refuge at Lingzang.

sentences.zh: 十一年五月率眾入朝，自陳家難，乞授職。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the eleventh year he led his followers to court, stated his family's calamities himself, and begged to be granted an office.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the eleventh year he led his followers to court, recounted his family's tragedy, and asked for an appointment.

sentences.zh: 帝念其祖率先歸附，令襲封安定王，賜印誥。

translations.literal: The emperor, mindful that his ancestor had been the first to submit, ordered him to inherit the enfeoffment as Prince of Anding and granted him a seal and patent of appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Remembering that his ancestor had been among the first to submit, the emperor allowed him to inherit the title Prince of Anding and granted him a seal and patent.

sentences.zh: 自是朝貢不輟。

translations.literal: From then on tribute missions did not cease.
translations.idiomatic: From that time tribute missions never stopped.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，中官喬來喜、鄧誠使烏斯藏，次畢力術江黃羊川。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year the eunuchs Qiao Laixi and Deng Cheng were sent as envoys to U-Tsang and halted at Huangyangchuan on the Bilishu River.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year the eunuchs Qiao Laixi and Deng Cheng were dispatched to U-Tsang and camped at Huangyangchuan on the Bilishu River.

sentences.zh: 安定指揮哈三孫散哥及曲先指揮散即思等率眾邀劫之，殺朝使，盡奪駝馬幣物而去。

translations.literal: Anding Commander Hasan Sun Sange and Quxian Commander Sanjisi and others led their followers to waylay and rob them, killed the court envoys, seized all the camels, horses, and goods, and departed.
translations.idiomatic: Anding Commander Hasan Sun Sange, Quxian Commander Sanjisi, and others led their men in an ambush, murdered the imperial envoys, seized all the camels, horses, and goods, and fled.

sentences.zh: 仁宗大怒，敕都指揮李英偕康壽等討之。

translations.literal: The Renzong was greatly enraged and ordered Chief Commander Li Ying, together with Kang Shou and others, to punish them.
translations.idiomatic: The Renzong was furious and ordered Chief Commander Li Ying, together with Kang Shou and others, to chastise them.

sentences.zh: 英等率西寧諸衛軍及隆奔國師賈失兒監藏等十二番族之眾，深入追賊，賊遠遁。

translations.literal: Ying and the others led the armies of the Xining guards and the forces of twelve Fan tribes, including the Longben State Preceptor Jiashier Jiancang, in a deep pursuit of the bandits, and the bandits fled far away.
translations.idiomatic: Li Ying and his officers led the Xining garrisons and the warriors of twelve tribes, including the Longben State Preceptor Jiashier Jiancang, in pursuit deep into the frontier until the raiders fled beyond reach.

sentences.zh: 英等逾崑崙山西行數百里，抵雅令闊之地，遇安定賊，擊敗之，斬首四百八十餘級，生擒七十餘人，獲駝馬牛十四萬有奇。

translations.literal: Ying and the others crossed west of the Kunlun Mountains for several hundred li and reached the land of Yalingkuo, where they encountered the Anding bandits, struck and defeated them, beheaded more than four hundred eighty, captured more than seventy alive, and obtained more than one hundred forty thousand camels, horses, and cattle.
translations.idiomatic: Li Ying and his men marched several hundred li west of the Kunlun Mountains to Yalingkuo, met the Anding raiders, and routed them, taking more than four hundred eighty heads, more than seventy prisoners, and more than one hundred forty thousand camels, horses, and cattle.

sentences.zh: 曲先聞風遠竄，追之不及而還。

translations.literal: Quxian, hearing the news, fled far away. They pursued but could not overtake them and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Quxian, hearing of the defeat, fled into the distance. The pursuers could not catch them and turned back.

sentences.zh: 英以此封會寧伯，壽等皆進秩。

translations.literal: For this Ying was enfeoffed as Marquis of Huining, and Shou and the others were all promoted in rank.
translations.idiomatic: For this feat Li Ying was enfeoffed as Marquis of Huining, and Kang Shou and the others were all promoted.

sentences.zh: 大軍既旋，指揮哈三等懼罪，不敢還故地。

translations.literal: Once the great army had returned, Commander Hasan and the others, fearing punishment, did not dare return to their former lands.
translations.idiomatic: After the army withdrew, Commander Hasan and his fellows, fearing punishment, dared not return home.

sentences.zh: 初，大軍之討賊也，安定指揮桑哥與罕東衛軍同奉調從征。

translations.literal: Earlier, when the great army was punishing the bandits, Anding Commander Sangge and the troops of Handong Guard were both mobilized by order to follow the campaign.
translations.idiomatic: When the army marched against the raiders, Anding Commander Sangge and the Handong garrison had both been called up for the campaign.

sentences.zh: 罕東違令不至，其所轄板納族瞰桑哥軍遠出，盡掠其部內廬帳畜產。

translations.literal: Handong disobeyed the order and did not come. The Bana tribe under its jurisdiction, seeing that Sangge's army had gone far away, plundered all the dwellings, tents, and livestock within his tribe.
translations.idiomatic: Handong defied the order and never came. The Bana tribe under its command, seeing Sangge's forces far from home, stripped his lands of every tent and herd.

sentences.zh: 事聞，降敕切責，令速歸所掠，違命則發兵進討。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported, an edict was issued sternly rebuking them and ordering the swift return of what had been plundered. Disobedience would bring troops to advance in punishment.
translations.idiomatic: When word reached the court, an edict sharply rebuked them and ordered the stolen goods returned at once, on pain of a punitive expedition.

sentences.zh: 已，進桑哥都指揮僉事。

translations.literal: Before long Sangge was promoted to Associate Chief Commander.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward Sangge was promoted to Associate Chief Commander.

sentences.zh: 弘治三年，領占幹些兒卒，子千奔襲。

translations.literal: In the third year of Hongzhi Lingzhanganxie'er died, and his son Qianben succeeded him.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Hongzhi Lingzhanganxie'er died, and his son Qianben inherited the post.

sentences.zh: 賜齋糧、麻布，諭祭其父。

translations.literal: Vegetarian provisions and hemp cloth were granted, and he was instructed to perform sacrifices for his father.
translations.idiomatic: The court granted mourning provisions and hemp cloth and instructed him to offer sacrifices for his father.

sentences.zh: 先是，哈密忠順王卒，無子。

translations.literal: Earlier the Prince of Zhongshun of Hami had died without a son.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the Prince of Zhongshun of Hami had died leaving no heir.

sentences.zh: 廷議安定王與之同祖，遣官擇一人為其後，安定王不許。

translations.literal: The court debated that the Prince of Anding shared the same ancestry with him, and dispatched officials to choose one man as his successor. The Prince of Anding would not agree.
translations.idiomatic: The court noted that the Prince of Anding shared the same lineage and sent officials to choose a successor, but the Prince of Anding refused.

sentences.zh: 至是，訪求陝巴於安定，冊為忠順王，命千奔遣送其家屬。

translations.literal: At this time Shanba was sought out in Anding, enregistered as Prince of Zhongshun, and Qianben was ordered to escort his family members there.
translations.idiomatic: At this point Shanba was found in Anding, invested as Prince of Zhongshun, and Qianben was ordered to escort his family to Hami.

sentences.zh: 千奔怒曰：「陝巴不應嗣王爵，爵應歸綽爾加。」

translations.literal: Qianben angrily said: "Shanba ought not inherit the princely rank; the rank ought to go to Chuo'erjia."
translations.idiomatic: Qianben angrily protested: "Shanba has no right to the princedom; the title belongs to Chuo'erjia."

sentences.zh: 綽爾加者，千奔弟也。

translations.literal: Chuo'erjia was Qianben's younger brother.
translations.idiomatic: Chuo'erjia was Qianben's younger brother.

sentences.zh: 且邀厚賞。

translations.literal: He also demanded generous rewards.
translations.idiomatic: He also demanded lavish rewards.

sentences.zh: 兵部言：「陝巴實忠順王之孫，素為國人所服。

translations.literal: The Ministry of War stated: "Shanba is in fact the grandson of the Prince of Zhongshun and has long been respected by the people of the state.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of War replied: "Shanba is in truth the grandson of the Prince of Zhongshun and has long commanded the people's respect.

sentences.zh: 前哈密無主，遣使取應立者，綽爾加自知力弱不肯往。

translations.literal: Formerly, when Hami had no ruler, envoys were sent to fetch the one who should be established. Chuo'erjia, knowing his own strength was weak, refused to go.
translations.idiomatic: When Hami had no ruler, the court sent envoys to bring back the rightful heir, but Chuo'erjia, knowing himself too weak, refused to go.

sentences.zh: 今事定之後，乃爾反覆，所言不可從。」

translations.literal: Now that the matter is settled, he turns about in this way. What he says cannot be followed."
translations.idiomatic: Now that the matter is settled, he reverses himself; his claims cannot be accepted."

sentences.zh: 陝巴迄得立。

translations.literal: Shanba was established in the end.
translations.idiomatic: Shanba was duly established.

sentences.zh: 然千奔以立非己意，後哈密數被寇，竟不應援。

translations.literal: Yet because the establishment was not according to Qianben's wish, when Hami was repeatedly attacked by bandits afterward, he ultimately did not send aid.
translations.idiomatic: But because the succession had gone against Qianben's wishes, when Hami was raided again and again he never sent help.

sentences.zh: 十七年率眾侵沙州，大掠而去。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he led his followers to invade Shazhou and departed after great plunder.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year he led his men against Shazhou, looted heavily, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 正德時，蒙古大酋亦不剌、阿爾禿廝侵據青海，縱掠鄰境。

translations.literal: In the Zhengde era the great Mongol chieftains Yibulai and Aertusi invaded and occupied Qinghai and freely plundered neighboring territories.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Zhengde emperor the great Mongol chiefs Yibulai and Aertusi seized Qinghai and raided the neighboring regions at will.

sentences.zh: 安定遂殘破，部眾散亡。

translations.literal: Anding was then ruined and broken, and its tribesmen scattered and perished.
translations.idiomatic: Anding was left in ruins, and its people scattered.

sentences.zh: 阿端衛

translations.literal: Adun Guard
translations.idiomatic: Adun Guard

sentences.zh: 阿端衛，在撒里畏兀兒之地，洪武八年置。

translations.literal: The Adun Guard was located in the land of Sarig Uyghur and was established in the eighth year of Hongwu.
translations.idiomatic: Adun Guard lay in Sarig Uyghur country; it was established in Hongwu year 8.

sentences.zh: 後為朵兒只巴殘破，其衛遂廢。

translations.literal: Later it was ravaged by Duoirzhiba, and the guard was thereupon abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Later Duoirzhiba ravaged the region, and the guard was abolished.

sentences.zh: 永樂四年冬，酋長小薛忽魯札等來朝，貢方物，請復置衛設官，從之，即授小薛等為指揮僉事。

translations.literal: In the winter of the fourth year of Yongle, the chieftains Xiaoxue Huluzha and others came to court, presented local products as tribute, and requested the re-establishment of the guard and appointment of officials. Their request was granted, and Xiaoxue and the others were at once appointed assistant commanders.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of Yongle year 4, the chiefs Xiaoxue Huluzha and others came to court with regional tribute and asked that the guard be restored and officials appointed. The court agreed and made Xiaoxue and his companions assistant commanders.

sentences.zh: 洪熙時，曲先酋散即思邀劫朝使，脅阿端指揮鎖魯丹偕行。

translations.literal: In the Hongxi reign, the Quxian chieftain Sanjisi waylaid and robbed an imperial envoy and coerced the Adun commander Suoludan to go along with him.
translations.idiomatic: During the Hongxi reign, Sanjisi, chieftain of Quxian, ambushed an imperial envoy and forced Suoludan, commander of Adun, to accompany him.

sentences.zh: 已，大軍出征，鎖魯丹懼，率部眾遠竄，失其印。

translations.literal: Soon afterward the great army marched out on campaign. Suoludan was afraid, led his tribesmen in flight to distant regions, and lost his seal.
translations.idiomatic: When the imperial army marched out, Suoludan fled far away with his people in fear, losing his seal in the process.

sentences.zh: 宣德初遣使招撫，鎖魯丹猶不敢歸，依曲先雜處。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Xuande, envoys were sent to summon and reassure him, but Suoludan still did not dare return and lived intermingled with Quxian.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Xuande reign the court sent envoys to win him back, but Suoludan still dared not return and settled in mixed company with Quxian.

sentences.zh: 六年春，西寧都督史昭言：「曲先衛真只罕等本別一部，因其父助散即思為逆，竄處畢力術江。

translations.literal: In the spring of the sixth year, the Xining Regional Commander Shi Zhao said: "Zhenzhihan and others of Quxian Guard originally formed a separate division. Because their father aided Sanjisi in rebellion, they fled and dwelt at the Bilitu River.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the sixth year, Shi Zhao, regional commander at Xining, reported: "Zhenzhihan and others of Quxian Guard were originally a separate band. Their father had aided Sanjisi in rebellion, and they fled to the Bilitu River.

sentences.zh: 其地當烏斯藏孔道，恐復為亂，宜討之。」

translations.literal: Their land lies on the main road to U-Tsang; I fear they will again stir up trouble. They should be attacked."
translations.idiomatic: Their territory stands on the main route to U-Tsang, and I fear they may rebel again. They ought to be brought to heel."

sentences.zh: 帝敕昭曰：「殘寇窮迫，無地自容，宜遣人宥其罪，命復故業。」

translations.literal: The emperor instructed Zhao: "These remnant bandits are driven to desperation and have nowhere to turn. You should send men to pardon their crimes and order them to resume their former occupations."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor replied to Zhao: "These broken rebels are at their wits' end with nowhere to go. Send men to pardon them and let them return to their old lands."

sentences.zh: 於是真只罕率所部還居帖兒谷舊地。

translations.literal: Thereupon Zhenzhihan led his followers back to dwell in their old lands at Tie'ergu.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenzhihan then led his people back to their former home at Tie'ergu.

sentences.zh: 明年正月入朝，天子喜，授指揮同知，令掌衛事，以指揮僉事卜答兀副之。

translations.literal: In the first month of the next year he came to court. The Son of Heaven was pleased, appointed him vice commander, and ordered him to administer guard affairs, with the assistant commander Buda'er as his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: The following first month he came to court. The emperor was pleased, made him vice commander and put him in charge of the guard, with assistant commander Buda'er as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 真只罕因言：「阿端故城在回回境，去帖兒谷尚一月程，朝貢艱，乞移本土為便。」

translations.literal: Zhenzhihan then said: "The old city of Adun lies in Muslim territory, still a month's journey from Tie'ergu. Tribute to court is difficult. I beg to move back to our native land for convenience."
translations.idiomatic: Zhenzhihan then said: "The old Adun city lies in Muslim country, a full month's journey from Tie'ergu, making tribute journeys arduous. I ask permission to return to our native lands."

sentences.zh: 天子從其請，仍給以印，賜璽書撫慰之。

translations.literal: The Son of Heaven granted his request, again gave him a seal, and bestowed an imperial letter of reassurance to comfort him.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor granted the request, issued a new seal, and sent an imperial letter of reassurance.

sentences.zh: 迄正統朝，數入貢，後不知所終。

translations.literal: Down to the Zhengtong reign they repeatedly came to present tribute; afterward their fate is unknown.
translations.idiomatic: Through the Zhengtong reign they came to court with tribute several times; after that their fate is unknown.

sentences.zh: 其時西域地亦有名阿端者，貢道從哈密入，與此為兩地云。

translations.literal: At that time there was also a place in the Western Regions called Adun, whose tribute route entered through Hami. It is said that these were two separate places.
translations.idiomatic: There was also an Adun in the Western Regions at that time, whose tribute route ran through Hami—a different place altogether, it is said.

sentences.zh: 曲先衛

translations.literal: Quxian Guard
translations.idiomatic: Quxian Guard

sentences.zh: 曲先衛，東接安定，在肅州西南。

translations.literal: Quxian Guard bordered Anding on the east and lay southwest of Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Quxian Guard bordered Anding to the east and lay southwest of Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 古西戎，漢西羌，唐吐蕃，元設曲先答林元帥府。

translations.literal: In antiquity it was Western Rong; under Han, Western Qiang; under Tang, Tibet; under Yuan the Quxian Dalin Marshal's Office was established.
translations.idiomatic: In ancient times it was Western Rong country; under Han it was Western Qiang; under Tang, Tibetan; under the Yuan a Quxian Dalin Marshal's Office was set up.

sentences.zh: 洪武時，酋長入貢。

translations.literal: In the Hongwu reign, chieftains came to present tribute.
translations.idiomatic: During Hongwu, tribal chiefs came to court with tribute.

sentences.zh: 命設曲先衛，官其人為指揮。

translations.literal: Quxian Guard was ordered established, and its people were made commanders.
translations.idiomatic: The court established Quxian Guard and appointed its chiefs as commanders.

sentences.zh: 後遭朵兒只巴之亂，部眾竄亡，併入安定衛，居阿真之地。

translations.literal: Later, during the turmoil of Duoirzhiba, the tribesmen fled and scattered. They were merged into Anding Guard and dwelt in the land of Azhen.
translations.idiomatic: Later, during Duoirzhiba's upheaval, the people fled and were absorbed into Anding Guard, settling in Azhen country.

sentences.zh: 永樂四年，安定指揮哈三、散即思、三即等奏：「安定、曲先本二衛，後合為一。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Yongle, the Anding commanders Hasan, Sanjisi, Sanji, and others memorialized: "Anding and Quxian were originally two guards, but later were merged into one.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongle year 4, the Anding commanders Hasan, Sanjisi, Sanji, and others memorialized: "Anding and Quxian were once two guards but had later been merged into one.

sentences.zh: 比遭吐番把禿侵擾，不獲寧居。

translations.literal: Recently we have suffered raids and harassment from the Tibetan Batu and cannot live in peace.
translations.idiomatic: Lately the Tibetan Batu has been raiding us, and we cannot live in peace.

sentences.zh: 乞仍分為二，復先朝舊制。」

translations.literal: We beg that they again be divided into two and the former court's old system restored."
translations.idiomatic: We ask that they be split in two again and the old arrangement restored."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The court agreed.

sentences.zh: 即令三即為指揮使，掌衛事，散即思副之。

translations.literal: Sanji was at once made commander-in-chief to administer guard affairs, with Sanjisi as his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: Sanji was appointed commander-in-chief and put in charge of the guard, with Sanjisi as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 又從其請，徙治藥王淮之地。

translations.literal: Their request was again granted, and the seat of government was moved to the land of Yaowang Huai.
translations.idiomatic: The court also granted their request to move the seat to Yaowang Huai.

sentences.zh: 自是屢入貢。

translations.literal: From this time they repeatedly came to present tribute.
translations.idiomatic: From then on they came to court with tribute again and again.

sentences.zh: 洪熙時，散即思偕安定部酋劫殺朝使。

translations.literal: In the Hongxi reign, Sanjisi together with Anding tribal chiefs robbed and killed an imperial envoy.
translations.idiomatic: During Hongxi, Sanjisi and Anding chiefs ambushed and killed an imperial envoy.

sentences.zh: 已，大軍往討，散即思率眾遠遁，不敢還故土。

translations.literal: Soon afterward the great army marched to punish them. Sanjisi led his followers in flight to distant regions and did not dare return to his native land.
translations.idiomatic: When the imperial army marched against them, Sanjisi fled far away with his people and dared not return home.

sentences.zh: 宣德初，天子赦其罪，遣都指揮陳通等往招撫，復業者四萬二千餘帳。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Xuande, the Son of Heaven pardoned their crimes and sent Regional Commander Chen Tong and others to summon and reassure them. More than forty-two thousand households resumed their occupations.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Xuande the emperor pardoned them and sent Regional Commander Chen Tong and others to win them back. More than 42,000 households returned to their lands.

sentences.zh: 乃遣指揮失刺罕等入朝謝罪，貢駝馬，待之如初。

translations.literal: They then sent the commander Shilahai and others to court to beg forgiveness, presenting camels and horses as tribute. They were treated as before.
translations.idiomatic: They sent commander Shilahai and others to court to plead guilty, offering camels and horses; the court treated them as before.

sentences.zh: 尋擢散即思都指揮同知，其僚屬悉進官，給以誥命。

translations.literal: Soon Sanjisi was promoted to regional vice commander; all his subordinates were advanced in rank and granted patent letters of appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Sanjisi was soon promoted to regional vice commander; his officers were all advanced in rank and given patent commissions.

sentences.zh: 五年六月，朝使自西域還，言散即思數率部眾邀劫往來貢使，梗塞道途。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the fifth year, an imperial envoy returning from the Western Regions reported that Sanjisi had repeatedly led his tribesmen to waylay envoys bearing tribute passing to and fro, blocking the roads.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the fifth year, an envoy returning from the Western Regions reported that Sanjisi had repeatedly waylaid tribute missions, choking the routes.

sentences.zh: 天子怒，命都督史昭為大將，率左右參將趙安、王彧及中官王安、王瑾，督西寧諸衛軍及安定、罕東之眾往征之。

translations.literal: The Son of Heaven was angered and ordered Regional Commander Shi Zhao as grand general, leading the left and right adjutant generals Zhao An and Wang Yu and the eunuchs Wang An and Wang Jin, to supervise the armies of the various Xining guards and the hosts of Anding and Handong in an expedition against them.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was furious and named Regional Commander Shi Zhao grand general, with adjutant generals Zhao An and Wang Yu and the eunuchs Wang An and Wang Jin, to lead the Xining guards and the forces of Anding and Handong against them.

sentences.zh: 昭等兵至其地，散即思先遁，其黨脫脫不花等迎敵。

translations.literal: When Zhao and the others' troops reached their territory, Sanjisi fled first. His followers Toto-Buqa and others met the enemy in battle.
translations.idiomatic: When Shi Zhao's army arrived, Sanjisi had already fled; his followers Toto-Buqa and others met the troops in battle.

sentences.zh: 諸將縱兵擊之，殺傷甚眾，生擒脫脫不花及男婦三百四十餘人，獲駝馬牛羊三十四萬有奇。

translations.literal: The generals unleashed their troops to attack them, killing and wounding a great many. Toto-Buqa and more than three hundred forty men and women were captured alive. More than three hundred forty thousand camels, horses, cattle, and sheep were taken.
translations.idiomatic: The generals pressed the attack, killing and wounding many. Toto-Buqa and more than 340 men and women were taken alive, along with well over 340,000 camels, horses, cattle, and sheep.

sentences.zh: 自是西番震慴。

translations.literal: From this the Western tribes were awed and shaken.
translations.idiomatic: After this the western tribes were thoroughly cowed.

sentences.zh: 散即思素狡悍，天子宥其罪，仍怙惡不悛。

translations.literal: Sanjisi had always been cunning and fierce. The Son of Heaven pardoned his crimes, yet he still clung to evil and would not repent.
translations.idiomatic: Sanjisi had always been cunning and fierce. Though the emperor pardoned him, he remained unrepentant.

sentences.zh: 至是人畜多損失，乃悔懼。

translations.literal: At this time his people and livestock suffered heavy losses, and he then felt remorse and fear.
translations.idiomatic: Now that his people and herds had suffered heavy losses, he felt remorse and fear.

sentences.zh: 明年四月遣其弟副千戶堅都等四人貢馬請罪。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the next year he sent his younger brother, Vice Centurion Jiandu, and three others to present horses and beg forgiveness.
translations.idiomatic: The next fourth month he sent his brother, Vice Centurion Jiandu, and three others with horses to plead guilty.

sentences.zh: 復待之如初，令還居故地並歸其俘。

translations.literal: They were again treated as before. He was ordered to return and dwell in his former lands, and his captives were also returned to him.
translations.idiomatic: The court treated them as before, ordered them back to their old lands, and returned their captives.

sentences.zh: 七年，其指揮那那罕言：「往者安定之兵從討曲先，臣二女、四弟及指揮桑哥等家屬被掠者五百人。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, their commander Nanahan said: "In the past, when Anding's troops joined the campaign against Quxian, my two daughters, four younger brothers, and the families of the commander Sange and others—five hundred people in all—were seized.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year their commander Nanahan said: "When Anding's troops joined the campaign against Quxian, my two daughters, four brothers, and the families of commander Sange and others—500 people in all—were carried off.

sentences.zh: 今散即思已蒙赦宥，而臣等親屬猶未還，望聖明垂憐。」

translations.literal: Now Sanjisi has already received pardon, yet my kinsmen still have not been returned. I hope Your Sagacious Majesty will show compassion."
translations.idiomatic: Sanjisi has been pardoned, yet our kin have not been returned. I beg Your Majesty's mercy."

sentences.zh: 天子得奏惻然，語大臣曰：「朕常以用兵為戒，正恐濫及無辜。

translations.literal: When the Son of Heaven received the memorial he was deeply moved and told his ministers: "I have always taken military action as a warning, precisely because I fear it will sweep up the innocent.
translations.idiomatic: Moved by the memorial, the emperor told his ministers: "I have always been wary of resorting to arms, precisely for fear of harming the innocent.

sentences.zh: 彼不自言，何由知之。」

translations.literal: If they do not speak of it themselves, how could I know?"
translations.idiomatic: If they had not spoken up, how would I ever have known?"

sentences.zh: 即敕安定王亦攀丹等悉歸所掠。

translations.literal: He at once instructed the Prince of Anding Yipandan and others to return everything they had seized.
translations.idiomatic: He immediately ordered the Prince of Anding Yipandan and the others to return all they had taken.

sentences.zh: 其年，散即思卒，命其子都立嗣職，賜敕勉之。

translations.literal: That year Sanjisi died. His son Duli was ordered to succeed to his post, and an edict of encouragement was bestowed upon him.
translations.idiomatic: That year Sanjisi died. His son Duli succeeded to his post and received an encouraging edict from the throne.

sentences.zh: 十年擢那那罕都指揮僉事，其僚屬進職者八十九人。

translations.literal: In the tenth year Nanahan was promoted to regional assistant commander; eighty-nine of his subordinates were advanced in rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year Nanahan was promoted to regional assistant commander, and eighty-nine of his officers were also advanced.

sentences.zh: 正統七年遣使貢玉石。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Zhengtong, envoys were sent to present jade and stone as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengtong year 7 they sent envoys with jade tribute.

sentences.zh: 成化時，土魯番強，被其侵掠。

translations.literal: In the Chenghua reign, Turfan grew strong and they suffered its raids.
translations.idiomatic: During Chenghua, Turfan grew powerful and raided them repeatedly.

sentences.zh: 弘治中，安定王子陝巴居曲先。

translations.literal: In the middle of Hongzhi, the Prince of Anding's son Shanba dwelt at Quxian.
translations.idiomatic: In the Hongzhi reign, Shanba, son of the Prince of Anding, held Quxian.

sentences.zh: 廷議哈密無主，迎為忠順王。

translations.literal: The court deliberated that Hami had no ruler and welcomed him as the Prince of Loyalty and Obedience.
translations.idiomatic: The court, finding Hami without a ruler, welcomed him as Prince of Loyalty and Obedience.

sentences.zh: 正德七年，蒙古酋阿爾禿廝亦不剌竄居青海，曲先為所蹂躪，部族竄徙，其衛遂亡。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Zhengde, the Mongol chieftain Altan Yibulai fled and settled in Qinghai. Quxian was trampled by him; the tribes fled and migrated, and the guard perished.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengde year 7 the Mongol chieftain Altan Yibulai fled into Qinghai, overran Quxian, and scattered its tribes until the guard was lost.

sentences.zh: 明初設安定、阿端、曲先、罕東、赤斤、沙州諸衛，給之金牌，令歲以馬易茶，謂之差發。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Ming, the Anding, Adun, Quxian, Handong, Chijin, and Shazhou guards were established. Gold tally-plaques were given them, and they were ordered each year to trade horses for tea—this was called differential dispatch.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the dynasty the court established the Anding, Adun, Quxian, Handong, Chijin, and Shazhou guards, issued gold tally-plaques, and required annual horse-for-tea exchange—the system known as differential dispatch.

sentences.zh: 沙州、赤斤隸肅州，餘悉隸西寧。

translations.literal: Shazhou and Chijin were subordinated to Suzhou; all the rest were subordinated to Xining.
translations.idiomatic: Shazhou and Chijin fell under Suzhou; all the others under Xining.

sentences.zh: 時甘州西南盡皆番族，受邊臣羈絡，惟北面防寇。

translations.literal: At that time southwest of Ganzhou was entirely tribal peoples. They were kept in hand by frontier officials and served only to guard against invaders from the north.
translations.idiomatic: At that time all country southwest of Ganzhou was tribal land, held in check by frontier officials and used chiefly to shield the north from raiders.

sentences.zh: 後諸衛盡亡，亦不剌據青海，土魯番復據哈密，逼處關外。

translations.literal: Later all the guards perished. Yibulai seized Qinghai, and Turfan again seized Hami, pressing close upon the lands beyond the passes.
translations.idiomatic: Later the guards were all lost, Yibulai seized Qinghai, Turfan reoccupied Hami, and the frontier pressed hard upon the outer passes.

sentences.zh: 諸衛遷徙之眾又環列甘肅肘腋，獷悍難馴。

translations.literal: The displaced peoples of the various guards also ranged in a ring around Gansu's flanks, fierce and hard to tame.
translations.idiomatic: The displaced peoples of the fallen guards also clustered around Gansu's flanks, fierce and unruly.

sentences.zh: 於是河西外防大寇，內防諸番，兵事日亟。

translations.literal: Thus in the Hexi region they had to guard against great enemies without and the various tribes within, and military affairs grew daily more urgent.
translations.idiomatic: The Hexi corridor now had to face great enemies without and unruly tribes within, and military pressures mounted by the day.

sentences.zh: 赤斤蒙古衛

translations.literal: Chijin Mongol Guard
translations.idiomatic: Chijin Mongol Guard

sentences.zh: 赤斤蒙古衛。

translations.literal: Chijin Mongol Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Chijin Mongol Guard.

sentences.zh: 出嘉峪關西行二十里曰大草灘，又三十里曰黑山兒，又七十里曰回回墓，墓西四十里曰騸馬城，並設墩台，置暸卒。

translations.literal: Westward from Jiayu Pass twenty li is called Great Grass Marsh; another thirty li is Black Hill; another seventy li is the Muslim Tomb; forty li west of the tomb is Gelding Horse Fort. Beacon towers were all established and lookout sentries posted.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty li west of Jiayu Pass lay Great Grass Marsh; thirty li farther on, Black Hill; seventy li beyond that, Muslim Tomb; and forty li west of the tomb, Gelding Horse Fort. Beacon towers were built and lookouts posted all along the route.

sentences.zh: 城西八十里即赤斤蒙古。

translations.literal: Eighty li west of the city is Chijin Mongol territory.
translations.idiomatic: Eighty li west of the city lay Chijin Mongol country.

sentences.zh: 漢燉煌郡地，晉屬晉昌郡，唐屬瓜州，元如之，屬沙州路。

translations.literal: In Han it was Dunhuang commandery; under Jin it belonged to Jinchang commandery; under Tang to Guazhou; under Yuan likewise, subordinated to Shazhou Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In Han times it was Dunhuang commandery; under Jin, Jinchang commandery; under Tang, Guazhou; under the Yuan, likewise, part of Shazhou Circuit.

sentences.zh: 洪武十三年，都督濮英西討，次白城，獲蒙古平章忽都帖木兒。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Hongwu, Regional Commander Pu Ying marched west on punitive campaign. He halted at White City and captured the Mongol Grand Counselor Qutu Temür.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu year 13, Regional Commander Pu Ying marched west, halted at White City, and captured the Mongol Grand Counselor Qutu Temür.

sentences.zh: 進至赤斤站，獲豳王亦憐真及其部曲千四百人，金印一。

translations.literal: Advancing to Chijin Station, he captured Prince of Bin Yilie Zhen and more than fourteen hundred of his followers, as well as one gold seal.
translations.idiomatic: Pressing on to Chijin Station, he captured Prince Yilie Zhen of Bin, more than 1,400 of his followers, and a gold seal.

sentences.zh: 師還，復為蒙古部人所據。

translations.literal: When the army returned, the territory was again seized by Mongol tribesmen.
translations.idiomatic: After the army withdrew, Mongol tribesmen reoccupied the land.

sentences.zh: 永樂二年九月，有塔力尼者，自稱丞相苦術子。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the second year of Yongle, there was one Talini, who called himself son of the chancellor Kujiu.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of Yongle year 2, a man named Talini declared himself son of Chancellor Kujiu.

sentences.zh: 率所部男婦五百餘人，自哈剌脫之地來歸。

translations.literal: Leading more than five hundred men and women of his tribe, he came from the land of Halatu to submit.
translations.idiomatic: He led more than 500 men and women from Halatu to submit.

sentences.zh: 詔設赤斤蒙古所，以塔力尼為千戶，賜誥印、彩幣、襲衣。

translations.literal: An edict established the Chijin Mongol Office, appointing Talini chiliarch, and bestowed patent, seal, colored silks, and court robes.
translations.idiomatic: The court established the Chijin Mongol Office, made Talini chiliarch, and granted him a patent, seal, brocades, and court robes.

sentences.zh: 八年，回回哈剌馬牙叛於肅州，約塔力尼為援。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, the Muslim Halamaya rebelled at Suzhou and invited Talini as ally.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year the Muslim Halamaya rebelled at Suzhou and tried to enlist Talini's aid.

sentences.zh: 拒不應，而率部下擒賊六人以獻。

translations.literal: He refused and would not respond, but instead led his subordinates to capture six bandits and present them.
translations.idiomatic: Talini refused, then captured six of the rebels and sent them to court.

sentences.zh: 天子聞之喜，詔改千戶所為衛，擢塔力尼指揮僉事，其部下授官者三人。

translations.literal: The Son of Heaven was pleased to hear it and ordered the chiliarch's office changed to a guard, promoting Talini to assistant commander. Three of his subordinates were granted office.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was pleased and elevated the chiliarch's office to a guard, promoting Talini to assistant commander; three of his subordinates were also given appointments.

sentences.zh: 明年遣使貢馬。

translations.literal: The next year envoys were sent to present horses as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: The following year they sent envoys with horses as tribute.

sentences.zh: 又明年以匿叛賊老的罕，將討之。

translations.literal: The year after that, because he had harbored the rebel Laodehan, troops were about to be sent to punish him.
translations.idiomatic: The year after, because he had sheltered the rebel Laodehan, the court prepared to march against him.

sentences.zh: 用侍講楊榮言，止兵勿進，而賜敕詰責，塔力尼即擒老的罕來獻。

translations.literal: Following the advice of Reader-in-Waiting Yang Rong, the army was halted and not advanced, but an edict of rebuke was bestowed. Talini at once captured Laodehan and presented him.
translations.idiomatic: On Reader-in-Waiting Yang Rong's advice the court halted the troops and sent a rebuking edict instead; Talini promptly captured Laodehan and sent him to court.

sentences.zh: 天子嘉之，進秩指揮同知，賜賚甚厚。

translations.literal: The Son of Heaven commended him, promoted his rank to vice commander, and bestowed rewards very generously.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised him, promoted him to vice commander, and rewarded him lavishly.

sentences.zh: 久之卒，子且旺失加襲，修貢如制，進指揮使。

translations.literal: After a long time he died. His son Qiewangshijia succeeded, maintained tribute according to regulation, and was promoted to commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: He died after many years. His son Qiewangshijia succeeded him, kept up tribute as required, and was promoted to commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 宣德二年再進都指揮同知，其僚屬亦多進秩。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xuande he was again promoted to regional vice commander, and many of his subordinates were also advanced in rank.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuande year 2 he was promoted again to regional vice commander, and many of his officers were advanced as well.

sentences.zh: 正統元年，其部下指揮可兒即掠西域阿端貢物，殺使臣二十一人。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhengtong, his subordinate commander Ke'erji plundered the tribute goods of Adun in the Western Regions and killed twenty-one envoys.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengtong year 1 his subordinate commander Ke'erji plundered Adun tribute from the Western Regions and killed twenty-one envoys.

sentences.zh: 賜敕切責，令還所掠。

translations.literal: An edict of stern rebuke was bestowed, ordering the return of what had been plundered.
translations.idiomatic: The court sent a stern rebuke and ordered the stolen goods returned.

sentences.zh: 尋與蒙古脫歡帖木兒、猛哥不花戰，勝之，使來獻捷，進都指揮使。

translations.literal: Soon he fought with the Mongols Toghun Temür and Mengke Bukhua and defeated them. Envoys came to present news of victory, and he was promoted to regional commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he defeated the Mongols Toghun Temür and Mengke Bukhua, sent envoys with news of victory, and was promoted to regional commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 五年，朝使往來哈密者，且旺失加具餱糧、騾馬護送，擢都督僉事。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, for imperial envoys traveling to and from Hami, Qiewangshijia supplied rations and provided mules and horses as escort. He was promoted to Regional Commander Assistant.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year Qiewangshijia supplied provisions and mule escorts for envoys traveling to Hami and was promoted to assistant regional commander.

sentences.zh: 明年，天子聞其部下時往沙州寇掠，或冒沙州名，邀劫西域貢使，遣敕切責。

translations.literal: The next year the Son of Heaven heard that his subordinates often went to Shazhou to raid and plunder, or used Shazhou's name falsely to waylay envoys bearing tribute from the Western Regions, and sent an edict of stern rebuke.
translations.idiomatic: The next year the emperor learned that his men were raiding Shazhou or impersonating Shazhou forces to waylay Western tribute missions, and sent a sharp rebuke.

sentences.zh: 時瓦剌兵強，數侵掠鄰境。

translations.literal: At that time Oirat forces were strong and repeatedly raided neighboring territories.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the Oirats were strong and raided their neighbors repeatedly.

sentences.zh: 且旺失加懼，欲徙居肅州。

translations.literal: Qiewangshijia was afraid and wished to move and dwell at Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Qiewangshijia, alarmed, sought to move his people to Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 天子聞而諭止之，令有警馳報邊將。

translations.literal: When the Son of Heaven heard of it he instructed him to stop and ordered that at any alarm he should swiftly report to the frontier generals.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor heard of it and forbade the move, ordering him to report any alarm to the frontier generals at once.

sentences.zh: 八年，瓦剌酋也先遣使送馬及酒，欲娶且旺失加女為子婦，娶沙州困即來女為弟婦。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, the Oirat chieftain Esen sent envoys bearing horses and wine, wishing to marry Qiewangshijia's daughter as his son's wife and marry the Shazhou chief Kunjilai's daughter as his younger brother's wife.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year the Oirat chieftain Esen sent horses and wine, seeking Qiewangshijia's daughter for his son and the Shazhou chief Kunjilai's daughter for his brother.

sentences.zh: 二人不欲，並奏遵奉朝命，不敢擅婚。

translations.literal: The two men did not wish it and both memorialized that they obeyed the court's command and dared not marry on their own authority.
translations.idiomatic: Both men refused and memorialized that they served the court and dared not arrange marriages on their own.

sentences.zh: 天子以瓦剌方強，其禮意不可卻，諭令各從其願，並以此意諭也先，而二人終不欲。

translations.literal: The Son of Heaven, considering that the Oirats were then strong and their courtesy could not be refused, instructed that each follow his own wish and also conveyed this meaning to Esen. Yet the two men ultimately still did not wish it.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, mindful that the Oirats were strong and the overture could not lightly be rebuffed, told each man to follow his own wish and conveyed as much to Esen—but both still refused.

sentences.zh: 明年，且旺失加稱老不治事。

translations.literal: The next year Qiewangshijia said he was old and could no longer administer affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The next year Qiewangshijia pleaded old age and incapacity.

sentences.zh: 詔授其子阿速都督僉事，代之。

translations.literal: An edict appointed his son Asu Regional Commander Assistant to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: The court appointed his son Asu assistant regional commander in his stead.

sentences.zh: 也先復遣使求婚，且請親人往受其幣物。

translations.literal: Esen again sent envoys to propose marriage and also requested that a kinsman come in person to receive his betrothal gifts.
translations.idiomatic: Esen sent envoys again to propose marriage and asked that a kinsman come in person to accept the betrothal gifts.

sentences.zh: 阿速虞其詐，拒不從，而遣人乞徙善地。

translations.literal: Asu suspected deception, refused and would not comply, and sent men begging to move to better land.
translations.idiomatic: Asu suspected a trap, refused, and sent a petition asking to be moved to safer ground.

sentences.zh: 天子諭以土地不可棄，令獎率頭目圖自強。

translations.literal: The Son of Heaven instructed him that the land could not be abandoned and ordered him to encourage and lead his chieftains in seeking self-strengthening.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor told him the land must not be abandoned and urged him to rally his chiefs and strengthen themselves.

sentences.zh: 又以其飢困，令邊臣給之粟，所以撫恤者甚至。

translations.literal: Also, because they were hungry and destitute, frontier officials were ordered to give them grain. The measures taken to comfort and succor them were very extensive.
translations.idiomatic: Because they were starving, the court ordered frontier officials to supply grain—the measures taken to comfort them were generous indeed.

sentences.zh: 先是，苦術娶西番女，生塔力尼；

translations.literal: Earlier, Kujiu had married a Western Tibetan woman and begot Talini;
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Kujiu had married a Western Tibetan woman and fathered Talini;

sentences.zh: 又娶蒙古女，生都指揮瑣合者、革古者二人。

translations.literal: He also married a Mongol woman and begot two sons, the regional commanders Suohezhe and Geguzhe.
translations.idiomatic: He also married a Mongol woman and fathered two sons, the regional commanders Suohezhe and Geguzhe.

sentences.zh: 各分所部為三，凡西番人居左帳，屬塔力尼，蒙古人居右帳，屬瑣合者，而自領中帳。

translations.literal: Each divided his followers into three. All Western Tibetans dwelt in the left encampment and belonged to Talini; Mongols dwelt in the right encampment and belonged to Suohezhe; and he himself led the central encampment.
translations.idiomatic: Each divided his following into three camps: Western Tibetans in the left wing under Talini, Mongols in the right under Suohezhe, while Kujiu himself led the center.

sentences.zh: 後苦術卒，諸子來歸，並授官。

translations.literal: Later Kujiu died; his sons came to submit, and all were granted office.
translations.idiomatic: Later Kujiu died. His sons came to submit, and all were given appointments.

sentences.zh: 至是阿速勢盛，欲兼併右帳，屢相仇殺。

translations.literal: By this time Asu had grown powerful and wished to annex the right encampment; they repeatedly fought and killed one another.
translations.idiomatic: By then Asu had grown strong and sought to swallow the right wing; the two sides feuded and killed one another again and again.

sentences.zh: 瑣合者不能支，醖於邊將，欲以所部內屬。

translations.literal: Suohezhe could not hold out. He consulted the frontier general and wished to submit his following to inner allegiance.
translations.idiomatic: Suohezhe could not hold his ground. He appealed to the frontier general and asked to bring his people under Ming rule.

sentences.zh: 邊將任禮遣赴京，請發兵收其部落。

translations.literal: The frontier general Ren Li sent him to the capital and requested that troops be dispatched to take over his tribe.
translations.idiomatic: Frontier general Ren Li sent him to court and asked that troops be sent to take possession of his tribe.

sentences.zh: 帝慮其部人不願內徙，仍遣瑣合者還甘肅，而令禮往取其孥。

translations.literal: The emperor, fearing his tribesmen were unwilling to migrate inward, still sent Suohezhe back to Gansu and ordered Ren Li to go and fetch his wives and children.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, fearing the tribesmen would not accept inward migration, sent Suohezhe back to Gansu anyway and ordered Ren Li to fetch his family.

sentences.zh: 十三年，邊將護哈密使臣至苦峪。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, frontier officers escorted Hami envoys to Kuyu.
translations.idiomatic: In year 13 frontier officers escorted Hami envoys as far as Kuyu.

sentences.zh: 赤斤都指揮總兒加陸等率眾圍其城，聲言報怨。

translations.literal: Chijin Regional Commander Zonger Jialu and others led troops to besiege the city, declaring they came to settle a grievance.
translations.idiomatic: Chijin regional commander Zonger Jialu and others led a force to besiege the city, claiming they had come to settle a score.

sentences.zh: 官軍出擊之，獲總兒加陸，已而逃去。

translations.literal: Government troops sallied out against them and captured Zonger Jialu, but he soon escaped.
translations.idiomatic: Government troops sallied out, captured Zonger Jialu, but he soon broke free.

sentences.zh: 事聞，敕責阿速，令縛獻犯者。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported, an edict reproached Asu and ordered him to bind and present the offenders.
translations.idiomatic: When word reached court, an edict rebuked Asu and ordered him to bind and hand over the culprits.

sentences.zh: 景泰二年，也先復遣使持書求婚。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jingtai, Esen again sent envoys bearing a letter to propose marriage.
translations.idiomatic: In Jingtai year 2 Esen again sent envoys with a letter proposing marriage.

sentences.zh: 會阿速他往，其僚屬以其書來上。

translations.literal: As it happened Asu was away elsewhere; his staff submitted the letter to the court.
translations.idiomatic: Asu happened to be away; his staff brought the letter to court.

sentences.zh: 兵部尚書于謙言：「赤斤諸衛久為我籓籬，也先無故招降結親，意在撤我屏蔽。

translations.literal: Minister of War Yu Qian said: "The Chijin guards have long served as our outer bulwark. Esen is for no reason seeking to win them over and forge marriage ties—his aim is to strip away our shield.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of War Yu Qian said: "The Chijin guards have long been our outer bulwark. Esen is wooing them and seeking marriage ties without cause—his aim is to peel away our shield.

sentences.zh: 宜令邊臣整兵慎防，並敕阿速悉力捍禦，有警馳報，發兵應援。」

translations.literal: Frontier officials should be ordered to ready troops and guard carefully, and Asu should be instructed to defend with all his strength; when alarm arises, report at once and dispatch troops in support."
translations.idiomatic: Frontier officials should ready troops and guard carefully, and Asu should be ordered to defend with all his strength; at the first alarm he must report at once so troops can be sent to his aid."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The proposal was adopted.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 五年，也先益圖兼併，遣使齎印授阿速，脅令臣服。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, Esen further plotted annexation; he sent envoys bearing a seal to invest Asu and compelled him to submit.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year Esen pressed harder for annexation, sent envoys with a seal to invest Asu, and tried to force his submission.

sentences.zh: 阿速不從，報之邊臣。

translations.literal: Asu refused and reported it to frontier officials.
translations.idiomatic: Asu refused and reported the matter to the frontier officials.

sentences.zh: 會也先被殺，獲已。

translations.literal: Soon after Esen was killed, and the danger was over.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Esen was killed, and the threat passed.

sentences.zh: 九年，土魯番陷哈密，遣使三人，以書招都督僉事昆藏同叛。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, Turfan seized Hami and sent three envoys with a letter inviting Assistant Regional Commander Kun Zang to rebel together.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year Turfan took Hami and sent three envoys with a letter urging assistant regional commander Kun Zang to rebel with them.

sentences.zh: 昆藏不從，殺其使，以其書來獻。

translations.literal: Kun Zang refused, killed the envoys, and submitted the letter to the court.
translations.idiomatic: Kun Zang refused, killed the envoys, and sent the letter to court.

sentences.zh: 天子嘉之，遣使賜賚，且令發兵攻討。

translations.literal: The Son of Heaven commended him, sent envoys with rewards, and ordered troops dispatched to attack and punish.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised him, sent envoys with rewards, and ordered troops to march against Turfan.

sentences.zh: 昆藏以力不足，請發官軍數千為助。

translations.literal: Kun Zang, citing insufficient strength, requested several thousand government troops as aid.
translations.idiomatic: Kun Zang, saying his forces were too few, asked for several thousand government troops to help.

sentences.zh: 朝議委都督李文等計度。

translations.literal: The court deliberated and entrusted Regional Commander Li Wen and others to plan the campaign.
translations.idiomatic: The court put regional commander Li Wen and others in charge of planning the campaign.

sentences.zh: 已，文等進征，昆藏果以兵來會。

translations.literal: Before long Li Wen and the others advanced on campaign, and Kun Zang indeed came with troops to join them.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Li Wen marched out, and Kun Zang did come with troops to join him.

sentences.zh: 會文等頓軍不進，其兵亦還。

translations.literal: But Li Wen and the others halted the army and did not advance, and Kun Zang's troops also returned.
translations.idiomatic: But Li Wen halted and would not advance, and Kun Zang's men withdrew as well.

sentences.zh: 十年，賞卜塔兒以千騎入肅州境，將與阿年族番人仇殺。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, Shangbotar entered Suzhou territory with a thousand horsemen, intending to feud with the Anian tribesmen.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year Shangbotar crossed into Suzhou with a thousand horsemen, intending to settle a blood feud with the Anian tribesmen.

sentences.zh: 邊臣既諭卻之，兵部請遣人責以大義，有仇則赴訴邊吏，不得擅相侵掠，從之。

translations.literal: Frontier officials had already admonished and sent them back. The Ministry of War requested that someone be sent to rebuke them on grounds of right conduct: if they had grievances they should appeal to frontier officials and must not raid one another at will. This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Frontier officials had already admonished them and turned them back. The Ministry of War asked that a messenger be sent to rebuke them in the name of right conduct: grievances must be taken to frontier officials, not settled by private raids. The court agreed.

sentences.zh: 十四年，其部人言賞卜塔兒幼不更事，指揮僉事加定得眾心，乞遷一秩，俾總衛事。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, his tribesmen said Shangbotar was young and inexperienced, while Assistant Commander Jia Ding had won the people's hearts; they begged he be promoted one rank to oversee guard affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year his tribesmen said Shangbotar was young and untested, while assistant commander Jia Ding had won the people's hearts; they asked that Jia Ding be raised one rank to head guard affairs.

sentences.zh: 賞卜塔兒亦署名推讓。

translations.literal: Shangbotar also signed his name in recommendation and yielded the post.
translations.idiomatic: Shangbotar signed as well, recommending Jia Ding and yielding the post.

sentences.zh: 而罕東酋長復合詞奏舉，且雲兩衛番人，待此以靖。

translations.literal: Handong chiefs jointly submitted the same recommendation, adding that the tribesmen of both guards awaited this to secure peace.
translations.idiomatic: Handong chiefs submitted a joint petition as well, saying the tribesmen of both guards looked to this appointment for peace.

sentences.zh: 帝納其言，擢加定都指揮僉事，暫掌印務。

translations.literal: The emperor accepted their words, promoted Jia Ding to Assistant Regional Commander, and put him temporarily in charge of the seal.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor accepted their plea, promoted Jia Ding to assistant regional commander, and put him temporarily in charge of the seal.

sentences.zh: 時土魯番猶據哈密。

translations.literal: At that time Turfan still held Hami.
translations.idiomatic: Turfan still held Hami.

sentences.zh: 哈密都督罕慎結赤斤為援，復其城，有詔褒賞。

translations.literal: Hami Regional Commander Han Shen allied with Chijin as support, recovered the city, and received an edict of commendation and reward.
translations.idiomatic: Hami regional commander Han Shen joined forces with Chijin, retook the city, and received an edict of praise and reward.

sentences.zh: 十九年，鄰番野乜克力來侵，大肆殺掠，赤斤遂殘破。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year, the neighboring tribe Yeme Keli invaded and carried out extensive slaughter and plunder; Chijin was thus devastated.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year the neighboring tribe Yeme Keli invaded, killing and plundering on a wide scale, and Chijin was left in ruins.

sentences.zh: 其酋長訴於邊臣，給之栗。

translations.literal: Its chiefs complained to frontier officials, who gave them grain.
translations.idiomatic: Its chiefs appealed to frontier officials, who supplied them with grain.

sentences.zh: 又命繕治其城，令流移者復業，赤斤自是不振。

translations.literal: They were also ordered to repair the city and let those who had fled return to their livelihoods; from then on Chijin never recovered its strength.
translations.idiomatic: The court also ordered the city repaired and the displaced brought back to their livelihoods, but Chijin never regained its strength.

sentences.zh: 然弘治中，阿木郎破哈密，猶用其兵。

translations.literal: Yet in the Hongzhi reign, when A Manlang broke Hami, their troops were still employed.
translations.idiomatic: Yet during Hongzhi, when A Manlang took Hami, their troops were still used.

sentences.zh: 後許進西征，亦以兵來助。

translations.literal: Later, when Xu Jin marched west, they also came with troops to assist.
translations.idiomatic: Later, when Xu Jin marched west, they sent troops to help as well.

sentences.zh: 正德八年，土魯番遣將據哈密，遂大掠赤斤，奪其印而去。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Zhengde, Turfan sent generals to seize Hami, then raided Chijin on a great scale and carried off its seal.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengde year 8 Turfan sent generals to take Hami, then overran Chijin and carried off its seal.

sentences.zh: 及彭澤經略，始以印來歸。

translations.literal: Only when Peng Ze took charge of frontier affairs did they return the seal.
translations.idiomatic: Only after Peng Ze took charge of frontier affairs did they return the seal.

sentences.zh: 已，番賊犯肅州與中國為難。

translations.literal: Soon after, tribal raiders harassed Suzhou and made trouble for China.
translations.idiomatic: Soon tribal raiders were harrying Suzhou and making trouble for the realm.

sentences.zh: 赤斤當其沖，益遭蹂躪。

translations.literal: Chijin stood in their path and suffered ever worse ravaging.
translations.idiomatic: Chijin lay directly in their path and was trampled ever more harshly.

sentences.zh: 部眾不能自存，盡內徙肅州之南山，其城遂空。

translations.literal: The tribesmen could not sustain themselves and all migrated inward to the southern hills of Suzhou; the city was left empty.
translations.idiomatic: The tribesmen could not survive on their own and all moved inward to the southern hills of Suzhou; the city was abandoned.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖七年，總督王瓊撫安諸郡，核赤斤之眾僅千餘人。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Jiajing, Grand Coordinator Wang Qiong pacified the various districts and verified that Chijin's people numbered only a little over a thousand.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiajing year 7 grand coordinator Wang Qiong pacified the frontier districts and found that Chijin had barely a thousand people left.

sentences.zh: 乃授賞卜塔兒子鎖南束為都督，統其部帳。

translations.literal: He then appointed Shangbotar's son Suonan Shu Regional Commander to command their encampment.
translations.idiomatic: He then made Shangbotar's son Suonan Shu regional commander and put him in charge of the remnant encampment.

sentences.zh: 沙州衛

translations.literal: Shazhou Guard
translations.idiomatic: Shazhou Guard

sentences.zh: 沙州衛。

translations.literal: Shazhou Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Shazhou Guard.

sentences.zh: 自赤斤蒙古西行二百里曰苦峪，自苦峪南折而西百九十里曰瓜州，自瓜州而西四百四十里始達沙州。

translations.literal: Two hundred li west from Chijin Mongol lands is called Kuyu; from Kuyu, turning south and then west one hundred ninety li is Guazhou; from Guazhou westward four hundred forty li one finally reaches Shazhou.
translations.idiomatic: Two hundred li west from Chijin Mongol country lay Kuyu; from Kuyu, turning south and then west one hundred ninety li, Guazhou; and four hundred forty li west from Guazhou one reached Shazhou.

sentences.zh: 漢燉煌郡西域之境，玉門、陽關並相距不遠。

translations.literal: In Han it was the western borderlands of Dunhuang commandery; Yumen and Yang passes were not far apart.
translations.idiomatic: In Han times it was the western edge of Dunhuang commandery; Yumen and Yang passes lay not far apart.

sentences.zh: 後魏始置沙州，唐因之，後沒於吐蕃。

translations.literal: Northern Wei first established Shazhou; Tang maintained it, and later it was lost to Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: Northern Wei first established Shazhou; Tang kept it, and later it fell to Tibet.

sentences.zh: 宣宗時，張義潮以州內附，置歸義軍，授節度使。

translations.literal: In the reign of Emperor Xuanzong, Zhang Yichao submitted the prefecture and was established as the Guiyi Army, appointed military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Under Emperor Xuanzong, Zhang Yichao submitted the prefecture; the Guiyi Army was established and he was made military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 宋入於西夏，元為沙州路。

translations.literal: Under Song it passed to Western Xia; under Yuan it became Shazhou Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Under Song it passed to Western Xia; under the Yuan it became Shazhou Circuit.

sentences.zh: 洪武二十四年，蒙古王子阿魯哥失里遣國公抹台阿巴赤、司徒苦兒蘭等來朝，貢馬及璞玉。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year of Hongwu, the Mongol prince Aru Geshili sent the state duke Motai Abachi, the minister Kurilan, and others to court to present horses and uncarved jade.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu year 24 the Mongol prince Aru Geshili sent the state duke Motai Abachi, minister Kurilan, and others to court with horses and uncarved jade.

sentences.zh: 永樂二年，酋長困即來、買住率眾來歸。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yongle, chiefs Kunjilai and Maizhu led their followers to submit.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongle year 2 the chiefs Kunjilai and Maizhu led their people to submit.

sentences.zh: 命置沙州衛，授二人指揮使，賜印誥、冠帶、襲衣。

translations.literal: The court ordered Shazhou Guard established, appointed the two men commanders, and bestowed seals, patents, hat-belts, and court robes.
translations.idiomatic: The court established Shazhou Guard, made the two men commanders, and granted them seals, patents, hat-belts, and court robes.

sentences.zh: 已而其部下赤納來附，授都指揮僉事。

translations.literal: Soon after his subordinate China came to submit and was appointed Assistant Regional Commander.
translations.idiomatic: Soon his subordinate China came to submit and was made assistant regional commander.

sentences.zh: 五年夏，敕甘肅總兵官宋晟曰：「聞赤納本買住部曲，今官居其上，高下失倫，已擢買住為都指揮同知。

translations.literal: In the summer of the fifth year, an edict to Gansu Regional Commander Song Sheng said: "We have heard that China was originally Maizhu's follower, yet now holds rank above him—a breach of proper order. Maizhu has already been promoted to Vice Assistant Regional Commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the fifth year an edict to Gansu regional commander Song Sheng said: "We hear that China was once Maizhu's follower, yet now ranks above him—a breach of proper order. Maizhu has already been raised to vice assistant regional commander.

sentences.zh: 自今宜詳為審定，毋或失序。」

translations.literal: From now on ranks should be carefully determined so that order is not again disturbed."
translations.idiomatic: From now on ranks must be set with care so that order is not disturbed again."

sentences.zh: 八年擢困即來都指揮僉事，其僚屬進秩者二十人。

translations.literal: In the eighth year Kunjilai was promoted to Assistant Regional Commander, and twenty of his staff received rank advancement.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year Kunjilai was promoted to assistant regional commander, and twenty of his officers were advanced in rank.

sentences.zh: 買住卒，困即來掌衛事，朝貢不絕。

translations.literal: Maizhu died; Kunjilai took charge of guard affairs, and tribute missions never ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Maizhu died; Kunjilai took charge of guard affairs, and tribute never ceased.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，瓦剌賢義王太平部下來貢，中道為賊所梗，困即來遣人衛送至京。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, followers of Oirat Virtuous Prince Taiping came to pay tribute but were blocked mid-journey by bandits; Kunjilai sent men to escort them to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year followers of Oirat Virtuous Prince Taiping came to pay tribute but were waylaid by bandits; Kunjilai sent men to escort them to the capital.

sentences.zh: 帝嘉之，賚以彩幣，尋進秩都督僉事。

translations.literal: The emperor commended him, rewarded him with colored silks, and soon promoted him to Assistant Regional Commander.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised him, rewarded him with brocades, and soon promoted him to assistant regional commander.

sentences.zh: 洪熙元年，亦力把里及撒馬兒罕先後入貢，道經哈密地，併為沙州賊邀劫。

translations.literal: In the first year of Hongxi, Yilibali and Samarkand successively sent tribute missions; passing through Hami territory, they were both waylaid by Shazhou bandits.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongxi year 1 tribute missions from Yilibali and Samarkand, passing through Hami, were both waylaid by Shazhou bandits.

sentences.zh: 宣宗怒，命肅州守將費瓛剿之。

translations.literal: Emperor Xuanzong was angered and ordered Suzhou garrison commander Fei Xun to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xuanzong was furious and ordered Suzhou garrison commander Fei Xun to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 宣德元年，困即來以歲荒人困，遣使貸谷種百石，秋成還官。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xuande, Kunjilai, because of famine and hardship among his people, sent envoys to borrow a hundred shi of seed grain, to be repaid to the government after the autumn harvest.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuande year 1 Kunjilai, his people starving in a year of famine, sent envoys to borrow a hundred shi of seed grain to be repaid after the autumn harvest.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「番人即吾人，何貸為？」
