translations.literal: The emperor said: "The tribesmen are our own people—why speak of a loan?"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "The tribesmen are our own people—why speak of a loan?"

sentences.zh: 命即予之。

translations.literal: He ordered it given at once.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered it given at once.

sentences.zh: 尋遣中官張福使其地，賚彩幣。

translations.literal: Soon after he dispatched the eunuch Zhang Fu to their territory with colored silks as gifts.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he sent the eunuch Zhang Fu to their territory with brocades as gifts.

sentences.zh: 七年又奏旱災，敕於肅州授糧五百石。

translations.literal: In the seventh year they again reported drought disaster, and an edict granted five hundred shi of grain at Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year they reported drought again, and an edict granted five hundred shi of grain at Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 已而哈烈貢使言道經沙州，為赤斤指揮革古者等剽掠。

translations.literal: Before long a tribute envoy from Herat reported that on passing through Shazhou he had been plundered by Chijin commander Geguzhe and others.
translations.idiomatic: Before long a Herat tribute envoy reported that on the road through Shazhou he had been robbed by Chijin commander Geguzhe and others.

sentences.zh: 部議赤斤之人遠至沙州為盜，罪不可貸。

translations.literal: The ministry deliberated that for men of Chijin to travel as far as Shazhou to rob, the offense could not be pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry held that for men of Chijin to travel so far as Shazhou to rob, the offense could not be forgiven.

sentences.zh: 帝令困即來察之，敕曰：「彼既為盜，不可復容，宜驅還本土，再犯不宥。」

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Kunjilai to investigate and issued an edict saying: "Since they have turned to robbery, they cannot be harbored again. Drive them back to their own lands; repeat offenders will not be forgiven."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Kunjilai to investigate and sent an edict saying: "Since they have turned to robbery, they cannot be sheltered again. Drive them back to their own lands; repeat offenders will not be pardoned."

sentences.zh: 九年遣使奏罕東及西番數肆侵侮，掠取人畜，不獲安居，乞徙察罕舊城耕牧。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he sent envoys reporting that Handong and Western Tibetans had repeatedly harassed them, seizing people and livestock so they could not live in peace; they begged to relocate to the old city of Chahan to farm and pasture.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he sent envoys reporting repeated harassment by Handong and Western Tibetans, with people and livestock seized so that they could not live in peace; they asked to move to the old city of Chahan to farm and pasture.

sentences.zh: 帝遣敕止之曰：「爾居沙州三十餘年，戶口滋息，畜牧富饒，皆朝廷之力。

translations.literal: The emperor sent an edict forbidding it, saying: "You have dwelt at Shazhou for more than thirty years; your households have multiplied and your herds grown rich—all through the court's support.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sent an edict forbidding the move, saying: "You have lived at Shazhou for more than thirty years; your households have multiplied and your herds grown rich—all through the court's support.

sentences.zh: 往年哈密嘗奏爾侵擾，今外侮亦自取。

translations.literal: In past years Hami has reported your raids; today's outside harassment you have brought upon yourselves.
translations.idiomatic: In past years Hami has reported your raids; the harassment you suffer now you have brought on yourselves.

sentences.zh: 但當循分守職，保境睦鄰，自無外患。

translations.literal: You need only keep to your station, guard your borders, and live in peace with neighbors, and outside troubles will not arise.
translations.idiomatic: Keep to your station, guard your borders, and live at peace with your neighbors, and outside troubles will not arise.

sentences.zh: 何必東遷西徙，徒取勞瘁。」

translations.literal: Why migrate east and west to no purpose, bringing yourselves only exhaustion?"
translations.idiomatic: Why move east and west for nothing, bringing yourselves only exhaustion?"

sentences.zh: 又敕罕東、西番，果侵奪人畜，速還之。

translations.literal: He also instructed Handong and the Western Tibetans: if you have indeed seized people and livestock, return them at once.
translations.idiomatic: He also instructed Handong and the Western Tibetans: if you have seized people and livestock, return them at once.

sentences.zh: 明年又為哈密所侵，且懼瓦剌見逼，不能自立。

translations.literal: The next year they were again invaded by Hami, and fearing Oirat pressure as well, could not stand on their own.
translations.idiomatic: The next year they were invaded by Hami again, and fearing Oirat pressure as well, could not hold their own.

sentences.zh: 乃率部眾二百餘人走附塞下，陳飢窘狀。

translations.literal: They then led more than two hundred followers to flee and attach themselves below the frontier pass, reporting their hunger and distress.
translations.idiomatic: They then led more than two hundred followers to flee to the frontier and attach themselves below the pass, reporting hunger and destitution.

sentences.zh: 詔邊臣發粟濟之，且令議所處置。

translations.literal: An edict ordered frontier officials to distribute grain to relieve them and also to deliberate on how to settle them.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered frontier officials to distribute grain for relief and to decide how to settle them.

sentences.zh: 邊臣請移之苦峪，從之。

translations.literal: Frontier officials requested they be moved to Kuyu, and this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Frontier officials asked that they be moved to Kuyu, and the court agreed.

sentences.zh: 自是不復還沙州，但遙領其眾而已。

translations.literal: From then on they never returned to Shazhou, but only held nominal command over their people.
translations.idiomatic: From then on they never returned to Shazhou, but held only nominal command over their people.

sentences.zh: 正統元年，西域阿端遣使來貢，為罕東頭目可兒即及西番野人剽奪。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhengtong, Adun in the Western Regions sent envoys with tribute, who were plundered by Handong chieftain Kuerji and Western Tibetan wild tribesmen.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengtong year 1 Adun in the Western Regions sent tribute envoys who were robbed by Handong chieftain Kuerji and Western Tibetan wild tribesmen.

sentences.zh: 困即來奉命往追還其貢物，帝嘉之，擢都督同知。

translations.literal: Kunjilai was ordered to go and recover the tribute goods; the emperor commended him and promoted him to Vice Regional Commander.
translations.idiomatic: Kunjilai was ordered to recover the tribute goods; the emperor praised him and promoted him to vice regional commander.

sentences.zh: 四年，其部下都指揮阿赤不花等一百三十餘家亡入哈密。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, more than 130 households of his subordinates, including Regional Commander Achi Buhua, fled into Hami.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year more than 130 households of his followers, including regional commander Achi Buhua, fled into Hami.

sentences.zh: 困即來奉詔索之，不予。

translations.literal: Kunjilai received an imperial order to demand them back; Hami refused.
translations.idiomatic: Kunjilai received an imperial order to demand them back, but Hami refused.

sentences.zh: 朝命忠順王還之，又不予。

translations.literal: The court ordered the Prince of Loyalty and Obedience to return them; again they were not handed over.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered the Prince of Loyalty and Obedience to return them, but again they were not handed over.

sentences.zh: 會遣使冊封其新王，即令使人索還所逃之戶。

translations.literal: When envoys were dispatched to invest the new king, they were also instructed to demand back the fled households.
translations.idiomatic: When envoys were sent to invest the new king, they were also told to demand back the fugitive households.

sentences.zh: 而哈密僅還都指揮桑哥失力等八十四家，餘仍不遣。

translations.literal: But Hami returned only 84 households including Regional Commander Sang Geshili; the rest were still not sent back.
translations.idiomatic: But Hami returned only 84 households, including regional commander Sang Geshili; the rest were still not sent back.

sentences.zh: 是罕東都指揮班麻思結久駐牧沙州不去，赤斤都指揮革古者亦納其叛亡。

translations.literal: Meanwhile Handong Regional Commander Banmasijie had long pastured at Shazhou and would not leave, and Chijin Regional Commander Geguzhe also took in their deserters.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile Handong regional commander Banmasijie had long grazed his herds at Shazhou and would not leave, and Chijin regional commander Geguzhe also took in their deserters.

sentences.zh: 困即來屢訴於朝，朝廷亦數遣敕詰責，諸部多不奉命。

translations.literal: Kunjilai repeatedly petitioned the court; the court also sent edicts rebuking them many times, but most of the tribes would not obey.
translations.idiomatic: Kunjilai petitioned the court again and again; the court sent rebuking edicts many times as well, but most of the tribes would not obey.

sentences.zh: 四年八月令人偵瓦剌、哈密事，具得其實以聞。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the fourth year he sent men to spy out Oirat and Hami affairs and reported the full truth.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the fourth year he sent men to spy on Oirat and Hami affairs and reported the full truth to court.

sentences.zh: 帝喜，降敕獎勵，厚賜之。

translations.literal: The emperor was pleased, issued a commendatory edict, and richly rewarded him.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was pleased, sent down a commendatory edict, and rewarded him generously.

sentences.zh: 明年遣使入貢，又報迤北邊事，進其使臣二人官。

translations.literal: The next year he sent envoys with tribute, also reporting on northern frontier affairs; two of his envoys were promoted in rank.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he sent tribute envoys and also reported on northern frontier affairs; two of his envoys were promoted.

sentences.zh: 初，困即來之去沙州也，朝廷命邊將繕治苦峪城，率戍卒助之。

translations.literal: At first, when Kunjilai left Shazhou, the court had ordered frontier generals to repair Kuyu city and lead garrison troops to assist.
translations.idiomatic: When Kunjilai first left Shazhou, the court had ordered frontier generals to repair Kuyu and lead garrison troops to help.

sentences.zh: 六年冬，城成，入朝謝恩，貢駝馬，宴賜遣還。

translations.literal: In the winter of the sixth year the city was completed; he came to court to give thanks, presented camels and horses, was feasted and rewarded, and sent home.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the sixth year the city was finished; he came to court to give thanks, presented camels and horses, was feasted and rewarded, and sent home.

sentences.zh: 七年率眾侵哈密，獲其人畜以歸。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he led his followers to raid Hami and returned with captives and livestock.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he led his followers against Hami and returned with captives and livestock.

sentences.zh: 九年，困即來卒，長子喃哥率其弟克俄羅領占來朝。

translations.literal: In the ninth year Kunjilai died; his eldest son Nange led his younger brother K'orolingzhan to court.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year Kunjilai died; his eldest son Nange led his younger brother K'orolingzhan to court.

sentences.zh: 授喃哥都督僉事，其弟都指揮使，賜敕戒諭。

translations.literal: Nange was appointed Assistant Regional Commander, his brother Regional Commander; they were granted an edict of admonition and instruction.
translations.idiomatic: Nange was made assistant regional commander and his brother regional commander; they were granted an edict of admonition and instruction.

sentences.zh: 既還，其兄弟乖爭，部眾攜貳。

translations.literal: After they returned, the brothers quarreled, and the tribesmen grew divided in loyalty.
translations.idiomatic: After they returned, the brothers quarreled and their followers split in loyalty.

sentences.zh: 甘肅鎮將任禮等欲乘其窘乏，遷之塞內。

translations.literal: The Gansu garrison generals Ren Li and others wished to take advantage of their distress and shortage and move them inside the frontier pass.
translations.idiomatic: The Gansu garrison generals Ren Li and others wanted to take advantage of their distress and move them inside the frontier pass.

sentences.zh: 而喃哥亦來言，欲居肅州之小缽和寺。

translations.literal: Nange also came to report that he wished to dwell at the Xiaobohe Monastery in Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Nange also came forward saying he wished to settle at Xiaobohe Monastery in Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 禮等遂以十一年秋令都指揮毛哈剌等偕喃哥先赴沙州，撫諭其眾，而親率兵隨其後。

translations.literal: Ren Li and the others then, in the autumn of the eleventh year, ordered Regional Commander Maohala and others to accompany Nange and go first to Shazhou to pacify and instruct the people, while they personally led troops following behind.
translations.idiomatic: Ren Li and his colleagues then, in the autumn of the eleventh year, sent regional commander Maohala and others with Nange ahead to Shazhou to pacify the people, while he personally led troops behind them.

sentences.zh: 比至，喃哥意中變，陰持兩端，其部下多欲奔瓦剌。

translations.literal: When they arrived, Nange's intentions changed within; secretly he played both sides, and many of his followers wished to flee to the Oirats.
translations.idiomatic: When they arrived, Nange had changed his mind; he secretly played both sides, and many of his followers wanted to flee to the Oirats.

sentences.zh: 禮等進兵迫之，遂收其全部入塞，居之甘州，凡二百餘戶，千二百三十餘人，沙州遂空。

translations.literal: Ren Li and the others advanced troops to press them, thus taking in their entire band inside the pass, settling them at Ganzhou—in all more than two hundred households and more than 1,230 persons—and Shazhou was thus emptied.
translations.idiomatic: Ren Li advanced in force, took the whole band inside the pass, and settled them at Ganzhou—more than two hundred households and 1,230 people in all—leaving Shazhou empty.

sentences.zh: 帝以其迫之而來，情不可測，令禮熟計其便。

translations.literal: The emperor, considering that they had come only because they were pressed, and their intentions could not be gauged, ordered Ren Li to carefully weigh what course would serve best.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor felt that, having come only under coercion, their intentions could not be trusted, and ordered Ren Li to weigh the best course carefully.

sentences.zh: 然自是安居內地，迄無後患。

translations.literal: Yet from then on they lived in peace within the interior, and to the end there were no further troubles.
translations.idiomatic: Yet from then on they lived in peace within the interior, and no further trouble arose.

sentences.zh: 而沙州為罕東酋班麻思結所有。

translations.literal: Meanwhile Shazhou came to be held by the Handong chieftain Banmasijie.
translations.idiomatic: Shazhou meanwhile fell into the hands of Handong chieftain Banmasijie.

sentences.zh: 獨喃哥弟鎖南奔不從徙，竄入瓦剌，也先封之為祁王。

translations.literal: Only Nange's younger brother Suonan fled and would not follow the migration; he slipped into the Oirats, and Esen enfeoffed him as Prince of Qi.
translations.idiomatic: Only Nange's younger brother Suonan refused to migrate and fled into Oirat territory, where Esen enfeoffed him as Prince of Qi.

sentences.zh: 禮偵知其在罕東，掩襲獲之。

translations.literal: Ren Li, learning through espionage that he was in Handong, made a surprise attack and captured him.
translations.idiomatic: Ren Li learned through espionage that Suonan was in Handong, launched a surprise attack, and captured him.

sentences.zh: 廷臣請正法，帝念其父兄恭順，免死，徙東昌。

translations.literal: Court officials requested execution according to law; the emperor, mindful that his father and elder brother had been respectful and obedient, spared his life and moved him to Dongchang.
translations.idiomatic: Court officials called for execution, but the emperor, remembering his father and elder brother's loyal submission, spared his life and exiled him to Dongchang.

sentences.zh: 先是，太宗置哈密、沙州、赤斤、罕東四衛於嘉峪關外，屏蔽西陲。

translations.literal: Earlier, Taizong had established the four guards of Hami, Shazhou, Chijin, and Handong outside Jiayuguan to shield the western frontier.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Taizong had established the four guards of Hami, Shazhou, Chijin, and Handong beyond Jiayuguan to shield the western frontier.

sentences.zh: 至是，沙州先廢，而諸衛亦漸不能自立，肅州遂多事。

translations.literal: At this point Shazhou was first abolished, and the other guards also gradually could not stand on their own; Suzhou thereupon saw many troubles.
translations.idiomatic: By then Shazhou had already fallen, the other guards could no longer hold their own, and Suzhou was soon beset by trouble.

sentences.zh: 罕東衛

translations.literal: Handong Guard
translations.idiomatic: Handong Guard

sentences.zh: 罕東衛，在赤斤蒙古南，嘉峪關西南，漢燉煌郡地也。

translations.literal: The Handong Guard lay south of Chijin Mongol territory, southwest of Jiayuguan, in the territory of the Han-era Dunhuang commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Handong Guard lay south of Chijin Mongol territory, southwest of Jiayuguan, in what had been Han Dunhuang commandery.

sentences.zh: 洪武二十五年，涼國公藍玉追逃寇祁者孫至罕東地，其部眾多竄徙。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year of Hongwu, Duke of Liangguo Lan Yu pursued the fugitive bandit Qizhe's grandson to Handong territory, and many of their tribesmen fled and migrated.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu year 25 Duke of Liangguo Lan Yu pursued the fugitive bandit Qizhe's grandson into Handong territory, and many of the tribesmen fled.

sentences.zh: 西寧三剌為書招之，遂相繼來歸。

translations.literal: Sanla of Xining wrote letters summoning them, and they then came to submit one after another.
translations.idiomatic: Sanla of Xining wrote to summon them, and they submitted in succession.

sentences.zh: 三十年，酋鎖南吉剌思遣使入貢，詔置罕東衛，授指揮僉事。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year, the chieftain Suonan Jilasi sent envoys with tribute; an edict established the Handong Guard and granted him the post of Assistant Regional Commander.
translations.idiomatic: In year 30 chieftain Suonan Jilasi sent tribute envoys; the court established Handong Guard and made him assistant regional commander.

sentences.zh: 正統四年，罕東、安定合眾侵西番申藏族，掠其馬牛雜畜以萬計。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Zhengtong, Handong and Anding combined their forces to invade the Western Tibetan Shenzang tribe, plundering their horses, cattle, and mixed livestock numbering in the tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengtong year 4 Handong and Anding joined forces against the Western Tibetan Shenzang tribe and plundered tens of thousands of their horses, cattle, and livestock.

sentences.zh: 其僧訴於邊將，言畜產一空，歲辦差發馬無從出。

translations.literal: Their monk complained to frontier generals, saying their livestock was entirely gone and there was no way to supply the horses owed annually for the quota levy.
translations.idiomatic: Their monk appealed to frontier generals, saying their herds were wiped out and they had no horses left for the annual quota levy.

sentences.zh: 帝切責二衛，數其殘忍暴橫、違國法、毒鄰境之罪，令悉歸所掠。

translations.literal: The emperor sternly rebuked the two guards, enumerating their crimes of cruelty, violence, violation of national law, and poisoning neighboring territory, and ordered them to return all that had been plundered.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sternly rebuked both guards, listing their crimes of cruelty, lawbreaking, and harrying neighboring lands, and ordered everything stolen returned.

sentences.zh: 又諭僧不限舊制，隨所有入貢。

translations.literal: He also instructed the monk that the old regulations need not limit him—he might bring tribute according to whatever he possessed.
translations.idiomatic: He also told the monk that old quotas no longer applied and he might bring whatever tribute he could.

sentences.zh: 明年冬，綽兒加偕班麻思結共侵哈密，獲老稚百人、馬百匹，牛羊無算。

translations.literal: The next winter, Chuo'erjia together with Banmasijie jointly invaded Hami, capturing a hundred old and young, a hundred horses, and untold numbers of cattle and sheep.
translations.idiomatic: The next winter Chuo'erjia and Banmasijie jointly raided Hami, taking a hundred old and young captives, a hundred horses, and countless cattle and sheep.

sentences.zh: 忠順王遣使索之，不予。

translations.literal: The Prince of Loyalty and Obedience sent envoys to demand them back; they were not handed over.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Loyalty and Obedience sent envoys to demand them back, but they were refused.

sentences.zh: 帝聞，復賜敕戒諭。

translations.literal: When the emperor heard of it, he again granted an edict of admonition and instruction.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor heard, he sent another admonitory edict.

sentences.zh: 然番人以剽掠為性，天子即有言，亦不能盡從也。

translations.literal: Yet the Fan peoples take plunder as their nature; even when the Son of Heaven has spoken, they cannot fully obey.
translations.idiomatic: Yet raiding was in these tribes' nature; even the emperor's word could not make them fully comply.

sentences.zh: 六年夏，綽兒加來貢馬，宴賚還。

translations.literal: In the summer of the sixth year, Chuo'erjia came to present horses as tribute; he was feasted, rewarded, and sent home.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the sixth year Chuo'erjia brought tribute horses, was feasted and rewarded, and sent home.

sentences.zh: 九年卒，子賞卜兒加嗣職，奏乞齋糧、茶布，命悉予之。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he died; his son Shangbu'erjia succeeded to the post, memorialized begging for rations, tea, and cloth, and was ordered to receive all he requested.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the ninth year; his son Shangbu'erjia succeeded and petitioned for rations, tea, and cloth—all of which were granted.

sentences.zh: 十一年進都指揮使。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he was promoted to Regional Commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he was promoted to regional commander.

sentences.zh: 成化九年，土魯番陷哈密。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Chenghua, Turpan captured Hami.
translations.idiomatic: In Chenghua year 9 Turpan took Hami.

sentences.zh: 都督李文西征，罕東以兵來助。

translations.literal: Regional Commander Li Wen marched on a western campaign, and Handong came with troops to assist.
translations.idiomatic: When regional commander Li Wen marched west, Handong sent troops to help.

sentences.zh: 後都督罕慎復哈密，亦藉其兵，賜敕獎賚。

translations.literal: Later Regional Commander Han Shen recovered Hami, also relying on their troops, and was granted an edict of commendation and reward.
translations.idiomatic: Later, when regional commander Han Shen retook Hami, he too relied on their troops and received a commendatory edict and rewards.

sentences.zh: 十八年，其部下掠番族，有侵入河清堡者。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, his followers plundered Fan tribes, some encroaching on Heqing Fort.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year his followers raided Fan tribes, some pushing as far as Heqing Fort.

sentences.zh: 都指揮梅琛勒兵追之，奪還男婦五十餘人，馬牛雜畜四千五百有奇。

translations.literal: Regional Commander Mei Chen mustered troops to pursue them, recovered more than fifty men and women, and more than 4,500 mixed horses, cattle, and livestock.
translations.idiomatic: Regional commander Mei Chen pursued them and recovered more than fifty captives and over 4,500 horses, cattle, and other livestock.

sentences.zh: 邊臣請討其罪，部臣難之。

translations.literal: Frontier officials requested that their crime be punished; ministry officials found it difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Frontier officials called for punishment, but the ministry balked.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「罕東方聽調協取哈密，未有攜貳之形，奈何因小故遽加以兵。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Handong has lately obeyed orders and helped recover Hami; there is no sign of divided loyalty—why over a small matter rush to send troops?
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "Handong has lately obeyed orders and helped retake Hami; there is no sign of disloyalty—why send troops over a minor incident?

sentences.zh: 宜諭令悔過，不服，則耀兵威之。」

translations.literal: They should be instructed to repent; if they do not obey, then display military might to overawe them."
translations.idiomatic: Instruct them to repent; if they refuse, then display military might."

sentences.zh: 二十二年，邊臣言：「比遣官往哈密，與土魯番使臣家屬四百人偕行。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, frontier officials reported: "Recently officials were dispatched to Hami, traveling together with four hundred family members of Turpan envoys.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year frontier officials reported: "Recently envoys were sent to Hami along with four hundred family members of Turpan mission personnel.

sentences.zh: 道經罕東，為都督把麻奔等掠去，朝使僅免，乞討之。」

translations.literal: Passing through Handong, they were plundered by Regional Commander Bama Ben and others; the court envoys barely escaped, and a punitive expedition was requested."
translations.idiomatic: Passing through Handong they were robbed by regional commander Bama Ben and others; the court envoys barely escaped, and officials asked for punitive action."

sentences.zh: 帝命遣人往諭，如番人例議和，還所掠物，不從則進兵。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered men sent to instruct them: following the Fan custom, negotiate peace and return the plundered goods; if they do not obey, then advance troops.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered envoys sent to negotiate as with other Fan tribes—return what was stolen, and advance only if they refused.

sentences.zh: 弘治中，土魯番復據哈密。

translations.literal: During the Hongzhi reign, Turpan again held Hami.
translations.idiomatic: During Hongzhi Turpan again occupied Hami.

sentences.zh: 兵部馬文升議直搗其城，召指揮楊翥計之。

translations.literal: Ma Wensheng of the Ministry of War proposed striking directly at their city and summoned Commander Yang Zhu to plan it.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of War Ma Wensheng proposed striking Turpan's city directly and summoned commander Yang Zhu to plan the campaign.

sentences.zh: 翥言罕東有間道，不旬日可達哈密，宜出賊不意，從此進兵。

translations.literal: Zhu said Handong had a hidden route by which one could reach Hami in less than ten days; they should take the enemy by surprise and advance by this route.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu said Handong had a secret route that could reach Hami in under ten days—the troops should surprise the enemy and advance by that path.

sentences.zh: 文升曰：「如若言，發罕東兵三千前行，我師三千後繼，各持數日乾糧，兼程襲之，若何？」

translations.literal: Wensheng said: "As you say, send three thousand Handong troops ahead and three thousand of our army to follow; each carrying several days' dry rations, march at forced pace to strike them—what of it?"
translations.idiomatic: Wensheng said: "As you propose, send three thousand Handong troops ahead and three thousand of our men behind, each with several days' dry rations, and strike at forced march—how does that sound?"

sentences.zh: 翥稱善。

translations.literal: Zhu praised the plan.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu approved.

sentences.zh: 文升以屬巡撫許進，進遣人諭罕東如前策。

translations.literal: Wensheng entrusted the matter to Grand Coordinator Xu Jin; Xu sent men to instruct Handong according to the plan above.
translations.idiomatic: Wensheng put the matter in the hands of grand coordinator Xu Jin, who sent word to Handong as planned.

sentences.zh: 會罕東失期不至，官軍仍由大路進，賊得遁去。

translations.literal: But Handong missed the appointed time and did not arrive; the official army still advanced by the main road, and the bandits were able to escape.
translations.idiomatic: But Handong failed to arrive on time; the government army still marched by the main road, and the enemy escaped.

sentences.zh: 十二年，其部人侵西寧隆奔族，掠去印誥及人畜。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, his tribesmen invaded the Longben tribe of Xining, plundering their seal, patent of appointment, people, and livestock.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year his followers raided the Longben tribe of Xining, stealing their seal, commission, people, and livestock.

sentences.zh: 兵部請敕都督，宣諭其下，毋匿所掠物，盡歸其主，違命則都督自討，從之。

translations.literal: The Ministry of War requested an edict to the regional commander instructing his subordinates not to conceal plundered goods but return them fully to their owners; if they disobeyed, the regional commander himself should punish them—this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of War asked that the regional commander be ordered to tell his men to return all stolen goods; if they refused, he was to punish them himself—and the court agreed.

sentences.zh: 時土魯番日強，數侵掠鄰境，諸部皆不能支。

translations.literal: At this time Turpan grew daily stronger, repeatedly invading and plundering neighboring territory; none of the tribes could withstand it.
translations.idiomatic: Turpan was growing stronger by the day, repeatedly raiding its neighbors, and none of the tribes could hold out.

sentences.zh: 正德中，蒙古大酋入青海，罕東亦遭蹂躪，其眾益衰。

translations.literal: During the Zhengde reign, a great Mongol chieftain entered Qinghai; Handong also suffered devastation, and its people grew ever weaker.
translations.idiomatic: During Zhengde a great Mongol chieftain entered Qinghai; Handong was devastated as well, and its people grew weaker still.

sentences.zh: 后土魯番復陷哈密，直犯肅州。

translations.literal: Later Turpan again captured Hami and struck directly at Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Later Turpan took Hami again and raided Suzhou directly.

sentences.zh: 罕東復殘破，相率求內徙，其城遂棄不守。

translations.literal: Handong was again devastated; they collectively sought inward migration, and their city was thus abandoned and left undefended.
translations.idiomatic: Handong was wrecked again; the people sought inward migration en masse, and their city was abandoned.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖時，總督王瓊安輯諸部，移罕東都指揮枝丹部落於甘州。

translations.literal: During the Jiajing reign, Grand Coordinator Wang Qiong pacified the various tribes and moved the Handong regional commander Zhi Dan's tribe to Ganzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the Jiajing era grand coordinator Wang Qiong pacified the frontier tribes and moved regional commander Zhi Dan's Handong band to Ganzhou.

sentences.zh: 罕東左衛

translations.literal: Handong Left Guard
translations.idiomatic: Handong Left Guard

sentences.zh: 罕東左衛，在沙州衛故城，憲宗時始建。

translations.literal: The Handong Left Guard lay at the old city of Shazhou Guard and was first established in the Xianzong reign.
translations.idiomatic: Handong Left Guard was established at the old site of Shazhou Guard in the Xianzong reign.

sentences.zh: 初，罕東部人奄章與種族不相能，數仇殺，乃率其眾逃居沙州境。

translations.literal: At first, the Handong tribesman Yan Zhang could not get along with his clan; they repeatedly feuded and killed one another, so he led his followers to flee and dwell in Shazhou territory.
translations.idiomatic: At first the Handong tribesman Yan Zhang feuded repeatedly with his kin and led his followers to flee into Shazhou territory.

sentences.zh: 朝廷即許其耕牧，歲納馬於肅州。

translations.literal: The court at once permitted them to farm and pasture, paying horses annually at Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The court promptly allowed them to farm and pasture there, delivering horses yearly at Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 後部落日蕃，益不受罕東統屬。

translations.literal: Later the tribe grew daily larger and increasingly would not accept Handong's command.
translations.idiomatic: The band grew larger and gradually refused Handong's authority.

sentences.zh: 至其子班麻思結，洪熙時從討曲先有功，賞未之及。

translations.literal: When it came to his son Banmasijie, in the Hongxi reign he followed the campaign against Quxian and had merit, but reward had not reached him.
translations.idiomatic: His son Banmasijie had merit in the Hongxi campaign against Quxian but had never been rewarded.

sentences.zh: 宣德七年自陳於朝，即命為罕東衛指揮使，賜敕獎賚。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Xuande he reported himself at court and was at once appointed Regional Commander of Handong Guard, granted an edict of commendation and reward.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuande year 7 he petitioned the court, was made regional commander of Handong Guard, and received a commendatory edict and rewards.

sentences.zh: 然猶居沙州，不還本衛。

translations.literal: Yet he still dwelt at Shazhou and did not return to his original guard.
translations.idiomatic: Yet he remained at Shazhou and did not return to his home guard.

sentences.zh: 十年進都指揮使僉事。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was promoted to Assistant Regional Commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he was promoted to assistant regional commander.

sentences.zh: 正統四年，沙州衛都督困即來以班麻思結侵居其地，乞遣還。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Zhengtong, Kunjilai, regional commander of Shazhou Guard, reported that Banmasijie had encroached and occupied his territory, and begged that he be sent back.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengtong year 4 Shazhou regional commander Kunjilai reported that Banmasijie had encroached on his territory and asked that he be sent back.

sentences.zh: 天子如其言，賜敕宣諭，班麻思結不奉命。

translations.literal: The Son of Heaven granted his request, sending an edict of instruction, but Banmasijie did not obey the command.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor agreed and sent an instructive edict, but Banmasijie refused to comply.

sentences.zh: 時赤斤衛指揮鎖合者因殺人遁入沙州地，班麻思結納之。

translations.literal: At the time Chijin Guard commander Suohezhe, having killed a man, fled into Shazhou territory, and Banmasijie took him in.
translations.idiomatic: About then Chijin commander Suohezhe fled into Shazhou after killing a man, and Banmasijie sheltered him.

sentences.zh: 鎖合者又令其子往烏斯藏取毒藥，將還攻赤斤。

translations.literal: Suohezhe also sent his son to U-Tsang to obtain poison, intending to return and attack Chijin.
translations.idiomatic: Suohezhe also sent his son to Tibet for poison, planning to return and attack Chijin.

sentences.zh: 赤斤都督且旺失加以為言，天子即敕諭班麻思結睦鄰保境，無啟釁端。

translations.literal: Chijin regional commander Qiewangshijia reported this; the Son of Heaven at once sent an edict instructing Banmasijie to live in peace with neighbors and guard his borders, and not to provoke conflict.
translations.idiomatic: Chijin regional commander Qiewangshijia reported this, and the emperor immediately ordered Banmasijie to keep the peace with his neighbors and guard his borders—no provocations.

sentences.zh: 久之，沙州全部悉內徙，思結遂盡有其地。

translations.literal: After a long time, the entire Shazhou band all migrated inward, and Banmasijie thus came to hold all the territory entirely.
translations.idiomatic: In time the whole Shazhou population moved inward, and Banmasijie took possession of the entire area.

sentences.zh: 十四年，甘肅鎮臣任禮等奏，班麻思結潛與瓦剌也先通好，近又與哈密搆兵，宜令還居本衛。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, Gansu garrison officials Ren Li and others memorialized that Banmasijie had secretly kept friendly relations with the Oirat Esen and recently also clashed with Hami; he should be ordered to return and dwell in his original guard.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year Gansu officials Ren Li and others reported that Banmasijie was secretly on friendly terms with the Oirat Esen and had recently clashed with Hami; he should be ordered back to his home guard.

sentences.zh: 天子再賜敕宣諭，亦不奉命。

translations.literal: The Son of Heaven again granted an edict of instruction, but still he did not obey the command.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sent another instructive edict, but again he refused.

sentences.zh: 尋進秩都指揮使。

translations.literal: Soon after he was promoted in rank to Regional Commander.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon promoted to regional commander.

sentences.zh: 歷景泰、天順朝，朝貢不廢。

translations.literal: Through the Jingtai and Tianshun reigns, tribute missions to court were not discontinued.
translations.idiomatic: Through the Jingtai and Tianshun reigns tribute missions continued without interruption.

sentences.zh: 成化中，班麻思結卒，孫只克嗣職，部眾益盛。

translations.literal: During the Chenghua reign, Banmasijie died; his grandson Zhike succeeded to the post, and the tribesmen grew ever stronger.
translations.idiomatic: In the Chenghua period Banmasijie died; his grandson Zhike succeeded, and the tribe grew stronger.

sentences.zh: 其時，土魯番強，侵據哈密。

translations.literal: At that time Turpan was strong and invading and holding Hami.
translations.idiomatic: Turpan was then strong and had seized Hami.

sentences.zh: 只克與之接境，患其逼己，欲自為一衛。

translations.literal: Zhike bordered on them, feared their pressure upon himself, and wished to become a guard in his own right.
translations.idiomatic: Zhike bordered Turpan, feared its pressure, and wanted to become a guard in his own right.

sentences.zh: 十五年九月奏請如罕東、赤斤例，立衛賜印，捍禦西陲。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the fifteenth year he memorialized requesting that, following the precedent of Handong and Chijin, a guard be established and a seal granted, to defend the western frontier.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of year 15 he petitioned to follow the Handong and Chijin precedent—establish a guard, grant a seal, and hold the western frontier.

sentences.zh: 兵部言：「近土魯番吞噬哈密，罕東諸衛各不自保，西鄙為之不寧。

translations.literal: The Ministry of War said: "Recently Turpan has swallowed Hami; the Handong guards each cannot protect themselves, and the western marches are thereby unsettled.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of War said: "Turpan has lately swallowed Hami; the Handong guards can barely protect themselves, and the western frontier is in turmoil.

sentences.zh: 而赤斤、罕東、苦峪又各懷嫌隙，不相救援。

translations.literal: Yet Chijin, Handong, and Kuyu each harbor grievances and do not rescue one another.
translations.idiomatic: Chijin, Handong, and Kuyu harbor grudges against one another and will not aid each other.

sentences.zh: 倘沙州更無人統理，勢必為強敵所並，邊方愈多事。

translations.literal: If Shazhou further has no one to govern it, it will inevitably be annexed by a strong enemy, and the frontier will see ever more trouble.
translations.idiomatic: If no one governs Shazhou, a strong enemy will surely absorb it and the frontier will see even more trouble.

sentences.zh: 宜如所請，即於沙州故城置罕東左衛，令只克仍以都指揮使統治。」

translations.literal: The request should be granted: forthwith establish the Handong Left Guard at the old city of Shazhou, and let Zhike continue to govern as Regional Commander."
translations.idiomatic: The request should be granted: establish Handong Left Guard at old Shazhou and let Zhike govern as regional commander."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court agreed.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，甘肅守臣言：「北寇屢犯沙州，殺掠人畜。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year, Gansu frontier officials reported: "Northern bandits have repeatedly violated Shazhou, killing and plundering people and livestock.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year Gansu officials reported: "Northern raiders have repeatedly struck Shazhou, killing and plundering people and livestock.

sentences.zh: 又值歲飢，人思流竄。

translations.literal: There has also been famine this year, and people think of fleeing and scattering.
translations.idiomatic: Famine has also struck, and people are fleeing.

sentences.zh: 已發粟五百石，令布種，仍乞人給月糧振之。

translations.literal: Five hundred shi of grain have already been distributed for sowing; we still beg that monthly rations be granted for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Five hundred shi of grain have been issued for planting; we still ask for monthly rations to sustain them.

sentences.zh: 其酋只克有斬級功，亦乞並敘。」

translations.literal: Their chieftain Zhike has merit in slaying enemies; we also beg that this be recorded together."
translations.idiomatic: Chieftain Zhike has merit for killing enemies on campaign; we ask that this be rewarded as well."

sentences.zh: 乃擢只克都督僉事，餘報可。

translations.literal: Zhike was then promoted to Assistant Regional Commander; the rest was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Zhike was promoted to assistant regional commander; the rest was approved.

sentences.zh: 弘治七年，指揮王永言：「先朝建哈密衛，當西域要衝。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Hongzhi, Commander Wang Yong said: "The previous dynasty established Hami Guard at the strategic pass of the Western Regions.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongzhi year 7 commander Wang Yong said: "The founding dynasty established Hami Guard at the Western Regions' strategic choke point.

sentences.zh: 諸番入貢至此，必令少憩以館谷之，或遭他寇剽掠，則人馬可以接護，柔遠之道可謂至矣。

translations.literal: When the various Fan peoples came with tribute to this place, they were always made to rest briefly and be lodged and fed; if they encountered other bandits plundering them, men and horses could receive and protect them—the way of cherishing the distant could be called complete.
translations.idiomatic: Tribute missions from the frontier tribes were always given rest and provisions here; if raiders struck along the way, men and horses could escort them—the policy of cherishing distant peoples could scarcely have been more thorough.

sentences.zh: 今土魯番竊據其地，久而不退。

translations.literal: Now Turpan has stealthily occupied the place and long will not withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: Now Turpan has seized the place and shows no sign of leaving.

sentences.zh: 聞罕東左衛居哈密之南，僅三日程，野乜克力居哈密東北，僅二日程，是皆脣齒之地，利害共之。

translations.literal: I hear that Handong Left Guard lies south of Hami, only three days' journey away, and Yeme Keli lies northeast of Hami, only two days' journey away—these are all lip-and-teeth territory, sharing common interests and peril.
translations.idiomatic: Handong Left Guard lies three days south of Hami; Yeme Keli lies two days northeast—they are lip-and-teeth territory, with shared interests and shared peril.

sentences.zh: 去歲秋，土魯番遣人至只克所，脅令歸附，只克不從。

translations.literal: Last autumn Turpan sent men to Zhike's camp, coercing him to submit; Zhike would not obey.
translations.idiomatic: Last autumn Turpan sent men to Zhike's camp to force his submission; Zhike refused.

sentences.zh: 又殺野乜克力頭目，其部人咸思報怨。

translations.literal: He also killed a Yeme Keli chieftain, and all the tribesmen wish to avenge the grievance.
translations.idiomatic: He also killed a Yeme Keli chieftain, and the whole tribe burns for revenge.

sentences.zh: 宜旌勞二部，令並力合攻，永除厥患，亦以寇攻寇一策也。」

translations.literal: The two tribes should be honored and rewarded, ordered to join forces in attack, and the trouble permanently removed—this is also the strategy of using bandits to attack bandits."
translations.idiomatic: Both tribes should be rewarded and ordered to join forces and strike together, removing the threat for good—the old strategy of setting one enemy against another."

sentences.zh: 章下兵部，不能用。

translations.literal: The memorial was sent down to the Ministry of War, which did not adopt it.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial went to the Ministry of War, which did not act on it.

sentences.zh: 十七年，瓦剌及安定部人大掠沙州人畜。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, Oirats and Anding tribesmen greatly plundered the people and livestock of Shazhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year Oirats and Anding raiders plundered Shazhou's people and livestock on a large scale.

sentences.zh: 只克不能自存，叩嘉峪關求濟。

translations.literal: Zhike could not preserve himself, knocked at Jiayuguan seeking relief.
translations.idiomatic: Zhike could not hold out and came to Jiayuguan begging for aid.

sentences.zh: 天子既振給之，復諭二部解仇息爭，不得構兵召釁。

translations.literal: The Son of Heaven, having granted relief, also instructed the two tribes to dissolve enmity and cease quarreling, and not to raise troops and provoke conflict.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor granted relief and also ordered the two tribes to settle their feud and refrain from provoking conflict.

sentences.zh: 正德四年，只克部內番族有劫掠鄰境者，守臣將剿之。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Zhengde, Fan tribes within Zhike's band had raided neighboring territory; frontier officials were about to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengde year 4 Fan tribes under Zhike raided neighboring territory, and frontier officials prepared to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 兵部言：「西戎強悍，漢、唐以來不能制。

translations.literal: The Ministry of War said: "The Western Rong are fierce and strong; since Han and Tang they have not been controlled.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of War said: "The Western Rong are fierce; since Han and Tang no dynasty has fully controlled them.

sentences.zh: 我朝建哈密、赤斤、罕東諸衛，授官賜敕，犬牙相制，不惟斷匈奴右臂，亦以壯西土籓籬。

translations.literal: Our dynasty established the guards of Hami, Chijin, Handong, and others, appointing officers and bestowing edicts so they checked one another like interlocking teeth—not only severing the Xiongnu’s right arm, but also strengthening the western frontier bulwark.
translations.idiomatic: Our dynasty founded the Hami, Chijin, Handong, and other guards, appointing officers and granting patents so they checked one another like interlocking teeth—not only to break the nomads’ grip on the corridor, but to fortify the western frontier.

sentences.zh: 今番人相攻，於我何預，而遽欲兵之。

translations.literal: Now the Tibetans attack one another—what has that to do with us, that we should hastily send troops?
translations.idiomatic: Now the tribes are fighting among themselves. What concern is that of ours, that we should rush to arms?

sentences.zh: 宜敕都督只克，曉諭諸族，悔過息兵。」

translations.literal: It is fitting to order Regional Commander Zhike to instruct the various tribes to repent and cease hostilities."
translations.idiomatic: Order Regional Commander Zhike to instruct the tribes to repent and lay down their arms."

sentences.zh: 報可。

translations.literal: Approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 只克卒，子乞台嗣。

translations.literal: Zhike died; his son Qitai succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhike died, his son Qitai succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 十一年，土魯番復據哈密，以兵脅乞台降附，遂犯肅州。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year Turfan again seized Hami, used troops to coerce Qitai into submission, and then invaded Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In year 11 Turfan again occupied Hami, forced Qitai to submit at sword-point, and then raided into Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 左衛不克自立，相率徙肅州塞內。

translations.literal: The Left Guard could not maintain itself and moved en masse inside the Suzhou frontier pass.
translations.idiomatic: Unable to hold their ground, the Left Guard moved inside the frontier at Suzhou in a body.

sentences.zh: 守臣不能拒，因撫納之。

translations.literal: The frontier officials could not refuse them and therefore accepted and settled them.
translations.idiomatic: The frontier officials could not turn them away and took them in under pacification.

sentences.zh: 乞台卒，子日羔嗣。

translations.literal: Qitai died; his son Rigao succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: When Qitai died, his son Rigao succeeded.

sentences.zh: 十六年秋入朝，乞賞賚。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the sixteenth year he came to court and begged for rewards.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of year 16 he came to court seeking gifts.

sentences.zh: 禮官劾其越例，且投疏不由通政司，請治館伴者罪，從之。

translations.literal: Ritual officials impeached him for exceeding precedent and for submitting a memorial not through the Transmission Office; they asked that the hosting officers be punished, and this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual officials impeached him for overstepping precedent and for submitting a memorial outside the Transmission Office. They asked that his escort officers be punished, and the emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 乞台既內徙，其部下帖木哥、土巴二人仍居沙州，服屬土魯番，歲輸婦女、牛馬。

translations.literal: After Qitai moved inward, his subordinates Temuge and Tuba still dwelt at Shazhou, submitted to Turfan, and each year sent women, cattle, and horses as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: After Qitai moved inside the frontier, his followers Temuge and Tuba remained at Shazhou under Turfan, paying annual tribute in women, cattle, and horses.

sentences.zh: 會番酋徵求苛急，二人怨。

translations.literal: When the tribal chief’s exactions grew harsh, the two men resented it.
translations.idiomatic: When the tribal chief’s demands grew unbearable, the two turned resentful.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖七年夏，率部族五千四百人來歸，沙州遂為土魯番所有。

translations.literal: In the summer of the seventh year of Jiajing they led 5,400 tribesmen to submit; Shazhou thereupon fell to Turfan.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of Jiajing year 7 they brought 5,400 tribesmen to submit, and Shazhou passed to Turfan.

sentences.zh: 哈梅里

translations.literal: Hameri
translations.idiomatic: Hameri

sentences.zh: 哈梅里，地近甘肅，元諸王兀納失里居之。

translations.literal: Hameri lies near Gansu; the Yuan prince Unashiri dwelt there.
translations.idiomatic: Hameri lay near Gansu, where the Yuan prince Unashiri had his seat.

sentences.zh: 洪武十三年，都督濮英練兵西涼，請出師略地，開哈梅里之路以通商旅。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Hongwu, Regional Commander Pu Ying trained troops at Xiliang and requested to lead an expedition to seize territory and open the route to Hameri for merchants and travelers.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu year 13 Regional Commander Pu Ying drilled troops at Xiliang and asked to campaign westward, open the road to Hameri, and restore travel and trade.

sentences.zh: 太祖賜璽書曰：「略地之請，聽爾便宜。

translations.literal: The Taizu granted a sealed letter saying: "As for your request to seize territory, you may act as you see fit.
translations.idiomatic: The Hongwu Emperor sent a sealed letter: "As for your request to seize territory, use your own judgment.

sentences.zh: 然將以謀為本，爾慎毋忽。」

translations.literal: Yet strategy must be fundamental—do not neglect it."
translations.idiomatic: But strategy must come first—do not neglect that."

sentences.zh: 英遂進兵。

translations.literal: Ying then advanced his army.
translations.idiomatic: Pu Ying then marched.

sentences.zh: 兀納失里懼，遣使納款。

translations.literal: Unashiri was afraid and sent envoys to offer allegiance.
translations.idiomatic: Unashiri was frightened and sent envoys to submit.

sentences.zh: 明年五月遣回回阿老丁來朝貢馬。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the following year he sent the Muslim Alaoding to court to present horses as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: The next year, in the fifth month, he sent the Muslim Alaoding to court with horses as tribute.

sentences.zh: 詔賜文綺，遣往畏吾兒之地，招諭諸番。

translations.literal: An edict bestowed patterned silks and sent him to the Uighur lands to summon and instruct the various tribes.
translations.idiomatic: The court granted him brocades and sent him to the Uighur country to win over the frontier tribes.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，帝聞兀納失里與別部仇殺，諭甘肅都督宋晟等嚴兵備之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year the emperor heard that Unashiri was feuding and killing with another tribe and ordered Gansu Regional Commander Song Sheng and others to ready troops strictly.
translations.idiomatic: In year 23 the emperor learned that Unashiri was locked in blood feud with a neighboring tribe and ordered Song Sheng, regional commander of Gansu, to hold his forces in readiness.

sentences.zh: 明年遣使請於延安、綏德、平涼、寧夏以馬互市。

translations.literal: The next year he sent envoys requesting horse markets at Yan'an, Suide, Pingliang, and Ningxia.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he sent envoys asking to trade horses at Yan'an, Suide, Pingliang, and Ningxia.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「番人黠而多詐。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Tibetans are cunning and full of deceit.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "The frontier peoples are cunning and treacherous.

sentences.zh: 互市之求，安知非覘我。

translations.literal: Their request for mutual markets—who knows it is not to spy on us?
translations.idiomatic: This request for markets—who knows it is not reconnaissance?

sentences.zh: 中國利其馬而不虞其害，所喪必多。

translations.literal: If China values their horses and does not guard against their harm, what is lost will surely be great.
translations.idiomatic: If we prize their horses and ignore the danger, our losses will surely be great.

sentences.zh: 宜勿聽。

translations.literal: It is fitting not to consent.
translations.idiomatic: Do not agree.

sentences.zh: 自今至者，悉送京師。」

translations.literal: From now on, all who come are to be sent to the capital."
translations.idiomatic: From now on, send every envoy who arrives to the capital."

sentences.zh: 時西域回紇來貢者，多為哈梅里所遏。

translations.literal: At this time many of the Western Regions Uighurs coming to present tribute were blocked by Hameri.
translations.idiomatic: At that time many Uighur tribute missions from the Western Regions were blocked by Hameri.

sentences.zh: 有從他道來者，又遣兵邀殺之。

translations.literal: Those who came by other routes he again sent troops to intercept and kill.
translations.idiomatic: When they came by other routes, he sent troops to ambush and kill them.

sentences.zh: 帝聞之怒。

translations.literal: When the emperor heard of this he was angry.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was enraged when he heard of it.

sentences.zh: 八月命都督僉事劉真偕宋晟督兵討之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month he ordered Assistant Regional Commander Liu Zhen together with Song Sheng to supervise troops in attacking him.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month he ordered Assistant Regional Commander Liu Zhen and Song Sheng to lead a punitive expedition.

sentences.zh: 真等由涼州西出，乘夜直抵城下，四面圍之。

translations.literal: Zhen and the others marched out west from Liangzhou, reached the city walls by night in a direct rush, and surrounded it on four sides.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zhen marched west from Liangzhou, reached the city by night, and surrounded it on all sides.

sentences.zh: 其知院岳山夜縋城降。

translations.literal: His Pacification Commissioner Yueshan was lowered from the wall by rope at night to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: His pacification commissioner Yueshan was lowered over the wall by rope that night to surrender.

sentences.zh: 黎明，兀納失里驅馬三百餘匹，突圍而出。

translations.literal: At dawn Unashiri drove more than three hundred horses and broke out of the encirclement.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn Unashiri drove more than three hundred horses and broke through the encirclement.

sentences.zh: 官軍爭取其馬，兀納失里率家屬隨馬後遁去。

translations.literal: Government troops vied to seize the horses; Unashiri led his family after the horses and escaped.
translations.idiomatic: Government troops scrambled for the horses; Unashiri fled with his household in their wake.

sentences.zh: 真等攻破其城，斬豳王別兒怯帖木兒、國公省阿朵爾只等一千四百人，獲王子別列怯部屬千七百三十人，金銀印各一，馬六百三十匹。

translations.literal: Zhen and the others stormed the city, beheaded 1,400 persons including Prince of Bin Bierqietiemuer and Duke Sheng'a Duoerzhi, captured 1,730 followers of Prince Bielieqie, one gold and one silver seal each, and 630 horses.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zhen stormed the city, killed 1,400 men including Prince Bierqietiemuer of Bin and Duke Sheng'a Duoerzhi, and took 1,730 followers of Prince Bielieqie, one gold seal and one silver seal, and 630 horses.

sentences.zh: 二十五年遣使貢馬騾請罪。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year he sent envoys presenting horses and mules to beg forgiveness.
translations.idiomatic: In year 25 he sent envoys with horses and mules to beg forgiveness.

sentences.zh: 帝納之，賜白金、文綺。

translations.literal: The emperor accepted them and bestowed white silver and patterned silks.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor accepted the submission and granted white silver and brocades.
